jobs.title: Liens Department Lead | Personal Injury
jobs.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

The Reductions Team Lead runs the function that determines how much of every settlement actually reaches our clients. You will supervise a team of reductions and lien resolution specialists, personally handle the largest and most complex lien files, and own the metrics that measure our performance — aggregate reduction rate, net-to-client percentage, and time from settlement to disbursement.

This is a negotiation role with a management layer on top. Every dollar your team takes off a medical balance, a hospital lien, or a health plan’s subrogation claim is a dollar that goes to an injured client instead. You will set the standard for how hard those negotiations are pushed, hold the team to it, and step in personally when a provider or plan will not move.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Post-settlement medical bill and lien reductions Team Lead
• Lead the team. Supervise, train, and evaluate a team of reductions and lien resolution specialists. Assign files, manage workload distribution, run regular file reviews, and develop the team’s negotiation skills.
• Own the numbers. Track and report aggregate reduction percentage, dollars saved, aging, and settlement-to-disbursement turnaround. Identify where the team is leaving money on the table and fix it.
• Negotiate the hard files. Personally handle high-balance, high-complexity, and escalated reductions where the provider or plan has refused to move at the specialist level.
• Resolve statutory and plan liens. Direct the resolution of Medicare conditional payments and Medicare Secondary Payer obligations, Florida Medicaid (AHCA) claims under Fla. Stat. § 409.910 including the administrative challenge process, ERISA and self-funded plan reimbursement claims, TRICARE and VA claims, and hospital and provider liens under applicable county ordinances.
• Manage letter of protection balances. Negotiate LOP balances with treating providers and maintain documentation consistent with Fla. Stat. § 768.0427 disclosure requirements.
• Apply the collateral source framework. Analyze health insurance payments, PIP benefits, and other collateral sources under Fla. Stat. § 768.76 to establish the correct reimbursement exposure before negotiating.
• Build provider relationships. Establish and maintain working relationships and, where appropriate, standing reduction arrangements with high-volume providers, facilities, and lien resolution vendors.
• Partner with the attorneys. Give trial and pre-suit attorneys accurate, timely lien exposure figures so they can evaluate settlement authority and advise clients on net recovery.
• Protect the client experience. Ensure clients understand their closing statement and that disbursement is accurate, documented, and prompt.
• Improve the process. Standardize templates, escalation paths, and negotiation playbooks; recommend and help implement case management system and workflow improvements.
• Maintain compliance. Ensure every file satisfies trust accounting, Florida Bar, and firm documentation requirements before funds are released.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Minimum of four (4) years of experience in medical lien resolution, reductions, or settlement negotiation at a personal injury firm, lien resolution company, or healthcare recovery vendor.
• At least one (1) year of experience leading, training, or formally mentoring a team.
• Demonstrated track record of negotiating meaningful reductions on medical balances and liens, with the numbers to support it.
• Working knowledge of Medicare Secondary Payer rules and conditional payment resolution.
• Working knowledge of Florida Medicaid third-party recovery and the AHCA lien process.
• Familiarity with ERISA plan reimbursement claims and the practical difference between self-funded and fully insured plans.
• Understanding of Florida PIP and the collateral source framework as it affects reimbursement exposure.
• Strong command of settlement math — gross to net, attorney fees and costs, pro rata allocation, and common fund and made-whole considerations.
• Excellent written and verbal communication; able to be firm with providers and plainspoken with clients.
• Proficiency with legal case management software and spreadsheets.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bilingual English/Spanish, spoken and written.
• Experience at a high-volume Florida plaintiff personal injury firm.
• Experience negotiating with hospital systems and large provider groups in the South Florida market.
• Paralegal certificate, or a bachelor’s degree in a related field.
• Experience building or refining a reductions workflow from the ground up.
• Familiarity with Medicare Set-Aside considerations in third-party liability settlements.

LOCATION

This position is open to work at our office 5 days a week.

• Office Locations: 7900NW 154th Street, Suite 101 Miami Lakes, FL 33016
• Position Type: Full Time (8:30 AM - 5 PM EST)

COMPENSATION & BENFITS

• Professional development and continuing education support
• Collaborative, growth-oriented team environment

jobs.title: Director - Demand Generation
jobs.description:
Freshworks is looking for a senior demand generation leader to help build and modernize our scaled demand engine across our product portfolio.

This role is for a hands-on operator and builder. You will own the day-to-day demand generation engine across channels, work closely with Revenue Marketing leadership on strategy and prioritization, and help rethink how demand generation should operate in an AI-forward company.

We are not looking for someone to simply run the traditional demand gen playbook faster. We want someone who can question what is working, identify what is not, build better systems, and use AI and automation to fundamentally improve how we generate, qualify, nurture, and convert demand.

You will partner closely with Sales, RevOps, Product Marketing, Analytics, and regional marketing teams to create an integrated demand engine that drives measurable pipeline and revenue impact.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and execute the scaled demand generation roadmap across our product portfolio, balancing pipeline goals, audience priorities, channel performance, and budget.
• Build and optimize always-on demand programs across SEM, SEO, AI search/GEO, content syndication, webinars, conversational marketing, lifecycle, nurture, and emerging channels.
• Build AI-native and agentic workflows into the demand engine, including audience identification, campaign orchestration, lead qualification, personalization, optimization, and reporting.
• Own performance across key demand generation metrics including MQCs/MQLs, SAOs, conversion rates, pipeline contribution, pipeline velocity, CAC, CPL, and channel efficiency.
• Manage and continuously optimize multi-million-dollar budgets across channels and campaigns based on incremental pipeline impact and ROI.
• Partner with Sales and RevOps on lead scoring, qualification, routing, SLAs, and handoff processes to improve conversion from demand through pipeline.
• Partner with Product Marketing to ensure campaigns, messaging, and audience strategies are coordinated across product lines rather than fragmented.
• Build a rigorous testing and experimentation culture, with clear hypotheses, measurement frameworks, and decisions on where to scale, optimize, or stop investment.
• Lead and develop a high-performing demand generation team while remaining close enough to the work to diagnose problems and drive execution.
• Evaluate and help evolve the demand generation martech stack, including marketing automation, intent data, conversational marketing, AI tools, and orchestration platforms.

What Success Looks Like:

In this role, success means building a demand engine that is:

• Predictable in generating qualified pipeline
• Efficient in how budget is deployed
• Stronger at converting demand into sales opportunities
• Integrated across products, regions, and channels
• Increasingly automated and AI-native
• Measured on business outcomes, not activity volume

The Profile We Are Looking For

• You are equally comfortable looking at a pipeline dashboard, challenging a channel strategy, designing a new operating system, and getting into the details with the team.
• You are not overly attached to legacy marketing playbooks. You care about what actually creates an incremental pipeline and are willing to stop programs that no longer perform.
• Most importantly, you are a builder. You see demand generation as a system to continuously redesign and improve, not simply a collection of campaigns to run.

Qualifications:

• 10+ years of experience in B2B demand generation, growth marketing, or performance marketing, ideally in enterprise SaaS.
• Significant experience owning scaled demand generation programs and measurable pipeline targets.
• Experience managing multi-million-dollar marketing budgets and making channel allocation decisions based on performance and ROI.
• Strong understanding of demand generation economics, including CPL, CAC, conversion rates, pipeline coverage, velocity, and incremental return.
• Demonstrated experience building or implementing AI-enabled or agentic workflows within a marketing or demand generation environment.
• Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms such as Marketo, HubSpot, or Pardot and CRM platforms such as Salesforce.
• Experience with intent and account intelligence platforms such as 6sense or Demandbase and conversational marketing platforms such as Qualified or Drift.
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to independently diagnose performance issues using data.
• Strong partnership skills across Sales, RevOps, Product Marketing, Analytics, and executive stakeholders.
• Experience leading and developing demand generation teams.

Preferred:

• Experience in a scaled, sales-led enterprise SaaS company with a multi-product portfolio.
• Experience operating in both enterprise and SMB/mid-market motions.
• Experience at an AI-native company or building AI-native marketing systems.
• A strong point of view on AI search, GEO, and how buyer discovery is changing.
• Experience with ITSM, customer support, CRM, or adjacent enterprise software categories.

We're committed to building a workplace that reflects the diverse world we serve. At Freshworks, you'll find inclusive teams, flexible thinking, and opportunities to grow your career - while making work better for millions.

If this sounds like a journey you want to be part of, we'd love to meet you. Let's building something refreshing together.

The annual base salary range for this position is $225,000 - $280,000 Base Salary.

Compensation is based on a variety of factors including but not limited to location, experience, job-related skills, and level. Bonus/equity may be available.

The Senior Project Manager (SPM) plays a pivotal role in leading the internal day-to-day operations and delivery for a set of strategic, creative and medium-to-high complexity tactical projects, from inception to completion, within a brand or multiple brands. The SPM has expert-level project management skills which allow them to lead any type of project or program, with limited supervision, and is considered the primary internal nucleus for their projects.

• Full lifecycle delivery and management of complex, technical, strategic and creative projects

• Develops and actively manages project timelines, estimates, risk registers, communication plans, burn reports and change logs with minimal oversight

• Leads the estimation process and provides project budget and staff plan parameters with minimal supervision

• Leads the project timeline creation process in close partnership with internal and external stakeholders with minimal supervision

• Leads project kickoffs and status meetings

• Creates and/or reviews and distributes meeting recaps; oversees and evolves Project Managers (PM) and Project Coordinators (PC) in their ability to write actionable recaps

• In partnership with ADs and GPD, provides input to program Gantt Charts

• In partnership with Account Services, AD and GPD, assists with change order creation and management

• Works closely with Project Management Office (PMO) leadership to identify and mitigate program-level risks

• Identifies project staff needs and works with resource managers and PCs to ensure accuracy and updates of resource plans

• Resolves conflicts, including scope, schedule, resources, budget, quality and communication with minimal oversight

• Ensures all project artifacts (FRD, BRD, etc.) are properly stored within enterprise systems (Workfront, TFS, etc.)

• Accountable for application of Intouch delivery processes and PMO standards across their projects

• Actively mentors and supports training efforts for Project Managers and Project Coordinators

• Acts as first touchpoint of escalation for Project Managers and PCs

• Keeps direct manager informed; asks for help when needed; knows when to escalate issues/concerns to leadership; brings solutions

• Participates in candidate interviews as needed

• Effectively senses team morale and understands how to address issues

• modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent education plus professional experience required

• Three to five years of experience in a PMO role

• Pharmaceutical or advertising experience preferred (AOR or DAOR)

• Advanced understanding and applications of PMO standards and processes

• Experience leading the delivery of complex, technology, strategy and creative based projects

• Ability to develop a creative, strategic or technical heavy project plan

• Ability to tailor and flex process to provide solutions to proactively facilitate a project

• Experience leading a wide range of different functional groups and project teams

• Comprehension of project forecasting and reforecasting throughout lifecycle of project

• Expert project and program burn analysis and remediation

• Excellent scope and change management tracking and adherence

• Comfortable with client-facing communication

• Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate, assess and mitigate risk

• Ability to build trust, negotiate and influence decision-making with Account, SMEs, Clients, Partner Agencies and third-party vendors

• Strong sense of ownership and accountability

• Strong decision-making and implementation, especially when faced with uncertainty

• Experience working with Project Management Information Systems such as Workfront, Workfront Proof, Smartsheet, MS Project

• Strong understanding of Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Excel

• Launch experience a plus

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.

We're seeking a Senior Lead Engineer to direct multi-disciplinary engineering teams delivering custom municipal and industrial treatment systems. In this pivotal leadership role, you'll be accountable for all engineering deliverables, guiding cross-functional teams of 25-30+ engineers through complex projects from conception to completion.

As a member of the project leadership team alongside the Project Manager and Sourcing Project Leader, you'll ensure technical excellence, schedule adherence, and budget compliance while serving as the primary technical face of Veolia to our customers. This is an ideal role for an experienced engineer who excels at building high-performing teams, communicating vision, and driving results in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Team Management

• Direct multi-disciplinary engineering teams (Process, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation & Controls) managing approximately 4,000 engineering hours monthly
• Build and mentor high-performing teams, delegate effectively, and facilitate collaboration across functions
• Establish project rhythms, meetings, and communication structures that drive clear action plans and outcomes
• Identify competency development needs and support team growth.

Engineering Delivery & Quality Assurance

• Oversee all engineering deliverables including P&IDs, equipment drawings, datasheets, plant/piping arrangements, instrumentation architecture, and design specifications
• Coordinate formal and peer review processes to ensure accuracy and quality of all technical work
• Manage engineering activities across internal and external functions using industry-standard tools (schedules, document lists, action items, risk registers, change orders)
• Ensure proper technical review of vendor selection and fabrication.

Commercial & Customer Management

• Support bid activities with technical reviews, labor estimates, and sub-contracting strategies
• Execute projects with balance of plant (BOP) and site installation scope
• Serve as primary customer liaison, resolving technical queries and managing expectations
• Coordinate technical requirements with suppliers and ensure timely information delivery
• Support Sourcing in vendor management and performance monitoring.

Project Coordination & Execution

• Manage project team resource budgets and allocate resources strategically
• Coordinate all engineering activities to maximize performance and project success
• Maintain critical project reporting and documentation
• Exercise sound judgment and professionalism when managing multiple shifting demands.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in an accredited Engineering field
• Minimum 10 years of project experience in engineering or a related field
• Impeccable planning, organization, and time management skills
• Clear, concise communication and presentation abilities
• Strong meeting facilitation skills with ability to set objectives and drive outcomes
• Team player with excellent judgment under changing conditions
• Ability to travel domestically and internationally 5-10% of the time.

• Direct experience in water treatment, oil & gas, chemical, or power industries
• Experience with industrial processes and system engineering
• EPC (Engineering, Procurement & Construction) contract experience
• Professional Engineer's License, or ability to obtain one within 1 year.

jobs.title: Prodajni savjetnik, Westgate Zaprešić
jobs.description:
ŠTO ĆEŠ RADITI?

Kao prodajni savjetnik, imat ćeš ključnu ulogu u stvaranju izvanrednog iskustva kupovine našim kupcima. Dočekivat ćeš kupce, usmjeravati ih kroz trgovinu, te pokazujući naše proizvode pomagat ćeš im u pronalasku onoga što traže. Prateći naše vrijednosti, pridonosit ćeš osobnom uspjehu, ali i uspjehu kompanije.

Također ćeš:

• Dijeliti svoje znanje o modi i proizvodima, kako bi sa što više informacija pomogao/la kupcima pri donošenju odluke.
• Surađivati sa svojim timom, kako biste pružili iznimnu uslugu kupcu na svakom koraku.
• Brinuti da su prodajni prostor, kao i pozadinske prostorije, dobro opskrbljeni zalihama, organizirani i privlačni.
• Pružati podršku prilikom otvaranja i zatvaranja trgovine.
• Pozitivno predstavljati sebe i brend tijekom svake interakcije s kupcima.

S KIM ĆEŠ RADITI?

Naše trgovine su srce naše kompanije, u kojima se kupci direktno susreću s našim brendom. Kao dio dinamičnog tima u trgovini, svaka uloga – od prodajnih savjetnika, voditelja odjela, voditelja trgovine i vizualnih dekoratera, do glavnog blagajnika – doprinosi stvaranju inspirativnog i gostoljubivog okruženja. Također, surađivat ćeš s timom sa šireg područja, kao i između trgovina, kako biste podijelili iskustva i zajedno postigli uspjeh. Zajedno sa svojim timom, imat ćeš ključnu ulogu u pružanju usluga kupcima kako bi se osjećali samouvjereno te izrazili svoju individualnost uz najnovije trendove i beskrajne stilske mogućnosti. Izgradnjom značajnih veza s kupcima u našim trgovinama, modu činimo dostupnom i održivom za sve.

TKO SI?

• Tražimo ljude s/sa...​
• Iskustvom usluživanja kupaca na području mode, maloprodaji ili sličnim područjima, što će se smatrati prednošću.
• Strašću za pomaganjem kupcima te interesom za modu ili maloprodaju –rado ćemo te naučiti svemu ostalom!

I ljude koji (su)...​

• Uživaju u timskom i dinamičnom okruženju.
• Komunikativni, kreativni i zainteresirani za rad s tehnologijom u trgovini.
• Posjeduju snažnu želju za učenjem i daljnjim razvojem.
• Fleksibilni i orijentiran na aktivnosti.

TKO SMO?

H&M Group je globalna kompanija snažnih modnih brendova i pothvata. Cilj nam je dokazati kako ne postoji kompromis između iznimnog dizajna, pristupačnih cijena i održivih rješenja. Želimo modu svima učiniti dostupnom, a naši kupci su u središtu svake naše odluke koju donosimo.

Čine nas tisuće strastvenih i talentiranih kolega, ujedinjenih zajedničkom kulturom te vrijednostima. Zajedno želimo iskoristiti svoju snagu, svoje postignuće i znanje kako bismo usmjerili modnu industriju prema inkluzivnijoj i održivijoj budućnosti.

ZAŠTO ĆEŠ VOLJETI RADITI OVDJE?

U H&M Grupi, ponosni smo na to što smo energična i gostoljubiva kompanija. Našim zaposlenicima nudimo atraktivne pogodnosti s opsežnim mogućnostima razvoja diljem svijeta.

• 10% popusta za djelatnike na sve naše H&M Group robne marke, kako u trgovinama tako i online
• H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Više o programu saznaj ovdje.​
• Privatno zdravstveno dopunsko i dodatno osiguranje
• Nagrada za dugogodišnji rad za 10, 15 & 20 godina
• Naknada za topli obrok
• Nagrada za umirovljenje
• Dar za vjenčanje
• Program preporuke

PRIDRUŽI NAM SE!

Naša jedinstvenost proizlazi iz kombinacije mnogih faktora– naše inkluzivne i suradničke kulture, naših snažnih vrijednosti i prilika za rast no ponajviše naših ljudi koji nas čine onim što jesmo.​

Zajedno s nama napravi sljedeći korak u svojoj karijeri. Putovanje počinje ovdje.​

* Proces selekcije kandidata:

Radi efikasnog upravljanja s velikim brojem prijava za ulogu prodajnog savjetnika, koristimo online regrutacijsku metodu procjene koja se temelji na vještinama u nekim od naših trgovina. Morat ćeš ih ispuniti kao dio postupka prijave i provjere. Tvoji odgovori bit će ocjenjeni alatom za procjenu koji primjenjuje unaprijed definirane kriterije koje je postavila H&M Grupa.

• Monitor market conditions, client expansion strategies, and emerging construction opportunities.
• Represent Dexterra US at industry events, client meetings, site visits, and other business development activities.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

• Proven business development experience within commercial construction, general contracting, design-build, construction management, or a related industry.
• A demonstrated record of developing and closing complex construction opportunities.
• Experience selling to organizations with multiple locations, regional or national portfolios, or recurring construction needs.
• Established relationships within sectors such as retail, restaurants, financial services, healthcare, industrial, distribution, hospitality, or commercial real estate would be an asset.
• Strong understanding of commercial construction delivery models, including ground-up construction, tenant improvements, renovations, remodels, and rollout programs.
• Ability to identify client challenges and translate them into practical construction solutions and measurable business value.
• Confidence building relationships with senior leaders in construction, real estate, facilities, procurement, finance, and operations.

• Strong commercial judgment, communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
• A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively with estimating, construction, operations, finance, and executive leadership.
• Disciplined pipeline management and CRM experience.
• Ability and willingness to travel for client meetings, industry events, and site visits.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

• Be part of a growing organization with a strong focus on innovation and operational excellence.
• Award winning safety culture.
• Competitive compensation and benefits package including 401k, medical, dental, vision, paid time off.
• Fully Remote work model.

• Experience recruiting across multiple AMER countries.
• Strong experience hiring technical and business professionals.
• Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and executives.

The ideal candidate will be an enthusiastic civil or structural engineer with experience: new pipeline design and installation, existing installations, failure and forensics analysis, condition assessment, and rehabilitation.

Responsibilities may include but not limited to:

• Work on projects related to pipeline failure analysis and pipeline forensics analysis.
• Work on projects from planning through design and construction services, for new and rehabilitation pipe designs, for water, sewer and stormwater infrastructure.
• Work on projects related to pressure pipe design and pipe stress analysis.
• Understanding of construction methods, such as open-cut and trenchless (micro tunneling, jack and bore, etc.) for sewer and water infrastructure.

• Technical writing, reviewing, and providing clear, concise input to investigations, memorandums, engineering reports and documentations.
• Prepare engineering services proposals, fee estimates, and schedules.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

• BS in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering or a related field + 8 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
• Licensed PE
• 8 years of project experience in design of municipal water, wastewater and/or stormwater pipeline design, analysis, installation, and inspection.
• 8 years of experience in Mathcad / MATLAB and FEA.
• 8 years of experience working with pipeline design codes, standards, and regulations.
• Valid U.S. Driver’s License and as a condition of employment, must pass AECOM’s Motor Vehicle Records Review.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Strong ability to read and interpret 2D and 3D CAD drawings.

jobs.title: Data Analytics Lead (Product Intelligence)
jobs.description:
About the role

The Product Intelligence team serves a critical role by providing business intelligence to the organization: we synthesize data sources across the company, delivering product usage and business insights that directly shape product strategy and decision-making.

We are looking for a Data Analytics Lead to own the analytical and semantic layer of Product Intelligence – the person who defines what our data means, makes sure it is trustworthy, and turns it into insight that changes decisions. You will work hand in hand with Product Management and Engineering to define the telemetry we need in order to answer the questions the business is actually asking, establish the success metrics that product and commercial teams are measured against, and proactively investigate product usage and user journeys to surface opportunities PMs would not have found on their own. You will also be the analytical voice in the room with senior leadership, regularly presenting insights and recommendations to senior management.

This is a deliberately broad, high-ownership analytics role rather than a report-building one. You will own data quality, cataloging, and the semantic definitions that make our data AI-ready, and you will partner closely with your data engineering counterpart – defining the business needs and data requirements, and collaborating with them to deliver the pipelines and models that support them.

As a senior individual contributor, you will lead our analytics function, its standards, and its definitions. As Lead you are expected to own the discipline and set its direction, with your influence coming from the quality of your work and your partnerships across Product, Engineering, and the business.

What you’ll do

Insight & analysis

• Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to translate product usage and telemetry data into product-led insights – identifying upsell opportunities, predicting churn, and supporting revenue targets.
• Perform proactive, self-directed analysis into product usage and user journeys – funnel and drop-off analysis, feature adoption, cohort and retention behaviour – to help Product Managers understand how the product is really used and where to improve it.
• Define, document, and own the success metrics used to evaluate product features, releases, and business objectives, and make sure they are consistently understood and applied across teams.
• Provide regular reporting, insights, and recommendations to senior management, and present them directly to that audience.
• Manage senior stakeholders across the business, balancing competing analytical priorities from Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance.

Data definition, quality & governance

• Own the semantic layer: define what our core business entities and metrics mean – customer, account, active user, adoption, churn, expansion – so that a given metric means the same thing everywhere in the company.
• Champion an AI-ready data strategy by defining the semantics, metric definitions, and metadata that allow AI and LLM-powered tools to query our data reliably and return trustworthy answers.
• Own data quality for the analytical layer: define quality expectations and checks, monitor for silent correctness failures, and drive issues to resolution with the owning teams before they reach a dashboard or a leadership deck.
• Build and maintain the data catalog and documentation, so that data consumers across the company can find data, understand its meaning, and know how much to trust it.
• Establish and maintain data governance practices for the analytics layer – ownership, lineage, definitions, and access – proportionate to a fast-moving team.

Data collection & partnering with Engineering

• Work with Product Managers and Engineering to define and implement new product telemetry, specifying the events, properties, and grain needed to answer real business questions – and validating that what ships actually answers them.
• Identify gaps in what we currently collect, and make the case for the instrumentation needed to close them.
• Define business and data requirements clearly enough to be built, and collaborate with your data engineering counterpart to deliver the pipelines, models, and data structures required to support them.
• Contribute to the design and evolution of the analytics layer, including semantic modeling and dashboarding within our BI tools.
• Promote an agile, iterative way of working and actively contribute to team ceremonies.

What We’re Looking For

Analytics experience

• Degree in a quantitative, technical, or business-analytical field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 7+ years of experience in a data analyst, product analyst, analytics engineer, or business intelligence role, including experience operating with a high level of autonomy and owning your own analytical agenda.
• Strong SQL – comfortable working directly in a data warehouse against large, messy, multi-source data without needing someone to prepare it for you.
• Proven experience partnering with Product and business teams to deliver product-led insights, such as identifying upsell opportunities, predicting churn, or supporting revenue growth.
• Demonstrated experience managing senior stakeholders and presenting data strategy and insights to executive/C-level audiences.
• Hands-on experience with product usage or telemetry data – funnels, user journeys, feature adoption, cohort and retention analysis.
• Experience defining success metrics and KPIs, and the judgement to know when a proposed metric will drive the wrong behaviour.
• Experience with data visualization and BI tools such as Power BI, QuickSight, Tableau, or similar – including building the semantic/data model behind a dashboard, not just the dashboard itself.
• Solid understanding of data modeling concepts (facts, dimensions, grain, slowly changing dimensions) and the ability to reason about whether a data model can answer a given business question.
• Hands-on experience using agentic AI coding tools – Claude Code or similar – as part of your day-to-day analytical work: exploring unfamiliar data, writing and debugging queries and transformations, and automating repetitive analysis.
• Familiarity with the modern data stack – dbt, cloud data warehouses (Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar), AWS services such as S3, Athena, or Glue – and comfort using Git as part of an analytics workflow.
• Experience specifying telemetry or instrumentation requirements together with Product and Engineering teams.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain a complex finding simply without losing its rigor. Fluency in English.
• Available to travel to our head office in Lausanne on an occasional basis.

Data quality, governance & AI-readiness

• Practical experience owning data quality – defining checks and expectations, investigating discrepancies, and distinguishing a genuine business result from a data problem.
• Experience with data cataloging, documentation, or data governance practices, and an understanding of why shared definitions matter more than tooling.
• Solid understanding of AI/ML and LLM concepts and their implications for data – in particular, why semantic definitions, metric consistency, and data quality determine whether an AI tool gives a trustworthy answer or a plausible wrong one.
• Ability to identify where AI can create value in an analytics workflow, and interest in using it to work faster.

How you work

• Curious and proactive: you go looking for the insight nobody asked for, and you sanity-check a result against business reality before you present it.
• Comfortable with ambiguity – able to turn a vague business question into a well-defined analysis, and to say clearly when the data cannot answer it.
• Collaborative: you work as a genuine partner to Product Managers and to your data engineering counterpart rather than as a request queue.
• Rigorous and honest about confidence levels, caveats, and the limits of the data.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Accounting – TV Networks
jobs.location: Englewood Cliffs, NEW JERSEY, United States
jobs.description:
Position Overview

Versant is seeking a Senior Director, Accounting – TV Networks to lead the controllership activities across the Sports and Entertainment Networks portfolio to ensure accurate accounting, financial reporting, and internal controls over multiple revenue streams and operating expenses. Reporting to the Controller, TV Networks, this leader will oversee a TV Networks business unit controllership team and manage the work supported by the shared services accounting operations team.

This role will partner cross-functionally with Corporate Controllership, Finance, Technical Accounting, Internal Audit, Legal and Technology.  This role will also be instrumental in building and optimizing the accounting foundation of a newly independent public company by driving controllership excellence, enhancing internal controls, supporting ERP and finance transformation initiatives, and developing scalable accounting processes that enable future growth.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical accounting expertise with operational leadership, exceptional people management skills, and the ability to lead through change in a dynamic media environment.

Key Responsibilities

Controllership & Financial Reporting

• Lead the controllership function for the Sports and Entertainment Networks, including accounting oversight for linear distribution, advertising sales, affiliate revenues, licensing, and other revenue streams, as well as non-programming operating expenses.
• Oversee all accounting activities to ensure transactions are recorded, documented, reviewed, and supported in accordance with U.S. GAAP, company accounting policies, and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) requirements.
• Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes, ensuring the timely and accurate preparation of financial statements, balance sheet reconciliations, account analyses, and supporting schedules.
• Review and approve journal entries, account reconciliations, accruals, and other accounting estimates, ensuring completeness and accuracy of the general ledger.
• Lead balance sheet reviews, identifying trends, risks, and unusual items and ensuring the completeness of external reporting support schedules.
• Ensure the accurate and timely preparation and delivery of recurring and ad hoc management reporting for executive leadership.

Business Partnership

• Serve as a key accounting partner to the Sports and Entertainment Networks Finance organization, providing guidance on accounting implications, reporting requirements, and internal controls for new business initiatives and transactions.
• Partner closely with Business Unit Controllership Leaders including the Senior Director, Programming & Content Accounting and the Director, Participations & Residuals.
• Partner with cross-functional groups including Technical Accounting, Corporate Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, Tax, Legal, Accounting Operations, Technology, Internal Audit, and external auditors to support business initiatives and resolve complex accounting matters.
• Provide accounting guidance on strategic initiatives, commercial agreements, contract interpretation, and new revenue arrangements.

Transformation & Process Improvement

• Partner with Controllership, Accounting Operations and Technology groups on accounting transformation initiatives focused on process standardization, automation, ERP implementation, close optimization, and reporting modernization.
• Drive continuous improvement efforts to enhance efficiency, strengthen controls, reduce manual processes, and improve reporting quality.
• Identify accounting process improvement opportunities and implement best practices that improve accuracy, efficiency, governance, and scalability.

Leadership & Talent Development

• Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing accounting organization by fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence.
• Build organizational capability to support evolving scope, greater centralization, ERP transformation, and future-state accounting operations.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
• CPA required.
• Public accounting experience and/or experience within a publicly traded company is preferred.
• 12+ years of progressive accounting and controllership experience, including significant leadership responsibility within a large, complex organization.
• Deep knowledge of U.S. GAAP, SEC/public company reporting, internal controls, and SOX compliance.
• Demonstrated experience leading month-end close, financial reporting, balance sheet governance, reconciliations, and accounting operations.
• Experience in media, entertainment, digital, advertising, networks, streaming, technology, or similarly complex industries.
• Experience leading process transformation, automation, centralization, or operating model redesign.
• Proven ability to lead and develop high-performing teams while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Exceptional analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with stakeholders across Finance, Accounting, and business organizations.

Leadership Competencies

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

• Deep technical accounting expertise balanced with operational excellence.
• Demonstrated ability to build strong partnerships across Controllership, Finance, and operational business teams.
• Ability to lead through organizational change and ambiguity while driving execution and accountability.
• Continuous improvement orientation with a passion for automation, standardization, and process optimization.
• High integrity, sound judgment, and commitment to financial stewardship and strong governance.
• Collaborative leadership style with a focus on developing talent, building high-performing teams, and fostering an inclusive, performance-driven culture.

Why Join Versant?

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the accounting and controllership function of a newly independent public media company. As a senior leader within the TV Networks Controllership organization, you will play a critical role in overseeing the accounting and financial reporting for Versant's Sports and Entertainment Networks while helping establish scalable accounting processes, strengthen governance, support business growth, and drive finance transformation.

This role is based at Versant's CNBC headquarters in Englewood Cliffs, NJ, offering the opportunity to collaborate with executive leadership in a highly dynamic and evolving environment. The office is easily accessible from New York City, Westchester County, and throughout New Jersey, with a complimentary daily shuttle service from Manhattan.

Additional Information:

• Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from the office a minimum of three days per week. Subject to change based on business need. This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks.
• Salary range: $160,000 - $200,000 (bonus and long-term incentive eligible)

While we look forward to supporting your continued learning and development, for this role we have identified some qualifications, skills, and capabilities that will set you up for success.

•   Business development success—evidence of consistently winning work (e.g., annual sales targets achieved, repeatable proposal wins, measurable account growth).

•   A strong professional network in New Jersey and an existing book of business.

•   Strong program/project leadership (scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk) and the ability to lead multi-disciplinary team.

•   In-depth knowledge of NJDEP environmental regulations and Technical Guidance and application to real-world situations.

•   Relevant degree in environmental science, engineering, geology, chemistry, or a related field; professional certifications/licensure (e.g., LSRP, PE, PG).

Why this role

•   Growth runway: define and expand our New Jersey market presence with leadership visibility.

•   Seller-doer platform: autonomy to lead pursuits plus support from technical specialists and delivery teams.

•   Strategic influence: shape offerings, pricing, and account strategies that drive repeatable growth.

•   Leadership opportunity: mentor talent, help recruit, and build a practice with staying power.

•   Flexibility & balance: hybrid work options.

•   The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

•   Competitive base pay and incentive programs

•   Support of external memberships, conference and engagements

If you’re excited by the chance to build a market, grow client partnerships, and lead a high-performing team, we encourage you to apply.

What we can offer you

• Interesting and diverse projects
• The opportunity to work with some of the best and brightest professionals in your field
• Generous Paid Time Off
• Excellent health and retirement benefits
• Investment in your development

jobs.title: Publicist – Vintage (Hybrid)
jobs.location: New York, New York (NY), United States
jobs.description:
Vintage is currently seeking a Publicist to work on a wide variety of fiction and nonfiction titles both in our Vintage Originals program and across the storied Vintage backlist catalog.  This position offers the unique opportunity to both launch new books and reimagine how classics are rediscovered.

Vintage Books is the trade paperback home to the Knopf Doubleday Publishing Group’s authors. Its publishing list ranges widely, from the most influential works of world literature to cutting-edge contemporary fiction and distinguished nonfiction. Vintage is today’s foremost trade paperback publisher, giving home to important writers including Margaret Atwood, James Baldwin, John Berendt, Albert Camus, Ralph Ellison, William Faulkner, David Grann, Shane Hawk, Samantha Irby, Haruki Murakami, Cormac McCarthy, Gabriel Garcia Marquez, Alexander McCall Smith, Toni Morrison, Donna Tartt, Ted Van Alst, Jr., and Alice Wong.

The Publicist will be responsible for writing press materials, securing top national and regional media across print and digital, and liaising closely with authors, agents, editors, and marketing and sales colleagues. Candidates should have a passion for the literary world and a desire to connect seminal titles from across decades to current events, pop culture, and the arts.

Specific responsibilities include:

• Executing media campaigns for titles across a range of genres, including securing national, regional, and niche media (radio, TV, print, online, newsletters, podcast).
• Developing and maintaining strong working relationships with producers, editors, event coordinators, festival organizers, and booksellers.
• Independently planning and executing author tours, including author travel, and maintaining detailed author schedules.
• Accompanying authors to local NYC based interviews and bookselling events.
• Communicating and building partnerships with agents, as well as managing high-touch author care.
• Creating persuasive press materials, including press releases, pitch letters, author Q&As, and story ideas.
• Collaborating with the editorial, marketing, and sales teams on campaign execution.
• Identifying new media opportunities to build on existing contacts and brainstorms creative angles for our list.

• Minimum of 3-4 years of publicity experience in a publishing environment
• Ability to work independently as well as in a collaborative team setting
• Ability to meet deadlines, multitask, and prioritize
• Ability to independently manage campaign budgets
• Strong attention to detail and organization skills
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Must be a creative and strategic thinker

This is a hybrid position with in-office responsibilities (approximately 2-3 days a week). We will consider candidates who can work from a commutable distance to our offices at 1745 Broadway, which includes the tri-state area (NJ, CT, and NY).

Candidates will have more than 10 years of experience as construction project inspectors on large, complex, multi-million-dollar Department of Defense (DoD) projects, including dormitories, airfields, shoreline restoration, and similar infrastructure. Strong experience in Civil, Mechanical, or Electrical construction disciplines is highly desirable.

Key responsibilities include reviewing and interpreting plans and specifications to ensure completeness, accuracy, and constructability. The role will primarily involve field inspection and reporting. Candidates must be able to interact professionally with clients and contractors, demonstrating excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and a polished presentation.

This person will be responsible for but not limited to the following:

• Provide oversight of contractor compliance with contract requirements and standards in accordance with the USACE 3-Phase inspection program, including evaluation of inspection levels, testing procedures, and deficiency correction documentation.
• Complete and maintain comprehensive field records, including daily reports documenting work performed, field measurements, computations, and observations.
• Participate in technical review of submittals and development plans to ensure conformity to USACE standards and specifications.
• Document construction observations and issue discrepancy notices for non-compliant items.
• Attend and participate in construction progress meetings and contractor weekly project meetings.
• Perform infrastructure walkthroughs and develop punch lists as required.
• Provide construction photographs to document progress and problem areas.
• Ensure compliance with safety regulations, USACE requirements, and building codes during construction of utility equipment.
• Participate in tests, demonstrations, and field instructions with appropriate personnel.
• Resolve conflicts related to construction installation.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office is required, and experience with RMS.

Minimum Requirements

• HS + 10 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
• US Citizen
• Condition of employment candidates must pass substance abuse test

Preferred Requirements

• 10 years of experience as a construction project inspector on large complex multimillion dollar DoD construction projects.
• Knowledge of the USACE Three Phase Inspection Process.
• Knowledge of EM 385-1 Safety Requirements.
• CQM Certification.
• Retired Military.

jobs.description:

Are you a skilled technician? At Thermopatch B.V., we are opening a brand-new, unique position for a serious and meticulous mechatronics professional who wants to own the production process from start to finish.

In this role, you won't just be a cog in a machine - you will be the one building them. You will bridge the gap between fine-tuned electronics and robust mechanical assembly. You will take loose components and turn them into fully operational, high-quality heat seal machines. If you have a passion for technology, a steady hand for precise soldering, and the flexibility to pivot from programming to light logistics, this role offers the ultimate technical variety.

Key responsibilities

• End-to-End Machine Assembly: Build our signature heat seal machines completely from scratch, seamlessly integrating both mechanical and electronic components.
• Testing & Calibration: Run comprehensive diagnostic testing and calibrate the finished devices to ensure they meet our strict performance standards before shipment.
• PCB Manufacturing & Finishing: Perform precise component-level work on printed circuit boards (PCBs), including soldering switches and displays, programming, and fine calibration.
• Spare Parts Production: Manufacture high-quality spare parts to support our customers, such as precisely fitting connectors to heating elements.
• Logistics Collaboration: Maintain a smooth workflow by handling light warehouse duties, which include collecting manufactured products and preparing them for the logistics department.

• Proximity: Currently residing in the Netherlands, in or within a reliable commuting distance of Almere (absolute must).
• Technical Aptitude: Strong mechanical insight and a genuine curiosity about how things work. A background in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or a similar field is preferred.
• Soldering Expertise: Proven, hands-on experience with PCB soldering, specifically with delicate components like switches and displays.
• Meticulous Mindset: A serious, accurate approach to your craft. You are someone who takes pride in the details and ensures every calibration is perfect.
• All-Round Flexibility: An autonomous worker who thrives on variety and is equally happy programming a circuit board, building a machine frame, or helping out in the warehouse.

jobs.title: Transport Planner
jobs.description:
The Transport Planner plans, schedules, and dispatches outbound shipments delivered by the company’s own fleet of box trucks. This role owns the daily route and delivery schedule, assigns drivers and vehicles, confirms customer delivery appointments, and tracks shipments through proof of delivery. The Transport Planner works closely with warehouse outbound teams, drivers, fleet maintenance, and Client Services to ensure every load departs on time, is delivered accurately, and meets committed service levels.

YOUR TASKS

• Plan and schedule daily outbound shipments and delivery routes for the company-owned box truck fleet.
• Build daily and weekly dispatch schedules, sequencing stops by customer delivery window, service level, and geography.
• Assign drivers and vehicles to routes, balancing hours-of-service limits, truck capacity, and driver availability.
• Confirm delivery appointments with customers and receiving sites; communicate schedule changes, delays, and exceptions promptly
• Coordinate with the warehouse outbound team so orders are picked, staged, and loaded in time for scheduled departures
• Track trucks in transit, monitor departure and delivery performance, and re-route or re-schedule when disruptions occur.
• Prepare and maintain shipping documentation, including bills of lading, packing lists, delivery receipts, and proof of delivery.
• Arrange third-party carrier coverage when volume exceeds fleet capacity, and verify rates, transit times, and service commitments.
• Report on transportation KPIs such as on-time delivery, fleet utilization, stops and miles per route, and cost per delivery.
• Support fleet readiness by tracking preventive maintenance, DOT inspections, fuel, and vehicle availability with the fleet lead.
• Communicate with drivers, warehouse supervisors, and Client Services on delivery issues; address and resolve discrepancies related to scheduling, routing, and shipment execution.

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate/Truck Driver
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Warehouse Associate/ Truck Driver to join our Mayer Team in Marietta, GA!

Summary:

Employee’s level and pay will be dependent on their level of experience, knowledge, and capabilities. The Warehouse Associate/Truck Driver I is responsible for efficiently and accurately filling customer orders, receiving, stocking, staging, and shipping material in a manner that meets company standards for safety, security, accuracy, and productivity. Responsible for all warehouse transactions, as well as the upkeep and maintenance of the branch warehouse environment and equipment. This role also has an essential driving component and may be assigned to operate a delivery vehicle for up to 50% of its time delivering products to/from customers, company branch/warehouse locations, and company suppliers in a delivery van or box truck (No CDL required). Responsible for ensuring that deliveries are prepared to meet customer requirements in the most efficient manner and materials are correct and free of damage.

• Follow established Standard Operating Procedures, Environmental Health and Safety Rules, and immediately address safety concerns
• Receive material coming into the building by vendors, customers, or other warehouses and verify the quantity and description of materials received by checking merchandise against the packing list
• Keep incoming orders stocked on shelves orderly and in designated area and report freight damage claims
• Prepare branch orders from the warehouse and ensure that the correct number and type of product is being shipped
• Process paperwork regarding shipments including but not limited to verifying that the merchandise to be shipped is correct, applying the correct postage tape and label, following customer shipping instructions, and insuring the shipment when necessary

• Load common carrier and company vehicles

• Inspect company vehicle for visual and operating defects; responsible for completing a daily inspection report
• Keep company vehicle clean, serviced, and maintained; alert supervisor of repair and/or service needed
• Must follow Department of Transportation (DOT), local and state driving laws and regulations
• Load or unload vehicle and ensure all material for each order is correct (quantity and type of material) and that material is free of damage before departure
• May assist in preparing orders for delivery
• Ensure all appropriate documentation is thoroughly completed at the time of delivery, including delivery receipt is signed by the customer, packing list and branch/warehouse manifest
• Pick up material returns from customers; responsible for inspecting the condition of the material and verify quantities and catalog numbers
• Pick up material from company suppliers
• Participate in the training of entry level Truck Drivers and provide mentorship and coaching
• May be required to perform other job functions within a branch when required including but not limited to counter sales and customer support

The information contained in this job description is intended to describe the essential job functions required of those assigned to this job. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, knowledge, skills, and abilities needed to perform the job. Please note that management retains the right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. • Prior warehouse experience a plus

• Must be at least 21 years of age

• Must obtain verification of non-expired medical certificate as required by law within 30 days of hire

• Must not have any at fault accidents in the past 3 years

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Ability to effectively communicate with co-workers and customers
• Ability to handle basic issues and problems
• Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations to accurately complete job tasks
• Ability to organize and prioritize job tasks and requirements
• Excellent organizational and time management skills
• Ability to meet deadlines

jobs.title: Non-Tenure Track, Clinical Assistant Professor, Clinical Psychology (2 positions)
jobs.description:
Augsburg University’s APA-accredited Doctor of Psychology (PsyD) program invites applications for two core faculty positions (non-tenure track) to begin in August 2027. Our program trains students using a broad, generalist, practitioner-scholar model. Multicultural training is core to our program and is woven throughout our curriculum and practicum training experiences. Further, our program is dedicated to the values of responsibility, relationship, and rigor. Through these values, we cultivate a vocation that benefits society, promotes well-being, and advances justice. This full-time, in-person program offers small class sizes and a cohesive, egalitarian faculty that holds a wide variety of theoretical orientations and applied research interests.

Preferred candidates will be committed to teaching and mentoring in clinical psychology at the graduate level. Responsibilities for this full-time position (11-month appointment) will include teaching, academic advising, supervision of student research, and service to the university. Preferred candidates will also have competence in applied research within the field of clinical psychology. Classes are offered on weekdays, with occasional evening classes. This position will allow the individual to integrate their unique knowledge, skills, and experiences within a program that emphasizes the role of context and multiculturalism in clinical psychology.

All faculty are afforded time for professional practice or scholarship. This time for professional activity aligns with our commitment to integrate clinical practice and/or research with teaching.

Minimum Qualifications

• PhD or PsyD in clinical psychology or a related field by the time the position begins.
• Competence in applied and/or translational research in psychology

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience teaching in higher education (particularly graduate education)
• Experience mentoring doctoral students in clinical work and/or research endeavors
• Licensed as a psychologist in Minnesota, or a commitment to complete licensure in Minnesota within the first two years of employment.

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $77,000 - $82,000, annually, depending on hiring rank and qualifications.

Augsburg University offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits program, including:

• Medical, dental and vision insurance coverage. Medical plans include Kavira direct care, which provides free or low-cost virtual and in-home primary care appointments and labs
• A generous 403(b) retirement program with an employer contribution of up to 8% upon eligibility
• Up to 100% tuition remission for employees, spouses and dependents, and participation in the Tuition Exchange program with colleges and universities throughout the US
• Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance
• Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for all employees
• Paid parental leave

Application Instructions and Requirements

Initial review of application materials will begin on October 26th, 2026, and will continue until the position is filled.

To apply for this position, please upload the following documents:

• Cover letter: please address how you meet the minimum and preferred qualifications above
• A statement on your philosophy of teaching
• Curriculum Vitae
• Copies of undergraduate and graduate transcripts. Official transcripts are required at time of hire.

As part of the online application process, candidates are asked to provide the name, email address, and nature of professional relationship for three professional references. One of the references must be able to address your teaching or teaching potential. If your application advances in this search, you will be notified prior to Augsburg contacting your references.

If you have questions regarding the position, please contact: Dr. Christopher Anders at anders@augsburg.edu.

Augsburg University is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity, race, age, disability, religion, national origin, color, or any other protected class.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete our application process, please contact our Human Resources Department at phone number: 612-330-1058 or email: hr@augsburg.edu.

jobs.description:
Ready to be a change agent? As a Mechanical/Project Engineer at Fiberon, you will bridge the gap between technical design and project execution to drive continuous improvement in the production of our industry-leading composite decking. Joining our dynamic Meridian Maintenance Team, where you will serve as both a technical expert and a project leader, focusing on Capital Projects, Safety Engineering, Continuous Improvement, Cost Reduction, Material Utilization and R&D Collaboration.

In this role, you will be responsible for leading and managing the execution of new product development projects from ideation to commercialization. You will develop project plans to ensure projects are completed within scope, on time, and within budget, balancing hands-on troubleshooting and mechanical optimization with the end-to-end management of cutting-edge technology deployments. Come work for an organization that values your contributions and empowers its associates to innovate.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

Project Management & Execution

• Capital Projects: Own the entire lifecycle of engineering and capital projects from initial scoping and budgeting through to final execution and commissioning.
• Project Reporting: Analyze operational data, interpret technical trends, and provide timely milestones, risk assessments, and financial updates to stakeholders.
• Vendor & Cross-Functional Leadership: Coordinate with equipment vendors, contractors, and internal R&D teams to keep projects on time and within budget.

⁠Process Optimization & Mechanical Design

• Process Optimization: Optimize current production processes and identify emerging technologies for future implementation.
• Mechanical Design: Develop mechanical designs and define project and equipment requirements using 2D and solid modeling CAD tools.
• Equipment Management: Evaluate, test, and modify legacy and new equipment to maximize safety, reliability, and operational efficiency.

Operational Excellence & Safety

• Product Launches: Ensure successful evaluation, testing, validation, and launch of new materials, processes, and products.
• Safety Advocacy: Actively support and advance health and safety practices across all business operations, ensuring all new project installations meet rigorous safety guidelines.
• Team Mentorship: Train, develop, and mentor colleagues within your area of technical and project expertise.

Education & Experience:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering.
• Experience: Minimum of 3 to 5 years in a blended mechanical, manufacturing, or project engineering role.
• Environment: Working experience within a technical product production or industrial manufacturing facility.

Technical & Leadership Skills:

• Technical Skills: Proficiency in CAD (2D & Solids); knowledge of Ignition and Allen Bradley PLCs is a strong plus.
• Continuous Improvement: Demonstrated application of CI methodologies, root cause analysis, FMEA, and RCM.
• Project Management: Proven experience managing engineering projects from scope through to execution, including timeline management and budgeting.

jobs.title: Director, Data Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
The Director, Data & AI - Data Engineering & Platforms is responsible for defining, refining and executing Domino's enterprise data strategy, data platform roadmap, and data engineering operating model. This leader oversees enterprise data platforms, data engineering, enterprise data products, data quality engineering, data base administration, and data operations capabilities that enable trusted, scalable, and secure data across the organization.

This role leads the teams responsible for designing, building, operating, and continuously improving the data foundations that power analytics, reporting, operational systems, predictive AI, and generative AI solutions. Working closely with business and technology stakeholders, the Director ensures Domino's data assets are reliable, discoverable, and ready to support growing enterprise demand for data-driven decision making.

Responsibilities

Strategy & Leadership

• Define and evolve the enterprise data platform, engineering, and operations strategy.
• Develop and manage a multi-year roadmap aligned to business priorities and technology modernization goals.
• Drive a data-as-a-product culture focused on trusted, reusable, and business-aligned data assets.
• Serve as a trusted advisor to senior business and technology leaders on data platform investments and capabilities.
• Establish goals, operating metrics, and performance measures that drive continuous improvement and business value.

Data Engineering & Platforms

• Lead the strategy, architecture, and operation of Domino's enterprise data platforms and engineering capabilities.
• Establish standards for reliability, scalability, performance, security, availability, and cost optimization.
• Lead the design and delivery of scalable batch, streaming, and real-time data solutions.
• Drive engineering best practices across data modeling, software development, testing, CI/CD, automation, and observability.
• Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies that improve engineering productivity, platform capabilities, and operational effectiveness.

Enterprise Data Products

• Own the enterprise data product strategy and roadmap for foundational data assets consumed across the organization.
• Establish standards for data product ownership, lifecycle management, reliability, discoverability, and operational support.
• Partner with analytics, application, and business teams to develop reusable and scalable enterprise data products.
• Enable self-service analytics and data consumption through consistent, trusted, and well-documented data assets.
• Measure success through adoption, quality, reliability, and business impact.

Data Foundations for Analytics & AI

• Ensure enterprise data platforms and data products provide trusted data foundations for analytics, predictive AI, and generative AI solutions.
• Develop and operate feature-serving capabilities that support machine learning and predictive modeling workloads.
• Develop and operate context-serving capabilities that support enterprise knowledge retrieval and generative AI experiences.
• Partner with Data Science, AI Engineering, Architecture, and Analytics teams to support evolving data consumption patterns.
• Drive investments in metadata, lineage, observability, and data quality that improve trust in downstream analytics and AI solutions.

Data Quality & Operations

• Lead the Data Quality Engineering and Data Operations functions.
• Establish enterprise standards for monitoring, validation, reconciliation, issue management, and operational support.
• Drive operational excellence through incident management, root cause analysis, automation, and continuous improvement.
• Define and monitor service levels, operational KPIs, and platform health metrics.
• Partner with business governance, security, compliance, and analytics stakeholders to ensure platforms support approved enterprise policies, business definitions, and regulatory requirements.

People Leadership

• Build, lead, and develop a high-performing organization of managers, engineers, and technical specialists.
• Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and technical excellence.
• Recruit, retain, and develop top talent while creating clear career growth opportunities.
• Manage team budgets, resource allocation, vendor relationships, and strategic investments.
• Promote continuous learning and adoption of modern engineering practices across the organization.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or related field.
• 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, cloud data technologies, or enterprise data management.
• 5+ years of leadership experience managing engineering, platform, or technology teams.
• Proven experience building and operating enterprise-scale data platforms and data products.
• Strong expertise with cloud-based data platforms, modern data architecture patterns, and large-scale distributed data processing.
• Experience leading data quality, operational support, and platform reliability initiatives.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across technical and business audiences.
• Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into scalable technology solutions and roadmaps.

jobs.description:
The RCP Student Technician reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

This position supports the Respiratory Care department and is primarily responsible for basic level respiratory care activities as listed in the Respiratory Care Practice Act. This position applies fundamental concepts, practices and procedures/policies. No one can work in this position for >3 years.

Responsibilities:

• "Basic respiratory care activities" means and includes all of the following activities:Cleaning, disinfecting, and sterilizing equipment used in the practice of respiratory care as delegated by a licensed health care professional or other authorized licensed personnel.Assembling equipment used in the practice of respiratory care as delegated by a licensed health care professional or other authorized licensed personnel.Collecting and reviewing patient data through non-invasive means, provided that the collection and review does not include the individual's interpretation of the clinical significance of the data. Collecting and reviewing patient data includes the performance of pulse oximetry, incentive spirometry and non-invasive monitoring procedures in order to obtain vital signs and notification to licensed health care professionals and other authorized licensed personnel in a timely manner. Maintaining a nasal cannula or face mask for oxygen therapy in the proper position on the patient's face.Assembling a nasal cannula or face mask for oxygen therapy at patient bedside in preparation for use.Maintaining a patient's natural airway by physically manipulating the jaw and neck, suctioning the oral cavity, or suctioning the mouth or nose with a bulb syringe.Performing assisted ventilation during emergency resuscitation using a manual resuscitator.Using a manual resuscitator at the direction of a licensed health care professional or other authorized licensed personnel who is present and performing routine airway suctioning. These activities do not include care of a patient's artificial airway or the adjustment of mechanical ventilator settings while a patient is connected to the ventilator.

Required:

• Basic Life Support (BLS)
• Actively enrolled in an approved school or program for respiratory care.

Preferred:

• Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS)
• Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP)
• Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS)
