jobs.title: Head of Enterprise Regulatory Advisory
jobs.description:
Company Description: 

Elliptic is the leader in digital asset decisioning, we have built the most comprehensive platform for efficiently extracting crypto data and intelligence across blockchains with the greatest accuracy.

Our platform’s unrivalled uptime, scalability, depth and breadth of our data and intelligence means exacting organizations choose Elliptic for their compliance, risk management, intelligence operations and blockchain infrastructure needs.

Founded in 2013, Elliptic is headquartered in London with offices in New York, Washington D.C., Miami, San Francisco, UAE, Singapore, Hong Kong and Tokyo. To learn more, visit www.elliptic.co http://www.elliptic.co and follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/elliptic/ and X https://x.com/elliptic.



The Impact You Will Have

As a Head of Enterprise Regulatory Advisory you will lead Elliptic’s public policy and regulatory engagement strategy across the United States, the most consequential jurisdiction shaping the future of digital assets.

Based in New York, you will be Elliptic’s senior voice on compliance and regulatory affairs across the Americas, guiding our approach to engaging with commercial clients, federal and state regulators, and international standard setters.



You will be one of Elliptic's subject-matter experts on the regulatory forces reshaping the US digital asset market, including the Clarity Act, stablecoin frameworks, FinCEN guidance, SEC and CFTC jurisdiction, and state-level licensing regimes. Just as importantly, you will understand what each of these means for our clients' businesses and for the revenue teams supporting them.

You will engage formally in shaping outcomes through consultations, working group seats, and direct engagement with regulators and industry associations, working closely with (though distinct from) our policy team, and helping craft our regulatory responses.

You will turn that regulatory engagement into commercial and reputational impact. You'll act as the subject-matter expert prospects and customers rely on directly, feed the voice of our ideal customer profile systematically into product and roadmap decisions, and translate our regulatory positions into thought leadership and advocacy, written with Elliptic's mindset and commercial point of view, that builds our brand and credibility across the Americas over time.

In this commercially oriented role, you’ll act as a trusted advisor to existing and prospective clients, helping them navigate regulatory complexity, adopt Elliptic’s solutions with confidence, and meet their compliance objectives.

You will join a global, cross-functional team of regulatory specialists and subject matter experts, working at the forefront of engagement with governments, regulators, financial institutions, and crypto native businesses.

Your leadership will be instrumental in establishing Elliptic as the most trusted advisor for regulated institutions and public agencies seeking to understand and mitigate risks in the digital asset economy.



Key Outcomes

 - Serve as Elliptic's subject-matter expert on US AML/CFT, regulatory, and compliance requirements affecting digital assets, engaging directly with federal and state regulators, industry associations, and working groups.

 - Drive commercial outcomes through direct, hands-on engagement across both pre-sales and post-sales, acting as the regulatory expert who helps convert deals and strengthens existing client relationships, consistent with GPRG's model of converting regulatory authority into commercial impact.Shape and respond to emerging digital asset regulatory frameworks, including stablecoin rules, AML/CFT requirements, and digital asset classification, translating them into practical guidance for clients and prospects.

 - Strengthen Elliptic's regulatory credibility and thought leadership through written advocacy, content, and external representation grounded in compliance and risk expertise, building brand equity and pipeline that compound over time.

 - Advise and empower internal teams, especially product and revenue, with regulatory and compliance insight that drives product development, client success, and commercial strategy.

 - Position Elliptic as the leading compliance and risk technology partner for US financial institutions navigating digital asset regulation.




What You Will Do

 - Provide direct advisory support to prospects and customers across the full commercial lifecycle, from pre-sales deal support through to post-sales onboarding, risk-rule design input, and ongoing regulatory Q&A, acting as the technical credibility behind Elliptic's commercial relationships.

 - Serve as the primary subject matter expert on US AML/CFT, compliance, and digital asset regulation, and on how this regulatory landscape affects our clients and the broader digital asset ecosystem.

 - Develop thought leadership through authoritative content, including regulatory analysis, compliance updates, consultation responses, and industry trend reports, written with Elliptic's mindset and commercial point of view.

 - Work with our Strategic Advisory team to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across federal agencies (FinCEN, SEC, CFTC, OCC, OFAC), state regulators, and industry associations, engaging through formal consultations and working group seats, authoring Policy Position Papers and feeding ICP playbooks that Revenue, Product and Marketing rely on directly.

 - Represent Elliptic at industry conferences, regulatory forums, and working groups, and in direct engagement with regulators and financial services leaders.

 - Collaborate with product teams to feed the voice of our ideal customer profile, informed by regulatory and compliance developments, systematically into roadmap decisions.

 - Maintain a disciplined regulatory learning and horizon-scanning practice, advising on regulatory developments and market trends affecting digital asset compliance and institutional adoption, and giving clients, prospects and internal teams early, actionable notice of what is coming.

 - Support business development and enterprise sales processes with deep AML, compliance, and risk expertise.

 - Contribute to cross-functional initiatives that accelerate responsible adoption of digital asset solutions within financial institutions.

 - Build and maintain your professional profile through speaking engagements, published thought leadership, and industry networking.



What You Will Achieve in the First 6 Months

 - Supported early customer engagements that demonstrate Elliptic’s regulatory expertise and strengthen confidence in our brand, and have been cited as a key expert resource by top prospects and customers.

 - Delivered consistent, high-quality regulatory and compliance intelligence to stakeholders internally and externally.

 - Supported post-sales engagement with at least one existing account, onboarding, risk-rule design input, or ongoing regulatory Q&A, demonstrating commercial value beyond the point of sale.

 - Established Elliptic as a credible and proactive voice in the US regulatory community.

 - Worked with our Strategic Advisory team to build trusted relationships with key regulators (for example FinCEN and Treasury).

 - Contributed visible US thought leadership content (publication, panel, consultation, or testimony) tied to Elliptic’s mission.

 - Embedded the US as a critical influencer within the global Regulatory & Industry Affairs framework.



You Will Be a Great Fit Here If You

 - 10+ years of experience in compliance, licensing, regulatory affairs, working with client facing teams, with a focus on financial services, digital assets, or public sector engagement.

 - Demonstrated experience operating at the intersection of regulatory expertise and commercial delivery supporting deal cycles and pre-sales engagements, advising revenue, product and account teams, and translating regulatory positions into guidance, content and playbooks that shape outcomes across both new business and existing client relationships.

 - Deep understanding of the US digital asset regulatory landscape, including federal frameworks (SEC, CFTC, FinCEN, OCC, OFAC) and key state-level regimes (e.g., NY BitLicense, state MTL frameworks).

 - Experience working within or alongside financial regulators, industry associations, or compliance and risk functions in the digital asset or financial services sector.

 - Strong existing network across US financial regulators (for example FinCEN, SEC, and CFTC), industry associations, and the compliance and AML community.

 - Exceptional communication skills, with experience crafting compliance positions, regulatory briefings, and thought leadership content on complex legal and regulatory topics.

 - Proven record of influencing regulatory outcomes through formal consultations, working group engagement, and collaborative work with regulators and industry associations.

 - Comfort working at the intersection of technology, law, and finance, including the regulatory applications of blockchain analytics and crypto asset compliance.

 - Passion for shaping the future of responsible crypto innovation, financial integrity, and regulatory clarity.

 - Used AI/LLM to conduct research on compliance and risk presentations for internal and external stakeholders, automating tasks and tools. 

 - Understanding of AI policy and the current/future regulation developments including impacts on blockchain data.



Bonus Points For

 - Former experience in a federal regulatory body, or Treasury/FinCEN.

 - Experience with stablecoins and their role in traditional finance and payments.

 - Previous consulting or advisory experience in financial services or government affairs.

 - Technical understanding of blockchain technology and digital asset infrastructure.

 - Experience supporting or building a shared knowledge base, playbook, or enablement resource used directly by sales, account management or product teams.

 - Experience developing and delivering training and knowledge-sharing sessions.

 - Experience working with international standard-setting bodies (FATF, Basel Committee).

 - Advanced degree in law, finance, economics, or related field.

 - Professional qualifications in compliance or related fields (CAMS, CFA, FRM, etc.).

 - Experience in fintech, digital asset advisory, or crypto policy advocacy roles.

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
This is a hybrid position requiring in-office attendance 1 day per week at our Atlanta office. Candidates must reside within a commutable distance to be considered.



As our Solutions Consultant, you will report to the Manager, Professional Services, and own the technical deployment and strategy of Fortune 500 accounts. You will guide the technical and strategic implementation of these accounts, ensuring their architecture produces the cleanest, most actionable behavioral data possible for Fullstory analyses. Collaborating cross-functionally with product, engineering, and support, you will troubleshoot technical issues and translate client needs into actionable solutions. To excel, you must possess a solid foundational understanding of web and native mobile development concepts. This technical baseline will empower you to field live questions during SDK builds, leverage AI to accelerate custom development, and escalate complex issues to engineering effectively. You must be deeply curious and passionate about your learnings.




IN A TYPICAL DAY, YOU MIGHT:

 - Meet with client teams to gather requirements on technical features and address data architecture strategy, ensuring optimal best practices and data cleanliness.

 - Build custom integration implementations using languages like JavaScript and Python, utilizing agentic AI to effectively design, draft, and deploy technical solutions.

 - Advise clients on API implementation and data management best practices, anticipating the questions our product team will ask before the request reaches them.

 - Gather requirements from client stakeholders and translate them for our analytics, product, and engineering teams, so a technical need lands with the team that can solve it.

 - Own your continuous learning and development, independently researching new features and proactively seeking out answers to maintain a comprehensive understanding of the Fullstory product.

 - Leverage AI tooling to rapidly draft, test, and iterate on technical integrations, applying your technical background to validate and refine the output before shipping.




HERE'S WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - Proven experience in a client-facing technical role—whether through consulting, professional services, or an early-career forward-deployed position—where you owned the technical relationship and guided external stakeholders.

 - A background in Computer Science, MIS, or a comparable technical discipline, giving you the architectural understanding to confidently navigate complex technical discussions across web and mobile ecosystems.

 - The ability to seamlessly bridge the gap between business and engineering. You can gather broad requirements from client stakeholders and proactively translate them into the precise technical specifications our product and engineering teams need.

 - Hands-on experience debugging modern web applications. You are highly comfortable diving into browser developer tools to diagnose front-end behavior, inspect network payloads, and resolve complex data architecture and capture issues.

 - Practical experience leveraging AI tooling to accelerate technical workflows and build working solutions, paired with the judgment to critically evaluate, validate, and correct the model’s output.




The base salary for this position ranges from $95,000 - $110,000 USD. This role is also eligible for a discretionary bonus of up to 10% of base salary, contingent upon Fullstory meeting its performance targets.

#LI-BS1


ABOUT FULLSTORY

Fullstory is a leading behavioral data platform transforming how businesses understand and improve their digital experiences. Our technology empowers companies to uncover insights, optimize customer and employee journeys, and deliver exceptional online interactions. It makes every customer experience smoother and more personalized and empowers the employees behind the scenes.

We’re building something special at Fullstory- and we’re looking for teammates who are curious, collaborative, and driven to make an impact. We’re especially excited about the potential of AI to enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and elevate our work. If that resonates, explore our Winning Ways https://www.fullstory.com/about-us/ to see the values that guide how we work and grow together.

How we support you:

Fullstorians are committed to building something better- from how we approach our product, to how we care for our customers and each other. Along these lines, we offer:

 - Flexibility and Connection. We have a vibrant HQ in Atlanta and a tight-knit group in London. Fullstorians in those cities come to the office at least one day a week to build cross-functional relationships and stay connected. We also offer a flexible PTO policy and an annual company-wide closure, along with federal holidays.

 - Benefits. Take care of the whole you. Fullstory offers sponsored benefit packages for US-based Fullstorians, and supplemental coverage options for international Fullstorians.

 - Learning opportunities. We provide professional development opportunities through training programs and an annual learning subsidy for US and EMEA-based employees.

 - Productivity support. US and EMEA-based Fullstorians receive a monthly productivity stipend.

 - Team Collaboration. Connect with fellow Fullstorians through team off-sites and an annual full-company meet-up.

 - Paid parental leave. Fullstorians balance the needs of their growing families without the added stress of figuring out work and finances.

 - Bereavement leave, including miscarriage/pregnancy loss. Take the time to grieve and help your loved ones.

Fullstory is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace dedicated to fostering an increasingly diverse community. We want candidates of all human varieties, backgrounds, and lifestyles. There’s no problem that can’t be made better by bringing together people with a broader set of perspectives. We are looking for a Sales & Operations Development Program Associate to join our Rexel, USA team starting in June of 2027!  This role is available in Indianapolis, IN or Chicago, IL.

Summary:

The Sales and Operations Development Program offers a 12-month Accelerated Commercial Experience (ACE) that provides associates with a fast-tracked opportunity, early in their career, to gain broad exposure within the Electrical Distribution industry. This rotational program provides hands-on exposure to the people, products, customers, and operations that power Rexel’s business. Through meaningful assignments, cross-functional projects, structured training, and mentorship, ACE Trainees develop the commercial, operational, and leadership skills needed to make an impact from day one. Participants gain broad experience across the business while exploring career paths aligned with their strengths and interests. Upon successful completion of the program, ACE Trainees may pursue opportunities in sales, operations, project management, procurement, marketing, future leadership, and other key areas of the organization.

What You'll Do:

As an ACE Trainee, you will complete a series of rotations designed to build your business knowledge, professional capabilities, and understanding of the electrical distribution industry. You will work alongside experienced Rexel leaders and team members, contribute to real business priorities, and develop relationships across functions

Rotations Include:

• Warehouse & Logistics: Learn the full-cycle supply chain processes behind storing and moving materials, including order fulfillment, receiving, stocking, staging, and shipping
• Sales: Gain experience in counter, inside, and outside sales. Build customer service, product knowledge, selling, and digital tool skills
• Operations: Understand the business drivers that influence safety, profitability, facility maintenance, inventory, working capital, and customer service. Use available data and tools to support sound business decisions
• Project Management: Manage customer, sales, and vendor relationships; place orders; track shipments; coordinate billing; and maintain clear, timely communication throughout the project. Learn to review bid packages and prepare project quotations

Elective Rotations:

Toward the end of the program, ACE Trainees can tailor their experience through elective rotations based on individual interests, career goals, and local business opportunities. Elective opportunities may include:

• Returning to a previous rotation for deeper experience.
• Product Specialist rotations in areas such as Automation, Lighting, Gear, Datacom, or Services.
• A customized rotation developed with local leadership

• Program Orientation (Dallas HQ)

Challenging convention, we bridge the gap between meaningful storytelling, data-led optimization and commerce. About Media Strategy

The Media Strategy department is the strategic heart of Monks' media offering: a unified team bringing together deep expertise in media strategy, media planning, and account management. We build integrated, full-funnel media strategies that connect brand storytelling to measurable business outcomes, powered by AI-enabled workflows and analytical rigor.

About the Role

The Associate Director, Media Strategy leads key strategy and planning workstreams on one of Monks' most important client relationships: owning deliverables end to end and serving as a trusted day-to-day client contact. This requires:

• Strong ability to build client and platform relationships

• A track record of managing and growing account workstreams

• Ability to tell data-driven stories and extract key insights for senior-level clients

• Full-funnel understanding of the media landscape across Social, Search, Programmatic/Digital Investment, Holistic Video, OOH, and Direct Partnerships.

• Experience managing and stewarding career growth for direct reports

Responsibilities:

• Serve as a lead day-to-day point of contact with media client stakeholders.

• Develop go-to-market strategies and integrated, full-funnel media plans informed by rich consumer and industry insights with a laser focus on outcomes.

• Lead briefings, brainstorms, presentations and reporting calls to represent and support the team.

• Prepare executive-level deliverables on performance, strategic POVs and competitive analysis.

• Analyze data, craft insights and make recommendations internally and externally in deck form.

• Use AI-enabled tools to accelerate research, insight generation, plan development and reporting.

• Maintain executional and performance excellence through ongoing collaboration with Activation, Investment and Data & Measurement teams.

• Establish relationships with platform partners to stay current on offerings and maximize media value.

• Track and manage the client scorecard to ensure the team is set up to hit performance goals.

• Lead and manage 1–3 direct reports; regularly meet to establish priorities and offer guidance and feedback.

About You

The essentials:

• 7+ years of industry experience focused on media strategy, planning and client service.

• Eager to forge long-term client partnerships built on mutual trust and fueled by ongoing performance.

• Proficient in media strategy with experience across digital direct, programmatic, social and search plus fluency in brand and offline channels.

• Ability to craft compelling, data-driven narratives for client deliverables.

• Experienced with syndicated planning and competitive insight tools (e.g., Comscore, GWI, Pathmatics, Nielsen).

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

A Senior Infrastructure Solutions Engineer makes Planet's infrastructure easier to use. Infra Solutions is a small, multi-disciplinary team: engineers who are as comfortable operating a system as building one, and as comfortable in a hard conversation as in a code review. We sit between the teams who build Planet's platform capabilities and the teams who need them, and our market is every engineering team at Planet, which we earn one engagement at a time. Teams work with us because we make their week lighter, not because anyone told them to, and every team that lands on the platform is infrastructure Planet no longer has to duplicate, secure and pay for.

Most of what you do takes the shape of a hands-on engagement with a team that is blocked, mid-migration, or arriving on the platform for the first time. They usually arrive with a proposed solution rather than the problem behind it, and working out the difference is where the engagement starts. From there you own it end to end: the diagnosis, the hands-on fix, the argument for what should change upstream, and the durable artifact that stops the next team hitting the same wall. This is a role driven by unreasonable hospitality (value out of proportion to what anyone asked us for) and backed by solid engineering and operator depth. You have run things in production, and you write the code other engineers depend on. The ideal candidate is energized by other teams' success: someone who would rather ship the thing that makes ten teams faster than own a system outright, and who does their best work in a room they don't own, with people who are not yet convinced they need help.

This is a full-time, remote position based in Germany, the Netherlands or Slovenia. If located near a Planet office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

• Lead end-to-end technical engagements: Partner directly with engineering teams to diagnose, unblock, and resolve complex infrastructure challenges.

• Execute critical migrations: Develop reference implementations, tooling, and guidance to transition teams off deprecated systems seamlessly.

• Accelerate platform adoption: Act as the primary technical contact for new teams onboarding to Planet’s core infrastructure.

• Establish standardized paths: Consolidate disparate solutions into well-supported, paved-road infrastructure offerings.

• Build scalable, shared artifacts: Design re-usable libraries, Terraform modules, and Helm charts to solve recurring technical patterns across teams.

• Enhance platform observability: Implement instrumentation and attribution tooling to provide visibility into infrastructure cost, usage, and adoption.

• Inform platform strategy: Synthesize engineering feedback and common pain points to influence the broader infrastructure roadmap.

What You Bring:

• 6+ years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering, including experience leading at least one cross-team project or migration.

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.

• Background in technical enablement, developer experience, or solutions architecture with a focus on internal developer productivity.

• Hands-on experience operating and maintaining production infrastructure environments.

• Deep expertise with Kubernetes orchestration, including workload optimization and operations.

• Working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or other public cloud providers, including its compute, storage, quota, and capacity mode.

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD) and CI/CD pipelines.

• Proficiency in software development using Go or Python.

• Ability to translate ambiguous requirements into structured, actionable engineering tasks.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and cross-functional collaboration.

What Makes You Stand Out:

• Experience with large-scale block storage (Persistent Disk, Hyperdisk, Ceph, SAN, or equivalent) operated at fleet scale rather than per-service.

• Experience driving large-scale migrations or deprecations that required buy-in from teams outside your reporting line.

• Experience in a consulting-adjacent engineering role (solutions architecture, professional services, or technical account engineering) applied to an internal platform.

• Familiarity with workflow orchestration (e.g. Temporal), batch and job-execution systems, or large-scale data processing pipelines.

• Experience defining and measuring platform adoption: developer-productivity instrumentation, NPS, or internal marketshare.

Application Deadline:

11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.

Why we care so much about Belonging.
We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.  If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!  At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.  We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.  We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride.

LifeStance is a multidisciplinary group composed of psychiatrists, nurse practitioners, therapists, and neuropsychologists. jobs.title: VP of Pharmacy Operations
jobs.description:
VP OF PHARMACY OPERATIONS

Location: Hebron, KY (On-site with up to 10% travel)

Position Type: Full-Time




ROLE SUMMARY

The Director of Pharmacy leads and oversees multi-site pharmacy operations, driving clinical excellence, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency. Headquartered in Hebron, KY, this executive leadership role directly manages local operations while exercising operational oversight over remote closed-door and mail-order facility sites in Ohio and Arizona.

The ideal candidate brings extensive expertise in closed-door pharmacy workflows, mail-order operations, and collaborative manufacturer/patient hub services.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Multi-Site Leadership: Direct operational oversight of the primary Hebron, KY facility alongside remote supervision of sites in Ohio and Arizona.

 - Mail-Order & Closed-Door Operations: Optimize order fulfillment, dispensing accuracy, inventory management, and logistics tailored to closed-door and mail-service environments.

 - Hub & Client Operations: Partner closely with manufacturer hub programs, patient support services, and third-party logistics (3PL) partners to streamline benefit investigation, prior authorizations, and patient onboarding.

 - Compliance & Partner Collaboration: Collaborate directly with local Pharmacists-in-Charge (PICs) and Quality Assurance teams to ensure operational workflows strictly comply with Board of Pharmacy, FDA, and DEA regulations.

 - KPI & Financial Management: Direct operational budgets, labor planning, carrier cost controls, and fulfillment metrics (units per hour, cost per shipment, accuracy rates).  Utilize data-driven insights to establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), continuous improvement programs, and error-prevention protocols across all facilities.

 - Travel Requirement: Quarterly to inspect remote operations in Ohio and Arizona, build team alignment, and meet key hub/client stakeholders.




QUALIFICATIONS



Education:

 - Track 1 (Pharmacy): Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) or Bachelor of Pharmacy (RPh) from an accredited institution.

 - Track 2 (Operations/Supply Chain): Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field. Candidates possessing either qualification track are eligible.

Experience

 - 7+ years of experience in high-volume warehouse management, distribution, 3PL, or mail-order operations, with 3+ years in multi-site operational leadership.

 -  Experience in healthcare is preferred.

Domain Knowledge

 - Experience in closed-door distribution, pharma/healthcare logistics, regulated supply chain, or collaborative hub models is preferred.

 -  The ideal candidate understands matrixed organizational structures, strict regulatory environments, and high-throughput fulfillment.

Technical Skills

 - Expertise with WMS/ERP platforms, fulfillment automation, labor optimization tools, and carrier management systems.

 - Strong proficiency in data analysis, reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Tableau, or WMS-native dashboards), and the ability to leverage metrics to drive strategic operational decisions.




BENEFITS

 - Ground floor opportunity with one of the fastest-growing startups in health-tech

 - Hybrid working environment

 - Competitive compensation (commensurate with experience)

 - Full benefits (medical, dental, vision).

 - 401(k) contribution opportunity.

Phil Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer.

We support our patients by ensuring they have the power to choose a caregiver who will care for them in the comfort of their own homes. Our mission spans coast to coast, supporting patients across the U.S.

We pride ourselves on our values which drive the level of care that we deliver to our patients:

• Here For You (An attitude of service, empathy, and availability)

• Own It (Drive and ownership)

• Do the Right Thing (High integrity)

• Be Positive (Great attitude and a can-do positive approach to challenges

Join our team and make a positive impact on the lives of others! We are looking for an LPN for our team in Missouri.

This is a field-based position that requires frequent travel to patient's homes in the Greater St. Louis, MO area.

Department & Position Overview:

FreedomCare’s Missouri operations support In-Home Services (IHS), a Medicaid home and community-based services model that allows eligible participants to receive in-home assistance to help them live independently.

The Care Manager, LPN is responsible for conducting initial in-home assessments, annual home visits, and providing ongoing care management and support. This role combines clinical assessment, care coordination, patient and caregiver education, and quality assurance to ensure safe, effective, and person-centered care.

The Care Manager, LPN collaborates closely with patients, caregivers, and interdisciplinary care teams to assess needs, identify potential changes to the individualized plans of care, and facilitate the seamless initiation and delivery of services. Through regularly scheduled home visits, the LPN evaluates patient and caregiver well-being, monitors the quality and effectiveness of care, and identifies opportunities to enhance health outcomes, safety, and regulatory compliance. The Care Manager, LPN proactively communicates clinical concerns, changes in condition, and potential barriers to care with the appropriate team members to ensure timely intervention, effective care coordination, and optimal patient outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct initial in-person clinical assessments and coordinate timely service activation, ensuring all required documentation, approvals, and standard procedures are completed.

• Identify potential changes to the individualized plans of care, making and documenting revisions as the patient’s needs or condition change.

• Educate patients, caregivers, and internal teams regarding care needs, safety considerations, service requirements, caregiver responsibilities, and next steps.

• Coordinate patient care through timely communication and documentation with physicians, clinical disciplines, internal partners, and appropriate community resources.

• Provide ongoing education and coaching to support effective use of established best practices, promote caregiver competency, and connect patients and families with appropriate resources.

• Review participant service records regularly and respond appropriately to identified changes in the patient’s condition, environment, or service needs.

• Identify changes in condition, safety concerns, service gaps, incidents, or other urgent issues and escalate them in accordance with established clinical protocols.

• Complete and document assessments, visits, clinical observations, care-plan updates, incidents, communications, and follow-up actions accurately, thoroughly, and within required timeframes.

• Support authorization, renewal, start-of-care, and continued-service processes, as applicable.

• Maintain compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements, professional standards, and company policies and procedures.

• Perform other related duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Credentials:

• Diploma from an accredited nursing program.

• Valid Licensed Practical Nurse license and in good standing by Missouri Board of Nursing

• Minimum of (1) year of experience with the care of the elderly, or individuals with disabilities or medically complex conditions.

jobs.title: Security Analyst - Tier 3 (West Coast)
jobs.description:
ABOUT 7AI

7AI is the foundational AI security company. Founded in 2024 by Cybereason co-founders Lior Div and Yonatan Striem-Amit, we came out of stealth in February 2025 to take on the non-human work of the SOC. Our platform pairs a federated SIEM with AI agents that detect, investigate, respond, and hunt, plus dedicated threat hunting and threat intelligence, with humans on the loop.

Backed by $166 million in total funding from investors including Index Ventures and Blackstone, we're building the AI foundation for security operations in the agentic era, and we're still early. That's the appeal: you'll join at a pivotal stage where your work shapes what 7AI becomes, alongside security veterans who've built this before. Our culture runs on respect, collaboration, and a shared bar for excellence, all pointed at one goal, delivering real outcomes for the customers who trust us to defend them.




OVERVIEW

7AI's AI agents take on a lot of the SOC's non-human work, but scaling that trust requires senior analysts who can validate the hardest cases and mentor the team doing it. As a Tier 3 Security Analyst, you'll be the technical lead and escalation point for junior analysts reviewing 7AI's AI agent investigations. You'll validate the agents' work, prove out the threats they stopped, and help customers understand the risk that was prevented. You'll also hunt for malicious activity in customer environments using 7AI's agents, and help build the processes that let this team scale without losing quality.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Review and validate the AI agents' investigations for accuracy and completeness, assessing risk

 - Serve as the technical escalation point for junior analysts and mentor them

 - Correlate data across cloud, endpoint, identity, and network sources to build the full picture of an attack

 - Investigate malicious activity the AI agents responded to, and assess the risk that was prevented for customers

 - Use 7AI's AI agents to hunt for emerging threats in customer environments, feeding new detections back into the product

 - Support customers with ongoing threat monitoring, triage, and alert prioritization, especially during active incidents

 - Proactively review logs and findings to catch potential threats and anomalies early

 - Communicate clearly with customers across technical levels, from SOC analysts to CISOs

 - Help design processes that let the team scale while keeping quality consistent

 - Work with Sales, Engineering, and Product to share customer feedback and help tune the platform

 - Stay current on emerging attack techniques and trends, including AI-driven attacks
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of experience in security operations

 - Hands-on experience investigating alerts across endpoint, network, identity, email, and cloud sources

 - Strong understanding of security monitoring tools such as XDR, SIEM, IDS/IPS, and IDP

 - Familiarity with log and telemetry concepts

 - Strong knowledge of common attack techniques and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, and incident triage methodologies

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to verify AI-driven analysis and make independent security decisions

 - Data querying experience with SIEM query languages such as SPL, KQL, FQL, or SQL

 - Strong knowledge of malware analysis methods

 - Strong interpersonal skills and a service-oriented mindset

 - A track record of collaborating well on a team, including mentoring others and teaching complex concepts
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in a managed services environment

 - Incident handling experience

 - Relevant certifications such as Security+, GSEC, or GCIH

jobs.title: Clinical Trial Associate I
jobs.description:
POSITION TITLE: Clinical Trial Associate I

DEPARTMENT: Ora Europe

*1 Year Fixed Contract Term*

Ora Values the Daily Practice of …

Prioritizing Kindness * Operational Excellence * Cultivating Joy * Scientific Rigor

At Ora, we are building the future of ophthalmic clinical research. As the world’s leading full-service ophthalmic drug and device development firm, we guide our clients across all phases of clinical research to efficiently bring new products and therapies to market. Over the past 45 years, our expert teams have helped earn more than 85 new product approvals. Ora's pre-clinical and clinical models, unique methodologies, integrated clinical data solutions, and global regulatory strategies have been refined and proven across thousands of global projects. Today, our team continues to expand across the globe, with over 400 employees across North America, Europe, Asia, and Latin America.

The Role:

Ora’s Clinical Trial Associate I (CTA I) assists Project Managers and study teams in clinical study conduct for clinical ophthalmic projects. They support the oversight feasibility including but not limited to, working with sites to generate contracts and budgets, collecting regulatory documents, and may be involved in scheduling follow up patient visits of all clinical sites and ensures compliance with (GCP) protocol along with overall clinical objectives. Ora’s CTA I’s participate in all phases of clinical studies including start up, study maintenance, and close-out activities.

What You’ll Do:

• Ensure study documentation, communication, training and data collection is aligned with study protocol adherence, and all applicable SOPs, regulations and guidelines

• Drafts and/or reviews study-related documents and templates including study protocols, informed consents, source document templates, study plans, study related logs, etc.

• Participate in study start-up (including Investigator Meeting), study maintenance and study closeout activities.

• Collect and review site regulatory documents for accuracy and completion (e.g., 1572, Financial Disclosure documents, CLIA waivers, etc.).

• Prepare, with oversight, essential documents package to support investigational product release for study and site approval.

• Create regulatory packages for IRB/IEC submission for study and site initial submission as well as applicable study and site continuity report submissions and close-out submissions.

• Assemble and distribute regulatory binders to clinical sites.

• Order and ship study-related supplies to clinical sites.

• Create Site Payments, obtain approval and submit to Accounting.

• Support Clinical Research Associates during monitoring visits to help ensure that any missing documents are filed within the eTMF and the site binder.

• Support project management activities including but not limited to drafting meeting agendas/minutes, drafting communication, and maintaining CTMS and the study tracker(s).

• Assist project managers in preparing study metric reports and collecting site status updates.

• Set-up and maintain the Trial Master File / electronic Trial Master File, and using applicable filesharing platforms (i.e., Z:drive, box.com) for clinical projects.

• Address Quality Control findings resulting from internal and external Trial Master File audits.

• Participate in Study Operations planning, Risk Assessment discussions and Pre-Study Meetings.

• Provide support to Clinical Operations for implementing process improvement actions, remaining current on all relative and applicable SOPs, and participating in departmental training sessions.

• Assist with audit preparations (i.e., Sponsor, IRB/IEC, FDA).

• Travel Requirements: up to 10%

• Adhere to all aspects of Ora’s quality system.

• Adhere to all essential systems and processes that are required at Ora to maintain compliance to Ora’s data integrity & business ethics and regulatory requirements.

• Clear and sustained demonstration of Ora’s values -- prioritizing kindness, operational excellence, cultivating joy and scientific rigor – as well as their linked behaviors.

• Responsibilities may differ from the above based on the specific needs of the business.

What We Look For:

• Experience needed for the Role: Bachelor’s Degree with a minimum of 1-year experience of research, including course work. Years of experience may be considered in lieu of education.

• Additional Skills & Attributes: 1 year of clinical trial experience is strongly preferred. Ophthalmic experience Ability to work in a semi-virtual, cross-functional team environment. Ability to apply analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to act with a consistent sense of urgency and acute attention to detail. Knowledge of GCP/ICH regulations. Experience maintaining electronic trial master files. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Committed to consistently producing high-quality work. Exceptional organizational and time management skills in order to manage multiple trials, critical tasks, and departmental process improvement efforts. Multilingual communication is a plus.

• Competencies and Personal Traits: What We Do: Execution Excellence: Ability to set goals, create structure and maintain a focused and collaborative approach to the delivery of timely and high-quality work. How We Do It: IQ, EQ and SQ: Agile and positive thinker, communicator and collaborator who uses a growth mindset to work and lead with authenticity, transparency, resilience, and empathy. Scientific, intellectual, and emotional/social curiosity creates the willingness and ability to innovate, make mistakes, learn and try again. Clear and Direct Communication, Feedback and Conflict Resolution: Practice radical candor in your communication and participate in active Giving and receiving feedback frequently, with an open heart and mind creates psychological safety and promotes faster, individual, team and company growth. Why We Do It: Seek Meaning and Purpose and a Desire to be Part of Something Bigger than Yourself: Crave being part of a team that works together under shared values to achieve significant positive impact in the wider world. At Ora, we are creating vision beyond what we see.

Our mission is to weave together people, processes, and technology to support innovation in ophthalmology around the world. We believe our business should be a force for good — to improve, heal, and change how we see. As a global company, our vibrant community and culture are nurtured by our core values: Prioritizing kindness, cultivating joy, operational excellence, and scientific rigor. Through our commitment to these values, we have built an inclusive and supportive work environment that fosters respect, accountability, and a fulfilling work-life balance for every team member.

We know a diverse workforce adds to our collective value and strength as an organization. People of color, the LGBTQIA+ community, disabled candidates and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Ora is proud to be an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to equal employment opportunity and fair, equitable compensation regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

• Implement company procedures and reporting activities.
• Develop and implement new store policies and strategies.
• Work towards long-term Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and business goals.
• Give feedback to the Buying team.
• Lead the store's Visual Merchandising and upkeep.
• Develop efficient workflows.
• Manage in-store events.
• Participate in and contribute to TOTEME's social and environmental sustainability strategy.

Your Profile

• A strong team leader with at least five years of experience in store management within luxury retail.
• Experience with leading a team.
• Experience working in an omnichannel environment.
• Experience with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems.
• Experience with back-office operations management.
• Experience generating reports and guidelines.
• Fluent in spoken and written English.

About You

• A strong leader with an interest in people and their development.
• Self-motivated, solution-oriented and hands-on.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask and work under pressure.
• Business and results-oriented with a strong commercial drive.
• Customer-focused with the ability to build lasting relationships.
• A strong visual eye and attention to detail.
• Passionate about TOTEME with an understanding of the brand and aesthetic.
• Available to work a flexible schedule, including evenings and weekends.

This is a full-time position based at TOTEME's new store in Dallas, starting as soon as possible.

TOTEME has teams in Stockholm, London, New York, and Shanghai, as well as retail spaces across Europe, North America, and Asia.

jobs.title: Manager, Content Strategy & AI Visibility
jobs.description:
Renesas is seeking a Manager, Content Strategy & AI Visibility to lead how our products, technologies, and solutions are planned, structured, and surfaced across every place customers look for answers, including Renesas.com, partner and distribution ecosystems, AI-powered answer engines, and traditional search. As AI increasingly influences how engineers research, evaluate, and select semiconductor solutions, this role will ensure Renesas content is comprehensive, authoritative, and optimized to be discovered, understood, cited, and trusted wherever customers seek information.

This is both a strategic and people-leadership role. You will define and execute Renesas' global content strategy across web experiences, product content, blogs, videos, and other digital channels, ensuring customers can easily access the information they need throughout their journey. You will establish the vision, roadmap, governance model, and content standards that improve content quality, consistency, discoverability, and business impact across the Renesas global digital ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines expertise in content strategy, SEO/GEO, content operations, and digital experience optimization. You understand that visibility is no longer defined solely by rankings and blue links, but by how effectively content is structured, connected, and surfaced across search engines, AI systems, partner ecosystems, and customer touchpoints.

Key Responsibilities

· AI visibility & discoverability strategy: Own the GEO and SEO strategy and roadmap, positioning Renesas as an authoritative, trusted source across AI-driven and traditional search experiences. Drive answer-first content architecture, entity optimization, and structured data initiatives that increase discoverability, strengthen authority signals, and ensure content can be accurately surfaced, cited, and trusted by search engines and AI systems.

· Content strategy: Define and evolve Renesas content strategy across product, technical, and marketing content, ensuring the information customers need is available throughout the buying and design journey. Establish content priorities, identify gaps, guide editorial roadmaps, and align content investments with business objectives, customer needs, and market opportunities.

· Content operations & governance: Establish scalable content intake, review, and governance processes that ensure content requirements, metadata, taxonomy, SEO/GEO considerations, and supporting assets are complete before work is handed off to web production and development teams. Drive consistency, quality, and operational efficiency across the content lifecycle.

· Team leadership: Lead and develop a team of content strategists responsible for content planning, governance, intake processes, and optimization initiatives. Establish priorities, drive execution, and foster a customer-centric, data-driven approach to content excellence.

· Information architecture & taxonomy: Define and evolve content architecture, taxonomy, metadata standards, and organizational frameworks that improve findability, scalability, consistency, and discoverability across web, search, AI, and partner ecosystems.

· Onsite search: Partner with the product team that owns onsite search to drive the content strategy behind it, monitoring onsite search behavior, identifying gaps, and maintaining the database of synonyms and rules to continually improve onsite SERP relevance and performance.

· Technical GEO/SEO: Work hand-in-hand with the product and development teams to implement and monitor technical GEO/SEO, establishing ongoing monitoring to catch issues early.

· Best practices & enablement: Serve as the internal authority on GEO and SEO best practices, educating marketers and both technical and non-technical stakeholders so new site features and content adhere to machine-readable, citation-worthy standards.

· Agency management: Manage our China search agency and other content, SEO, and digital experience partners, holding them accountable to clear goals, regional best practices, and measurable outcomes.

· Measurement & insights: Define the metrics that matter across content performance, customer engagement, discoverability, and AI visibility. Establish reporting frameworks that demonstrate business impact, identify optimization opportunities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.

· Market awareness: Monitor platform changes, competitive activity, emerging tools, and shifts in search behavior to recommend strategic adjustments, bringing an experimentation mindset that tests new approaches and doubles down on what works.

· Cross-functional partnership: Act as the connective tissue across content, web, engineering, product, and executive stakeholders to communicate priorities, create shared touchpoints, and drive execution.

· 7+ years of experience in content strategy, SEO, AI-driven discovery, digital experience, content operations, or related disciplines, including experience leading teams and cross-functional initiatives.

· Expertise in how LLMs and answer engines discover, evaluate, and cite content, and how AI-powered search is changing brand visibility and content performance.

· Experience developing and scaling content programs across web, product, technical, and marketing channels, including editorial planning, content standards, and quality management.

· Experience establishing content intake processes, governance models, and workflows that enable efficient content operations at scale.

· Experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders and driving alignment across marketing, product, engineering, and web teams.

· Familiarity with onsite search and relevance tuning, monitoring search behavior, and maintaining synonyms and rules.

· Working knowledge of technical SEO: structured data, schema markup, crawl efficiency, and site architecture at scale.

· Strong analytical skills and the ability to transform data into compelling stories that drive informed business decisions.

· Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, engineering, data science, communications, or related field.

· Experience in the semiconductor industry is a plus.

Dallas TX and San Jose CA are other locations for consideration.

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. The person we seek for this position will have a passion for positive customer experiences. The right candidate will be a champion to ensure tasks are performed and meet our quality standards and meet the needs of the customer.

Key Responsibilities:

• Understanding our client’s business needs and continually strive to meet these needs.

• Support customer request for assistance and solutions through requests escalated from our Tier 1 Call Center.

• Keep information updated up to date in the ITSM for customer support requests, and once completed, update the ITSM to show resolution.

• Visiting DOJ offices to assess and resolve A/V equipment and/or operational issues.

• Visit DOJ sites/conference rooms every two weeks to validate A/V equipment is operational and mitigate found problems before an incident is reported, to ensure A/V equipment is clean and organized, and to ensure necessary peripherals are present and ready (ie, wireless mice and microphones).

• Field customer’s input on the systems and pass that input onto the Government’s A/V points of contact (POCs).

• Aid the Government’s A/V POCs in the design of new A/V systems and/or enhancements to existing systems.

• Consistently strive to provide services that align with contractual SLAs.

• Support SOP development and update, creation of brochures, quick help guides, best practice tips, how-to guides, knowledge articles, and other publication sources that provide guidelines on use and processes.

Required Qualifications

• A minimum of 2 years of experience supporting customer’s A/V operations, including conference rooms and being responsive to customer support needs.

• At least 2 years of hands-on AV experience with Crestron and/or Extron A/V equipment, Polycom, Cisco, and/or LifeSize VTC equipment.

• Ability to effectively communicate with all levels of the project team, and with Exec Leadership.

• Capable of regularly lifting/moving up to 25 pounds, and occasionally up to 50 pounds, as well as work within tight spaces.

• Ability to hold/maintain an active Secret clearance – an existing clearance is preferred, will also consider a candidate who does not hold but is confident they can obtain.

• Associate’s degree in IT or related field

• Certifications requirements are – CTS (Certified Technology Specialist) and DM-NVX-N (Crestron DigitalMedia Networking Certification) – have certs coming in or commit to obtaining within 60 days of hire.

• Added nice to hold certifications are – CCSP (Certified Customer Service Professional) and/or CTS-I (Certified Technology Specialist (Installation)).

Desired Qualifications

• Experience working for a Systems Integrator, VAR, or government contractor.

• Strong technical and consultative skills

• Relevant experience in key competitor technology offerings to drive business outcomes

• OEM Certification such as: HPE Professional, Cisco Certified Specialist or Dell Sales Portfolio certifications are a plus

Compensation: $31.10 - $64.76

About Us

IntelliDyne, LLC empowers government organizations through the delivery of quality, mission-aligned services and innovative, people-first IT solutions. IntelliDyne has earned the designation of a Top Workplace by providing an inclusive and supportive environment where employees have a voice and are challenged to provide innovative solutions to our clients of national, state, and local importance.

jobs.title: Residential Maintenance Technician | Park Van Ness
jobs.description:

Apply today to join our dynamic team!

jobs.title: Flight Operations Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Flight Operations Manager to coordinate J.S. Held's enterprise drone program. This role will help establish a scalable and well-governed operating environment by improving visibility into the fleet, supporting pilot and regulatory requirements, administering technology and vendor relationships, and enabling consistent billing and reporting practices.

The ideal candidate combines strong program-management and operational skills with practical knowledge of commercial drone operations. This role partners across Practices, Operations, Finance, Legal, Information Technology, and the firm’s pilot community. It provides enterprise coordination and does not have direct report pilots.

Job Responsibilities

Program Management and Governance

• Coordinate the enterprise drone program and maintain visibility into drone assets, pilots, certifications, utilization, and flight activity.
• Develop and maintain SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), training, practical policies, procedures, records, and controls that support consistent operations across the firm.
• Track program performance and provide concise reporting on utilization, compliance, billing, risks, and implementation progress.
• Entrepreneurial mindset towards continued refinement of Fleet Management and new revenue opportunities.

Fleet Operations and Compliance

• Coordinate drone inventory, registration, assignment, maintenance, insurance, and retirement activities.
• Monitor applicable FAA requirements, pilot credentials, renewals, authorizations, and recordkeeping obligations; escalate specialized matters to the appropriate internal or external experts.
• Support risk assessments, incident reporting, corrective actions, and periodic compliance reviews.

Billing and Business Support

• Partner with Finance and practice operations to establish consistent and transparent drone billing and documentation practices.
• Help connect flight activity to the appropriate project or engagement and maintain records needed for invoicing, audit, and client questions.
• Monitor billing adoption and exceptions and report on drone activity, billings, recoveries, costs, and program economics.

Technology and Vendor Management

• Lead requirements definition, RFP support, evaluation, and implementation of a drone fleet-management platform, subject to the firm’s approval and investment governance processes.
• Administer the selected platform, including data standards, user access, workflow design, data quality, vendor performance, and enhancement priorities.
• Coordinate relationships with drone technology, equipment, training, and compliance vendors in accordance with firm policies.

Cross-Functional Coordination

• Partner with practice leaders, pilots, and corporate functions to support adoption, resolve issues, and align program priorities.
• Coordinate pilot onboarding, training, certification tracking, and program communications.
• Serve as the central point of coordination for program questions and route technical, legal, regulatory, safety, or accounting matters to the appropriate subject matter expert.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
• Five or more years of experience in program management, operations, fleet or asset management, compliance administration, field operations, or a related discipline.
• Practical knowledge of commercial drone operations and applicable FAA requirements.
• Experience implementing standardized processes across multiple teams, locations, or business units.
• Experience selecting, implementing, or administering an operational, fleet, asset, compliance, or workflow technology platform.
• Strong analytical, reporting, organizational, and stakeholder-management skills.
• FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate
• Clear written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams without relying on direct reporting authority.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting a multi-location drone, aviation, field-services, equipment-management, or other regulated operational program.
• Experience with drone fleet-management platforms, flight-log systems, or asset-management solutions.
• Experience supporting billing, cost recovery, project accounting, or client documentation in a professional services environment.
• Familiarity with commercial insurance schedules, FAA waivers or authorizations, and specialized drone operating environments.
• Project management, safety management, process improvement, or change management certification or training.

Physical and Mental Job Qualifications

• Ability to work at a computer and review operational, regulatory, and financial information for extended periods.
• Ability to communicate effectively with geographically dispersed stakeholders and manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
• Ability to travel occasionally and access field or equipment-storage locations when needed.
• Ability to safely handle or move typical small-drone equipment and cases, with reasonable accommodation as applicable.
• Occasional work outside standard business hours may be required to support operational needs.

Some of the Benefits We Have Include

J.S. Held understands all our employees are people and sometimes life needs flexibility. We work to always provide an environment that best supports and suits our team’s needs.

• Our flexible work environment allows employees to work remotely, when needed
• Flexible Time Off policy
• Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
• 401k Match
• Commuter Benefit

A reasonable estimate of the salary range for this role is $120,000-140,000. Any offered salary range is based on a wide array of factors including but not limited to skillset, experience, training, location, scope of role, management responsibility, etc.

Other Duties

We embrace diversity and our commitment to building a team and environment that fosters professional and personal enrichment is unwavering. We are greater when we are equal!
