jobs.title: Co-Founding CEO (Metabolic & Inflammation Therapies)
jobs.description:
Co-Founding CEO (Metabolic & Inflammation Therapies)

Location: Remote
Commitment: Part-time to start, with greater time commitment expected as the company scales
Compensation: Equity only, transitioning to salary after fundraising
Start Date: ASAP preferred, Q4 2026 at the latest
Seniority: Co-founder / Leadership

About the Company

This startup is developing a new kind of small molecule to treat diabetic kidney disease (DKD) and other metabolic diseases.

Their approach is different from existing treatments: instead of managing symptoms (like blood sugar or blood pressure), their drug targets the root cause: a molecular signal inside cells that triggers inflammation and scarring in the kidneys.

Their lead drug, INT-101, is first-in-class and acts by blocking a specific interaction between two proteins (RAGE and DIAPH1). Blocking this interaction mitigates the downstream effects that lead to kidney inflammation and fibrosis. As a result, it has the potential to restore kidney function, not just slow the damage. No other current therapies have this disease-modifying effect.

Built on Professor Ann Marie Schmidt's pioneering RAGE biology research at NYU, the platform shows strong preclinical proof-of-concept in diabetic kidney disease and potential across multiple indications. With four granted U.S. patents, it represents a credible, first-in-class therapeutic approach moving toward clinical development.

Purpose of the Role

The CEO will lead all aspects of the venture's growth, from setting strategy to advancing its first programs into clinical trials.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines scientific understanding with strong business and fundraising skills. The CEO will decide the indication strategy, secure new funding, build and lead the team, and represent the company to investors, partners, and the broader biotech community.

This is a unique opportunity to shape a first-in-class biotech from the ground up, driving a platform with potential impact across multiple chronic diseases.

Key Responsibilities

• Define and execute the company's strategy, aligning science, operations, and business goals.

• Lead fundraising (seed, Series A), leveraging networks and partnerships to secure capital and strategic collaborations.

• Choose and prioritize indication strategy (such as DKD, obesity, atherosclerosis, or MASH) based on opportunity, patient need, and risk.

• Oversee the transition from preclinical to IND submission and clinical development.

• Build and manage a team as the company progresses.

• Collaborate closely with Professor Ann Marie Schmidt and advisors to integrate scientific excellence with commercial strategy.

• Represent the venture in front of investors, partners, and the scientific community.

What We're Looking For

• Proven biotech or life sciences leader with early-stage venture experience.

• Successful fundraising track record.

• Strong scientific and strategic understanding of metabolic diseases (e.g., diabetes, kidney disease, obesity) or related areas.

• Experience guiding programs through preclinical and regulatory development toward the clinic.

• Ability to turn complex science into a clear, fundable business plan.

• Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills with investors, advisors, and diverse stakeholders.

• A hands-on, adaptable leader who thrives in dynamic startup environments, with integrity, credibility, and a collaborative mindset.

About NLC

NLC Health Ventures is a leading healthtech and biotech innovation platform based in Amsterdam, combining venture building and fund management across Europe and North America. With 40-45 employees, NLC manages four captive funds investing in ventures from pre-seed to Series B-C, and is fundraising for a fifth fund. The funds have a diverse LP base and are invested in over 70 companies. NLC values a collaborative, open, and impact-driven culture, where team members' ideas and contributions truly matter.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst - Manufacturing

The candidate should have working knowledge on a manufacturing environment. Besides having extensive knowledge of Manufactory domain, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), also need process/ digital solution Understanding with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Supply Chain/ costing domains such as Order Management, Inventory, Warehouse, Shipping, Transportation, Work in Process, Bills of Materials, and Purchasing, Standard costing would be an advantage. The candidate would lead analysis for conversion of existing legacy data, lead regression testing, and provide analyses and specifications for development work for any new or changed system requirements, to train, implement, and support business processes. Documents business policies, practices and procedures to meet company standards and user needs. Leverages existing system's standard functionality to implement efficient and consistent Avery Dennison Global processes and procedures. Brings a level of functional and technical knowledge of Manufactory Execution System/ Advance Production Scheduling Digital Solutions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Build & Site Rollout Management

• Provides Leadership and support for Apparel MES/APS/WMS global solution design & implementation/ rollout project execution from Business Process & Digital solution perspective.
• Translate business objectives into requirements and functional specifications, supporting document creation and automation efforts.
• Utilize business analysis, data mapping and data validation to assist the development of coding specifications.
• Manages the execution of testing for assigned deliverables; identify and document test defects, document quality issues and communicate defects to assure resolution.
• Prepares test and training plans. Develops training materials and delivers formal training for each new
• Manage defect resolution throughout the system development life cycle.
• Effectively leads change, working with key-stakeholders including management and end users to ensure involvement, participation, and encouragement of others ideas and contributions for effective teamwork and project completion.
• Participates and provides full and complete regression testing of system changes for patches and upgrades including working with Software Suppliers to diagnose and resolve problems with the MES system. In addition, tests and prepares new functionality as made available or as business requirements indicate. Ensures patches and upgrades are applied prior to production implementation.
• Provides support to end users for Supply Chain/ Manufactory modules and processes including interfacing with third party systems, like MES, Shipping

2. Project Management

• Project Management & Scheduling: Serve as the primary IT PM Coordinator for site building & rollouts—tracking project charters, schedules, resource allocation, and key deliverables from scoping to final hand-over.
• Vendor & Partner Coordination: Act as the operational bridge between site business stakeholders, MFG4.0 team , IT team and external implementation vendors, ensuring third-party technical deliverables meet timelines and quality standards.

• Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree, or Advanced Degree.
• MES/WMS Implementation / 0-to-1 Experience: 5+ years of hands-on Business Analyst experience with Manufacturing Execution System(MES) / Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) in manufacturing, warehousing, or apparel/industrial environments, including direct experience in 0-to-1 MES/WMS implementations OR full-lifecycle deployments
• Basic understanding of Shipping Module in ERP (Oracle eBS/ Fusion ERP / SAP) system.
• ERP Integration: Experience with WMS/MES integration to Oracle Fusion ERP or SAP S/4HANA.
• Project Coordination Track Record: Proven experience acting as an IT Project Coordinator, managing multi-site software rollouts, vendor schedules, and cross-functional project deliverables.
• PM Certifications: PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum certifications are advantageous.
• English Proficiency: Fluent/Proficient in English (both written and spoken) with exceptional communication skills, confident in leading workshops and coordinating independently with MFG4.0 team, global IT, site leaders, and external vendors. Mandarin is a plus.
• Familiar with the global digital solution standardization & plant rollout model, great collaboration/ Teamwork with different cultures across the world.
• Very logical thinker. Very organized and structured in methodology and work habits.
• Ability to see a need and provide a solution even if before being asked to provide a solution. jobs.title: NA Founding SDR (NYC based)
jobs.description:
🌟 What we do & why we do it

Founded in 2021 in Osnabrück, Germany, doinstruct is on a mission to empower the backbone of our society - the frontline workforce - by making workplaces safer, more compliant, and more efficient. We don’t just improve training; we redefine how industries onboard and upskill their teams.



The problem? Outdated, inefficient training methods that fail to meet the needs of the deskless workforce - the 80% of global workers overlooked by traditional learning solutions. We saw the gap and built a seamless, mobile-first platform that makes onboarding, training, and compliance effortless, multilingual, and accessible - anytime, anywhere.



At doinstruct, we don’t accept the status quo. We innovate, we challenge, we build. Our vision is bold: Operational excellence for frontline teams starts here. We cut through the noise of clunky, ineffective training with an engaging, user-friendly experience available in 35+ languages - no downloads, no passwords - just instant access to the skills that drive industries forward.



🚀 Join us if you’re ready to build something extraordinary. We’re growing fast and looking for ambitious minds who thrive in a fast-paced, high-impact environment. If you’re passionate about solving big problems, shaping the future of workplace learning, and working alongside a driven team that moves fast and thinks big, doinstruct is where you belong.



___

The role


You're early in your career and want proof, not a title, that you can sell. doinstruct sells AI-powered frontline training software into manufacturing, logistics, food and construction, and is hiring its first junior SDR for the US and Canada market it just broke into. 
You'll report to Mona, the co-founder leading our North America expansion, and work side by side with Jonathan, our Founding AE NA, who has led SDR teams before and coaches you day to day. What this role asks for is hunger, fast learning and turning AI-assisted tools into real qualified meetings.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN:

 - Learn from daily coaching and become better every week

 - Learn the challenges of your customers in ways how the doinstruct platform can help solve them
   
   


WHO YOU ARE:

 - Based in, or able to relocate to New York City to work side on side with Mona in the office at least 3d/week

 - A completed or nearly completed bachelor's degree, or one prior SDR/BDR stint already behind you

 - Be able to work in the USA without sponsorship

 - Concrete evidence you push harder than you have to: a demanding program, a job held through school, a competitive team
   
   


WHY DOINSTRUCT:

 - Backed by top tier investors (HV Capital and Creandum), with budget and leadership time already committed to the North America bet

 - You report directly to our co-founder Mona and are coached by Jonathan, our NA AE, has led SDR teams before - one of the best to learn from

 - doinstruct is a post-Series A company of around 75 people globally, still small enough that your work is visible past your own manager
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

 - 3 months: Ramped up with the confidence to tackle the market and speak to customers on your own!

 - 6 months: Begin to produce predictable pipeline through strategic outbound playbooks and qualified opportunities

 - 12 months: Become the standard as to which future NA SDR’s strive to Achieve!

____

At doinstruct, you'll have the chance to use your skills and help shape our growing start-up. We value a friendly work environment, open communication, and support your personal and professional growth every step of the way.



Even if you don't tick all of the boxes, but you are motivated and want to work with us, you are very welcome to apply.


We embrace diversity and hire people based on their ability to perform a job. People of any race, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, political opinion, or marital status are welcome at doinstruct.

_

For questions or remarks please reach out to our team at people@doinstruct.com
_


🌱 Our Core Values

Our core values shape how we work, ensuring consistency, trust, and purpose while guiding both individual actions and collective decisions. They’re not just words—we live them every day.

 - 💌 Appreciation – We cultivate an environment of mutual respect, recognizing the unique contributions and backgrounds of every team member. Success is a team effort, and we celebrate it together.

 - 💪 Drive – We don’t settle for "good enough." We are motivated by continuous improvement, setting ambitious goals, and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - 🚀 Enabler – We take a proactive, solution-oriented approach, understanding the diverse needs of both our customers and our team. We believe challenges are opportunities waiting to be solved.

 - 🗣️ Honesty – We value transparency and direct, constructive feedback. Open communication helps us learn faster, grow stronger, and build trust.

 - 🌟 Ownership – We take full responsibility for our work, moving with urgency and independence. We don’t wait for solutions—we create them. Mistakes are learning opportunities, and we embrace them as part of our growth.

 


🤝 HOW WE WORK

We believe in a workplace culture that fuels ambition, fosters innovation, and rewards initiative. At doinstruct, you’ll be surrounded by driven individuals who are passionate about making an impact. We set high standards - because the work we do matters.

Collaboration and shared energy drive us. We believe that working together in person creates the best ideas, sharpens our execution, and strengthens our team. That’s why we thrive in an office-first environment, where we exchange ideas freely and move fast together.

We’re not about rigid structures - we’re about high performance with flexibility. While we empower every teammate to optimize their productivity, we also believe that great things happen when we’re in the same room, building something extraordinary side by side.



 


📽️ GET A GLIMPSE INTO OUR OFFSITE IN NOV 2024


 
 




🌻 LET’S TALK BENEFITS

Your well-being is a priority, and we're here to help you thrive — both inside and outside of work. That’s why we offer a variety of benefits to our team that you can find here.

jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

• We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.

• Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.

• Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE:

We are looking for an exceptional Senior Manager, Global Procurement [Materials] to own and drive cost structures and savings. This role is critical to our goal of delivering the highest quality products, at radically low prices -done right. Reporting to the Head of Procurement, the ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in commodity costing, clean sheet, manufacturing excellence & efficiency, harvest timing, raw material availability to craft a competitive costing environment where T2 and T3 suppliers are being challenged to provide transparent, and competitive pricing to achieve a win win supply chain for both Quince and our partners.

Success in this role means achieving material cost at or near should-costing, below market indices, securing supply continuity, and contributing to product excellence by aligning material procurement with the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business,contribute to company growth, and shape the future of our global procurement strategy.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Commodity Insights: Establish a monitoring framework to forecast global market shifts, raw material fluctuations, currency risks, and macro-material trends. Deliver actionable intelligence to procurement and leadership on a regular cadence. Build and operationalize a live tracking system for key raw material prices, currency movements, and supply risks to proactively surface threats and opportunities.

• Upstream Cost Engineering: Construct and scale material-specific clean sheets to lock in baseline component costs before finished-goods production. Provide the costing foundation for Tier 1 negotiations. Build material-specific clean sheets for all top raw material inputs to create pricing transparency and support Tier 1 negotiation. Support Buy Plan margin review to govern company margin target. Partner with material sourcing team to ensure transparent, competitive pricing from all key material suppliers (we own material, we own costing)

• Tier 2 (and Tier 3) Vendor Strategy: Map and design an upstream network strategy to consolidate raw material volumes across key material types and maximize direct-to-mill leverage. Reduce supply chain complexity while improving cost and availability. Complete mapping of the Tier 2 and Tier 3 vendor landscape and deliver a defined material and vendor strategy that reduces complexity, ensures capacity, and increases direct-to-mill buying power. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate upstream material availability into product design and development cycles, ensuring early-stage cost optimization and seamless material-to-finished-good transitions.

• Material RFPs: Design and execute RFPs tailored specifically to raw material vendors, yarn spinners/mills, tanneries, and textile mills. Own the full bidding process from vendor outreach through award. Consistently deliver product exceptional material cost without sacrificing product quality or ESG considerations Negotiate and execute immediate cost-reduction agreements directly with Tier 2 material suppliers, while simultaneously institutionalizing repeatable negotiation frameworks to build long-term material maturity and sustainable competitive advantage. Partner directly with the Material Sourcing, Product Sourcing and Tier 1 and Tier 2 vendors to align on, and implement, material benefits into finished goods costing.

• Value Creation: Identify and execute on opportunities to reshape the supply chain and extract new financial value beyond traditional sourcing boundaries, including verticalization and volume consolidation plays. E.g. How do we become a market maker for Cashmere, Silk, etc? Could we sell cashmere and silk to other retailers? How can we partner with other mills or manufacturers to build a verticalized supply chain for critical materials, like linen, from French/Belgian farms and scutchers to linen mills? How do we buy/sell commodities to manage price fluctuations (e.g. gold pricing, Cashmere pricing)?

REQUIREMENTS:

• 12-15 years of experience in raw material sourcing, commodity procurement, or upstream supply chain management

• Deep knowledge of textile raw materials including yarns, fibers, fabrics, leather, and related commodities

• Experience negotiating directly with mills, tanneries, yarn spinners, and raw material vendors

• Familiarity with commodity hedging frameworks and global market indices

• Proven ability to build and execute material-specific clean sheets

• Strong analytical and financial modeling skills; comfort with large data sets

• Technical aptitude for leveraging AI-powered platforms (e.g., LLMs) to conduct scenario analysis and automate complex procurement tasks.Experience in upstream supply chain network design or consolidation preferred

• Experience working cross-functionally with merchandising, sourcing, and production teams

• Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree a plus

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer - Hardware
jobs.description:
About Etched

Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.



Job Summary

Designing frontier AI hardware means solving electrical and mechanical problems together: schematics and board layouts, power delivery and signal integrity, packaging and cooling, manufacturing and assembly. Every decision changes the constraints on the next. Future breakthroughs will come from AI systems that can reason across these domains, operate engineering tools, run thousands of experiments, and learn which designs work in the physical world.

You will build those systems. Your mandate is to build agents that take electrical and mechanical designs from requirements through verified, manufacturable outputs. These agents should create and modify CAD models, design schematics and PCB layouts, run simulations, diagnose failures, and iterate with our engineers, pushing the limits of how much of the design process AI can own end to end.

Etched offers a uniquely tight research loop: chips, boards, racks, cooling systems, manufacturing, and dedicated in-office compute under one roof. By architecting and orchestrating agent loops, you will turn proprietary designs, simulation results, engineering decisions, and physical test data into systems that get better with every experiment—and ship the hardware they help design.



Key Responsibilities

 - Build and own AI systems that turn engineering requirements into verified electrical and mechanical designs, carrying intent and constraints from initial concepts through manufacturing outputs.

 - Build agents that operate CAD, EDA, and simulation tools to generate designs, run experiments, inspect results, diagnose problems, and iterate with our teams, to the limits of model autonomy.

 - Develop workflows spanning component selection, schematic capture, PCB layout, mechanical CAD, assemblies, thermal analysis, and electrical and structural simulation.

 - Build the tool integrations and representations agents need to reason about geometry, connectivity, materials, tolerances, and coupled electrical, mechanical, thermal, and manufacturing constraints.

 - Design evals that measure engineering correctness, constraint satisfaction, simulation accuracy, manufacturability, and performance on real design tasks.

 - Turn simulation outputs, design-rule checks, engineering reviews, and physical measurements into structured feedback models can learn from.

 - Curate proprietary datasets and design memory from complete trajectories, expert demonstrations, failed approaches, and manufactured outcomes.

 - Build reproducible experiment infrastructure so design revisions, tool actions, simulation settings, and results remain traceable and experiments can run at scale.

 - Ship agent-generated designs with our electrical, mechanical, and manufacturing teams, and quantify improvements in design cycle time, hardware performance, and engineering effort.

jobs.title: Sr./Staff Product Designer, Developer Platform
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

Millions of people use ComfyUI to make AI images and video. The Developer Platform is how developers use ComfyUI their way. They deploy a serverless ComfyUI environment. They call any partner model through Comfy Router with one API key. They manage keys, limits and spend. They connect Comfy to their own agents through Comfy MCP.

We build this platform from the ground up. We are looking for a senior product designer to own it end to end.

You will be the design DRI for the full developer surface: the console, onboarding, the docs experience, and usage and billing. You will work directly with the pillar PM and the platform engineers. You will make the product decisions that design is responsible for.

You must know the developer. Either you were a developer, or you are one, or you have many years of experience in developer products.

This is not a role where a PM gives you a finished specification and you make it look good. You will get an unclear platform problem. You will find out who the developer is and what they try to do. Then you will carry the solution from problem to shipped UI.

What You Will Do

 - Own the design of the developer console: environments, API keys, Router, usage, spend, rate limits and workspace settings.

 - Turn new models, endpoints and capabilities into clear interfaces as the platform ships. The API surface moves fast, and you will keep pace with it.

 - Design the hard states: failed deploys, empty credit balances, rate-limit errors and missing permissions. In developer tools, an error message is an interface.

 - Shape the docs and quickstart experience with the docs PM. The reference material and the console must feel like one product.

 - Talk to the developers who build on Comfy, and read how they use the API, before you decide what to build.

 - Build what you design. Write the frontend code for your features and submit the PRs.

 - Set the design bar and direction for the Developer Platform pillar.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

 - Know the developer from the inside. You have written software and you have spent years on developer products and can show it.

 - Speak the language. You know what an API key, a webhook, a rate limit and a serverless deploy are. You do not need a translator to design for them.

 - Have 6+ years of product design experience, with developer-facing products that you shipped and can show: a console, an API platform, a cloud product or an SDK.

 - Have owned a product surface end to end without a design manager over your shoulder. You can show the decisions you made and why.

 - Have strong information architecture skills. You can take a tangle of objects, permissions and relations and make it feel like one clear thing.

 - Have high craft. Typography, density, spacing and interaction details matter to you, and you have shipped work that other designers respect.

Bonus Points

 - You have used ComfyUI, or another node-based or workflow tool, and have opinions about it.

 - You use other AI creation tools such as Krea, Runway, Higgsfield, Flora, etc and you know how they compare.

What This Role Is Not

 - A visual polish role where the product decisions are made somewhere else.

 - A marketing or docs-writing role.

 - A management role. This is a senior IC position with full ownership of one product surface.


ABOUT COMFY

Comfy (https://www.comfy.org) is the AI creation engine for visual professionals who demand control over every model, every parameter, and every output. The most powerful workflow engine for visual AI.

Unlike tools that hide everything behind a prompt box, Comfy lets you connect models, processing steps, and outputs on a canvas where every decision is visible and every step is inspectable. It gives you the building blocks to create workflows nobody's imagined yet, and share them with everyone.

What started as an open-source project in 2023 now has 4 million users, 60,000+ community-built nodes, and 150,000+ daily downloads. It's used by artists, filmmakers, game studios, designers, researchers, and VFX houses, including teams at OpenAI, Netflix, Amazon Studios, Ubisoft, EA, and Tencent.

We're a small, intense team in San Francisco. Our team comes from Stability AI and Google, and many contributed to the ComfyUI ecosystem long before working here. Low ego, high ownership. We work hard and demand a lot of each other, but we have fun. Everyone here is building something meaningful that will end up being our life's work.

If this mission excites you and you view yourself as top-tier talent, your future latent self is waiting for you at Comfy.

Check out our Github (https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI) and blog (https://blog.comfy.org). We recently raised $30M at a $500M valuation. The round was led by Craft, with participation from Pace Capital, Chemistry, TruArrow, and others.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As Claude's capabilities grow, so does our responsibility to ensure those capabilities reach the right people. The Access Programs team builds the systems that verify who our customers are, grant access to advanced model capabilities for approved use cases, and ensure that access is not misused. As a software engineer on this team, you will build the identity, vetting, and access management infrastructure that underpins our trusted access programs, along with the monitoring and enforcement tooling that keeps them safe. This work sits at the center of how Anthropic deploys frontier capabilities responsibly, balancing broad access with rigorous safeguards.

Responsibilities:

• Build identity verification and vetting systems (KYC/KYB) that establish who our individual and business customers are

• Design and implement access control systems that grant, scope, and revoke access to advanced capabilities based on approved use cases

• Build infrastructure to configure safety systems and detection thresholds on a per-customer basis for trusted access programs

• Develop monitoring to detect misuse of expanded access, and tooling that enables enforcement teams to act on it

• Partner closely with policy, enforcement, threat intelligence, product, research, and go-to-market teams so that access decisions are well-informed and consistently applied

• Build systems that identify account compromise and takeover, apply mitigations in real time, and carry affected accounts through to full remediation

• Design and build the dashboards, alerting, and internal admin tooling that give the team and its partners clear visibility into the health and outcomes of our access programs

• Integrate with third-party identity verification and data enrichment vendors

You may be a good fit if you have:

• A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or comparable experience

• Experience building and operating backend systems in production

• Strong coding skills in at least one general-purpose programming language, and experience building software with AI coding tools

• Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

• Care about the societal impacts of AI and want your work to make powerful systems safer

Strong candidates may also:

• 8+ years of industry software engineering experience

• Experience building shared platforms or foundational services that many teams and products depend on, rather than one-off solutions for a single use case

• A track record of working across functions (for example engineering, product, policy, operations, and go-to-market) to gather requirements, reconcile competing needs, and drive adoption of what you build

• Experience with identity, authentication, or authorization systems at scale

• Experience with KYC/KYB workflows or identity verification vendors

• Experience in trust and safety, integrity, fraud, or abuse detection

• Experience detecting and responding to account takeover or credential compromise

• Experience partnering with operational teams to build custom internal tooling

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$320,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. jobs.title: Practice Associate
jobs.description:
Practice Associate

Reports to:   Senior Lead Enrollment Specialist

Team:   Enrollment & Access

Location:   Remote

Status:   Full-time, non-exempt

About FamilyWell

FamilyWell Health delivers behavioral health care to women across the reproductive lifecycle. We operate a Collaborative Care Model in partnership with OB/GYN and primary care practices and enterprise health clients, making mental health support available where patients already receive care.

About the Role

As a Practice Associate, you provide the administrative backbone that keeps the enterprise referral pipeline moving. You support the Enrollment Specialist by keeping records synced across EHR systems, catching and resolving no-shows and late cancels before they become lost patients, processing related charges, and serving as the first voice patients and partners hear when they call FamilyWell.

It is a detail-heavy, high-volume role: part data entry and EHR administration, part patient outreach, part billing support, part reception. You are the reason patients don't fall through the cracks between appointments.

What You'll Do

Keep records in sync across EHRs

• Create appointments and paste clinical and administrative notes between EHR systems (e.g., Healthie and the partner's EHR) so both records stay current

• Document changes accurately and promptly following each appointment, cancellation, or reschedule

Monitor and resolve no-shows and late cancellations

• Run reports to identify no-shows and late cancellations across the caseload

• Text and call patients to reschedule missed or cancelled appointments

• Notify the referring provider when a patient is lost to follow-up

• Process charges for no-show and late-cancel appointments per policy

Support scheduling and coordination

• Text patients directly to schedule and confirm appointments

• Support handoffs after the intake and between therapy, psychiatry, and collaborative care as patient needs change

• Work directly with providers to resolve scheduling conflicts and follow-up gaps

• Communicate relevant patient status back to the referring clinician, including after no-shows, cancellations, or changes in care plan

• Follow the escalation pathway for clinical concerns promptly and through the right channel

Serve as the front door to FamilyWell

• Answer the FamilyWell phone line as receptionist, routing calls and taking messages appropriately

• Represent FamilyWell professionally and warmly with every patient and partner interaction

What You Bring

Required

• 1+ years in an administrative, scheduling, medical front-office, or customer service role

• Comfort working across multiple EHR or software systems simultaneously

• Strong attention to detail, particularly with data entry and charge processing

• Clear, warm phone and text communication with patients

• Strong customer service skills

• Ability to manage a high volume of tasks and follow-ups without dropping details

Preferred

• Experience with Healthie, EcW or a comparable EHR

• Experience with medical billing or charge posting

• Experience answering calls and customer service

• Behavioral health or healthcare administrative experience

Systems

• Healthie, Spruce, and partner EHR systems, and internal Registry tools — training provided

How We'll Measure Success

Measures reviewed monthly:

• No-show and late-cancel outreach within 1 business day

• Rebooking rate on missed appointments

• Charge processing accuracy and timeliness for no-shows and late cancels

• EHR documentation accuracy and timeliness across systems

• Phone line responsiveness and call handling quality

Why This Role Matters

Patients get lost between appointments, not between referrals. This role catches the gaps — the missed visit, the note that didn't make it to the other system, the call that goes unanswered — so that no patient falls out of care because of an administrative step that didn't happen.

FamilyWell Health is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are committed to building a team that reflects the patients we serve.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
About Tekmetric

Tekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better.

Built by a shop owner and shaped by the needs of the industry, Tekmetric brings together innovation, real-world experience, and a thriving community to help shops thrive - not just survive. From running a shop, to securing payments to engaging customers, our platform simplifies operations so shop owners can focus on what really matters: delivering exceptional service, earning trust, and growing sustainably.

Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset.

But we’re not just building shop management software. We’re building a movement. We’re empowering repair shops to rise above the daily grind, create meaningful connections with their customers, and lead the industry forward - one interaction at a time.

Come build with us. Join the journey. Shape the future of auto repair.

Working the Tekmetric Way

At Tekmetric, we’re building a culture where winning matters - not for ego, but because when our customers win, we win together.

We move fast, stay curious, and take full ownership of our results — no excuses, no finger-pointing. If you thrive in ambiguity, take initiative, and view honest feedback as fuel for growth, you’ll feel right at home here.

We’re direct but respectful, ambitious yet grounded, and collaborative at every level. Everyone leads through impact and is encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions (even your manager’s). This is a place for builders, not bystanders.

Success here takes focus, follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves — but if you’re driven by meaningful work and real results, it’s deeply rewarding. You’ll join a team that cares about the work, supports one another, and takes smart risks to achieve bold goals. Be yourself, stay mission-focused, and you’ll thrive. If that energizes you, we can’t wait to meet you.

At Tekmetric, great work happens anywhere, but great teams are built through intentional connection. We offer hybrid and remote work models based on your proximity to our office hubs. Because we value in-person collaboration, travel is an expected part of every role. We come together several times a year for team and company-wide offsites to align on goals and strengthen relationships. Attendance at these events is expected and fully supported.

Summary Of How You Will Impact Tekmetric

Tekmetric is at an inflection point, scaling fast and entering its next phase of growth, and Strategic Finance is at the center of how we get there. The Sr. Manager, Strategic Finance will be a key thought partner to the executive team, owning the analytical layer behind our GTM motion, shaping long-range strategy, and driving the high-stakes decisions that define our next chapter. This role sits outside of FP&A and is built for someone who wants to operate at the intersection of finance, strategy, and business — translating rigorous analysis into clear narratives and real decisions. If you're energized by building something from scratch, working directly with senior leadership, and having your fingerprints on how a high-growth SaaS company scales, this is the role for you.

The ideal candidate is a builder and a strategic thinker, someone who can go from a blank page to an exec-ready model or narrative without heavy guidance, earns credibility with leaders across the business through sharp analysis and clear communication, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where ambiguity is the norm and the playbook is still being written.

You will be responsible for:

Special Projects & Strategic Analysis

• Lead ad hoc strategic work including M&A screening, new market evaluation, pricing strategy, and new product launches

• Conduct competitive and market analysis to inform go-to-market and product strategy

• Evaluate strategic partnerships and commercial deal structures, assessing financial impact and trade-offs

• Support build vs. buy vs. partner decisions with rigorous financial and strategic frameworks

• Identify opportunities to automate recurring finance workflows using AI and modern FP&A tooling, reducing manual effort and improving data integrity

Long-Range Planning and Strategic Modeling

• Build and own long-range financial models that forecast multi-year revenue across various investment scenarios

• Model strategic alternatives and simulate how key business decisions (pricing, partnerships, market entry, capacity investment) affect long-term outcomes

GTM Finance & Customer Economics

• Own the analytical layer behind the GTM motion (CAC, sales efficiency, and funnel conversion analytics)

• Build and maintain customer economics frameworks including LTV:CAC, retention, churn drivers, and cohort analysis

• Evaluate expansion economics across upsell and cross-sell motions

• Serve as the analytical thought partner to Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product leadership, translating data into actionable recommendations

Executive and Board Reporting

• Develop strategic materials for the Board of Directors and investors, translating complex operational data into clear narratives

• Prepare executive-level presentations, investment briefs, and strategic summaries that distill complex analysis into actionable insight

• Build and maintain reusable AI-assisted workflows for recurring deliverables

What You’ll Bring

Experience and Requirements:

• 5+ years in strategic finance, investment banking, private equity, management consulting, FP&A or comparable analytical roles.

• Background in SaaS is strongly preferred

• Demonstrated strength in financial modeling, including building models from scratch, stress-testing assumptions, and communicating outputs clearly

• Experience working on special projects or cross-functional initiatives with senior stakeholders

• Has built at least one reusable prompt workflow for a recurring finance deliverable; can describe it and the time it saved

• Has connected AI tools to live data sources (e.g., CRM, financial databases) to automate recurring competitive or pipeline monitoring is a strong plus

• Proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets; experience with SQL; familiarity with BI tools such as Looker or equivalent; comfort with AI tools and workflow automation

Skills:

• Exceptional financial modeling skills, including ARR and revenue modeling, pipeline and capacity planning, scenario analysis, and sensitivity testing

• Strong strategic thinking and analytical capabilities, with the ability to translate insights into actionable plans

• Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build rapport at all levels

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously under tight deadlines

• Self-starter with a proactive attitude and a strong sense of ownership

• Ability to work independently and as part of a dynamic team in a fast-paced, evolving environment

Why You'll Love Working With Us

Health & Wellness That Have You Covered:

• Enjoy the flexibility of remote work

• Competitive base salaries that reflect your value.

• Generous Paid Time Off, because we know you do your best work when you're well-rested.

• Support for every stage of life—with paid maternity, parental bonding, and medical leave for you or your loved ones.

• Comprehensive health benefits, including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Prescription coverage. For employee only, we offer plans that cover 100% of premiums and we cover 50% of costs for families.

• Prioritizing your mental health: get free, confidential counseling through our partnership with BetterHelp.

Investing in Your Future (and Present):

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with 100% employer match on contributions up to 6% - so your future self will thank you.

• Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) to make your money go further.

jobs.title: Investment Associate
jobs.description:
About MISUMI Americas

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

Investment Associate

Misumi Ventures · San Francisco Bay Area · Full-time

The fund

Misumi Ventures is a $50 million early-stage fund investing at the intersection of frontier hardware, robotics, automation and industrial AI.

We will build a portfolio of 20 to 30 seed and early-stage companies. Our thesis is specific. Hardware companies rarely fail because the idea was wrong — they fail in the gap between a working prototype and repeatable volume production. Our portfolio companies get direct access to MISUMI's manufacturing continuum: more than 30 million standard parts, 22 company-owned factories, 4,000 sourcing partners, and a five-region network across the Americas, China, Asia, Europe and Japan. That is what we put on a cap table alongside the check.

The role

Misumi Ventures is newly launched. Our founding partners hold operating responsibilities within MISUMI Americas, which means the Investment Associate will be the fund's first dedicated full-time investment professional.

The scope is correspondingly broad. You will build our deal funnel, own how the fund presents itself to founders and co-investors, support diligence and portfolio companies, and run the reporting cadence to our LP. You will report to the Managing Partner and participate in investment discussions.

This is not a narrow deal seat, and we want to be direct about that before you apply.

Responsibilities

Sourcing and co-investor relationships

Our deal flow depends on being present in the pipelines of the firms that do lead. You will build and maintain relationships with investors across our sectors, work the accelerator and university research channels that produce frontier hardware companies, and keep a current map of who is funding what in robotics, automation, aerospace, and industrial software. You will run first meetings and write the memo that determines whether a partner takes a second.

Fund positioning and ecosystem presence

Founders and co-investors distinguish between a fund and a corporate development budget, and our credibility depends on being clearly understood as the former. You will own our external presence — website, content, founder-facing communications, and our participation in the deep-tech and hardware communities — and run the founder dinners, technical sessions and events that make us a known quantity in our categories.

Diligence and portfolio support

Technical and commercial diligence: customer references, expert calls, competitive and supply chain analysis, market sizing. Post-investment, you will connect portfolio companies into MISUMI's engineering and sourcing organization and support them through recruiting, customer introductions and subsequent financings.

Fund operations and LP reporting

Quarterly reporting to the LP, working with our fund administrator and the finance organization at MISUMI Americas. Portfolio and pipeline reporting for the investment committee. Ownership of the CRM and our data discipline.

Requirements

• Two to four years in venture capital, investment banking, management consulting, corporate development, or an operating role at a hardware or deep-tech company

• Demonstrated technical fluency in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, robotics, manufacturing or a related field highly preferred. You will be evaluating physical products and you need to be credible with the engineers building them

• Strong written communication. Memos, market analysis, and LP reporting constitute a large share of the work

• Established relationships in the venture, engineering or founder community a strong plus, or a clear plan for building them

• Comfort operating without an existing playbook, at a fund making its first investments

Preferred

• Prior exposure to hardware, robotics, aerospace, medtech or industrial automation, whether as an investor, engineer or operator

• Familiarity with manufacturing, supply chain or design-for-manufacturing

Compensation

• Base salary - $125K - $150K depending on experience

• Carried interest in the fund

• Health, dental, and vision coverage; 401(k)

Our partners have committed to market-standard economics for the fund, and that extends to the investment team.

We’re actively seeking teammates who:

• Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.

• Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.

• Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.

• Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.

• Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

jobs.title: Research Engineer
jobs.description:
Building Healthcare That Remembers 

Every time you call a doctor's office, the system forgets you the moment you hang up. You wait on hold, explain everything from scratch, get bounced between lines, and hope someone follows up. Everyone has felt this. No one should have to. 

At Assort Health, we're building one continuous conversation for every patient. An AI agent that knows who you are, remembers how you like to be reached, and carries that context from your first symptom to your full recovery. What began as the first voice AI agent to schedule a specialty appointment has become the largest proprietary specialty dataset in healthcare: 270 million patient interactions, 62,000 care protocols, 1.6 million decision pathways. 

We went from 15 people in 2025 and will cross 250 by the end of 2026. Revenue is up 20x in 15 months and we've raised $222 million, including a recent $120 million Series C https://www.assorthealth.com/blog/assort-health-raises-120-million-series-c-to-scale-largest-deployment-of-ai-agents-for-the-patient-journey at a $1.2 billion valuation. We've also been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and the 2026 Enterprise Tech 30 as the only healthcare AI company on the list!

Healthcare spends $1.1 trillion a year on administration instead of care. If you want to help change that, apply below.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Research Engineer, you’ll be responsible for building industry-leading healthcare AI models and model pipelines that power Assort’s voice agents and overall patient platform, taking them all the way from idea to production. You’ll own large initiatives that push the boundary of what models and agents can accomplish in the healthcare space while maintaining high levels of reliability, efficiency, and precision of accomplishing tasks.

We’re looking for strong research engineers who want to build the core models and algorithms behind our core platform and agents. People here own their work end-to-end, ship real improvements, and are trusted to make high-impact technical decisions.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead research and engineering efforts to improve core conversational capabilities in production, including instruction following, tool calling, retrieval, and memory

 - Investigate research questions in speech and audio, and design experiments to test hypotheses about model behavior and capabilities

 - Build and iterate on end-to-end models and pipelines that optimize for quality, efficiency, and user experience

 - Identify opportunities for model-task optimization to ensure the right model architectures are used for different tasks based on performance, latency, and cost

 - Partner with platform and product engineers to integrate new models into production systems

 - Break down ambiguous research ideas into clear, iterative milestones and roadmaps

 - Train, fine-tune, validate, and further develop models built in-house at Hume and models developed by our customers

 - Design evaluation protocols and benchmarks that measure model quality, generalization, robustness, and progress against research objectives

 - Analyze datasets, model outputs, and failure cases; compare training approaches and use the evidence to guide the next round of model development


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of experience with a minimum of 3+ in AI/ML engineering or research

 - Prior experience post-training and deploying LLMs in production environments

 - Fluency in Python and modern ML tooling (training, evaluation, inference, data pipelines)

 - Track record of taking research ideas from prototype → reliable, measurable production impact

 - Strong experimental judgment: formulating hypotheses, establishing useful baselines, designing evaluations, and interpreting results carefully

 - (Bonus) Prior experience utilizing and improving speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS) models, and/or duplex models

A PhD is not required. We value demonstrated research ability and the quality of the models, experiments, and systems you have helped build.




BENEFITS & PERKS FOR ASSORTIES

 - 💸 Competitive Compensation – Including salary and employee stock options so you share in our success.

 - 📚 Lifelong Learning – Annual budget for professional development, plus training opportunities to help you grow.

 - 💻 Office Setup Stipend – We’ll outfit your in-office workspace so comfy as it's productive.

 - 🩺 Top-Tier Health Coverage – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, because your health comes first.

 - 🏖 Flexible PTO – We trust you to take the time you need to recharge and come back ready to crush it.

 - 🥗 Meals & Snacks – Lunch, dinner, and snack breaks that fuel great ideas.

 - 💪 Fitness Stipend – Your wellness matters. We reimburse monthly membership costs to support your health.

 - 🚆 Commuter Benefits – We cover eligible transportation costs to make your trip to work easier.

 - 👵 401(k) – Build your retirement savings.
   
   


HOW WE WORK & WHAT WE VALUE

Our team at Assort Health moves fast, stays focused, and is fueled by a desire to serve our customers and patients. Our company values guide how we work—they are present in how we show up, make decisions and work together to move our mission forward. We bring a Day One Drive, relentlessly striving to improve, keep a 5-Star Focus, as our customers are our lifeblood, always Answer the Call, remembering that ownership and accountability are paramount, and show up with One Pulse, because we are one team, with one rhythm and one result. Our team is growing and we are looking for motivated, hardworking, and passionate talent. If you want to make healthcare accessible for everyone, we’d love to hear from you!

Please note: the Assort Health Talent Team will only email you from an assorthealth.com http://assorthealth.com email address.

jobs.title: Trader
jobs.description:
Wormhole Labs builds Sunrise (sunrise.xyz http://sunrise.xyz), a platform that helps token issuers launch and list their tokens on Solana. To date, we've orchestrated the launch of 100+ assets on Solana, accounting for more than $10 billion in cumulative trading volume.

As a Trader, you'll develop and run strategies for tokenized equities, pricing and hedging risk across onchain markets and traditional brokerage venues. You'll be responsible for managing capital and writing the code that puts your strategies into production. This is a hybrid trading and engineering role.

What you will do

 - Develop and run RFQ-based trading strategies for tokenized spot equities: set parameters such as buffers, spreads, and size limits, while optimizing for evolving business goals.

 - Price instruments where reference prices are thin or stale, such as long-tail stocks and extended and overnight sessions.

 - Measure execution quality: benchmark fills against references, analyze markouts, and turn what you find into strategy improvements.

 - Monitor positions, inventory levels and P&L in real time; proactively flag risks, execute adjustments, and continuously improve tooling & monitoring.

 - Integrate with traditional brokerage venues and onchain programs to fill trades and rebalance inventory.

What we're looking for

 - 4+ years trading at a market maker, OTC desk, prop firm or brokerage, with professional experience specifically trading spot equities.

 - Experience developing RFQ systems.

 - A rigorous approach to risk management: you track exposure, hedge thoughtfully, and escalate early when conditions shift.

 - Self-directed and adaptable: you're comfortable operating with autonomy in a remote-first environment.

 - Strong analytical and software engineering skills (e.g. Rust)

We provide

 - Competitive salary and restricted token units, dependent on position type and location.

 - Unlimited time off, healthcare premium reimbursement, and 401K.

 - Top-of-the-line MacBook Pro laptop.

 - Flexibility of working from wherever you have work authorization, as long as you can work 10-6PM US Eastern Time. We minimize unnecessary meetings, but building decentralized systems requires synchronous communication.

jobs.title: Investor Relations Manager, Capital Markets & Strategic Research
jobs.description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI? 

Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $700M in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. 

We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.

About the role:

We are looking for an Investor Relations Manager, Capital Markets & Strategic Research to build and deepen Higgsfield’s relationships across investment banks, equity research, institutional investors, and the broader capital markets ecosystem.

This is not a traditional IR role focused on quarterly earnings, filings, or maintaining an investor database. As a private, fast-growing AI company, our goal is to establish Higgsfield as a primary source of insight for the financial community on Creative AI and the transformation of the broader creative economy.

You will build relationships with the analysts, bankers, and investors shaping how emerging technology categories are understood, helping ensure they have the data, context, and access needed to understand the size of the market and Higgsfield’s position within it.

The goal is not paid placement. It is to build the relationships and credibility that lead analysts to independently recognize Higgsfield as one of the companies defining the Creative AI category.

What you'll do:

 - Build and manage relationships with investment bankers, equity and thematic research analysts, institutional and private-market investors, hedge funds, and other influential members of the capital markets ecosystem.

 - Establish a systematic engagement program with research teams at leading investment banks.

 - Develop a regular cadence of analyst briefings, executive conversations, and relationship-building across Wall Street.

 - Track relevant research covering Creative AI, generative video, the creator economy, advertising, media, AI infrastructure, and adjacent markets.

 - Make Higgsfield a trusted resource for analysts by providing market intelligence, data, executive access, and informed perspectives on how AI is transforming creative industries.

 - Educate analysts and bankers on the size and structure of the Creative AI opportunity and why the relevant TAM extends across multiple large existing industries.

 - Identify upcoming sector reports and research initiatives where Higgsfield can provide insight and contribute to the underlying investment thesis.

 - Create opportunities for earned inclusion of Higgsfield in thematic and sector research.

 - Identify opportunities to collaborate on or co-commission credible research examining Creative AI and the transformation of the creative economy, while maintaining a clear distinction between sponsored research and independent analyst coverage.

 - Partner with Higgsfield leadership, communications, and finance to develop the data, market frameworks, benchmarks, and narratives needed to explain the category.

 - Track analyst and banking relationships, engagements, relevant reports, upcoming research themes, and resulting outcomes.

 - Build a deliberate strategy for converting relationships into tangible outcomes rather than treating relationship-building itself as the objective.

Requirements:

 - 3–6+ years of experience in investor relations, investment banking, equity research, capital markets communications, strategic financial communications, or a closely related field.

 - Strong understanding of how Wall Street research is produced and how relationships with analysts and investment banks are built.

 - Ability to discuss TAM, industry structure, competitive positioning, and technological disruption with sophisticated financial audiences.

 - Ability to translate a fast-moving technology story into a credible capital markets thesis without turning it into marketing language.

 - Highly relationship-driven while remaining focused on measurable outcomes.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work closely with senior executives and cross-functional teams.

 - Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where the category, company, and market narrative are evolving quickly.

*Nice to have:

 - Existing relationships across investment banks, equity research analysts, institutional investors, or the broader capital markets community.

 - Experience covering or working within AI, technology, internet, media, advertising, the creator economy, or high-growth private technology companies.

 - Experience working with thematic or sector research and understanding how emerging technology categories become incorporated into broader investment theses.

 - Experience helping position a private, high-growth company with sophisticated financial audiences.
   

Compensation & Benefits

 - We offer a competitive and thoughtfully structured compensation package designed to align with impact, experience, and long-term growth.

 - Base Salary: The anticipated salary range for this role is $175,000 - $240,000, depending on experience, skills, scope, and location.

 - Bonus: This role is Bonus eligible and may participate in the Company's discretionary annual bonus program.

 - Equity: In addition to cash compensation, employees are eligible to participate in the company’s stock option program and share in Higgsfield’s long-term growth.

 - Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees professionally and personally, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a competitive 401(k) retirement plan with company matching, and additional benefits and perks.

 - The opportunity to work on ambitious AI products alongside a highly experienced, fast-moving, and international team.

 - Significant ownership, direct impact, and opportunities for professional growth as the company scales.

This is a hybrid role based in the San Francisco Bay Area. Team members are expected to work from our San Francisco office three full days per week, with the remaining days worked remotely and are expected to be available during agreed working hours and to maintain sufficient overlap with the relevant team’s time zone. We value in-person collaboration, active communication, responsiveness, and close partnership across teams.

Higgsfield AI is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.description:
HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

SG 9

This is an entry-level field sales position designed to lay the groundwork for a successful, long-term career with Continental, a global leader in future mobility solutions. The initial assignment will involve a six-month (predominately virtual) training program that provides a comprehensive understanding of the tire industry, our company, our sales strategy, and our customers. The training program will include extensive exposure to different departments across the Continental organization, opportunities to actively contribute while learning through special project assignments, participation in sales and management courses offered by the leading third-party training providers, and when conditions allow, travel with our current field sales managers to gain hands-on experience.

Upon successful completion of the training program, field sales coordinators can look forward to:

• Territory assignment in a major U.S. market plus a relocation package to cover the costs of moving
• Graduation bonus
• Company car and gas card
• Corporate credit card for all travel and business expenses
• Increased earning potential through Continental’s Sales Incentive Bonus Program on top of a competitive base salary
• The field sales coordinator position offers a significant amount of responsibility and independence compared to other entry-level roles. This autonomy is paired with the support, mentorship, and resources needed to ensure not only sales success, but also professional and personal growth for each coordinator.
• Achieve incremental annual sales growth in assigned territory by building relationships with and supporting Continental’s retail and/or wholesale customers
• Conduct regular in-person meetings and training with existing Continental customers to grow share of account
• Analyze customer and market conditions in assigned territory to identify sales opportunities
• Assist sales managers in the development and execution of sales strategy within geographic areas of responsibility
• Determine weekly travel schedule based on territory sales strategy and individual goals
• Ensure the success of product launches and consumer promotions through effective communication and coordination of digital and point-of-sale marketing materials with customers
• Plan and attend customer events such as NCAA Basketball games, Major League Soccer games, and BMW Performance Driving School

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE ROLE

• Bachelor's degree or completion of a Bachelor's degree by August 2027
• Must be open to relocation within 6-8 months of start date - once the training program is completed you will be required to relocate to a major U.S. market. (Recent territory assignments have included Los Angeles, CA, New York, NY, Washington, D.C., and Dallas, TX, etc.).
• Ability to travel over 50%
• Valid Driver's License
• Thrives in new and dynamic settings
• Assumes ownership and responsibility for individual contributions
• Has a passion for working with diverse teams to deliver results
• Legal authorization to work in the U.S is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas now or in the future for this job opening.
• A relocation package is offered

ADDITIONAL WAYS TO STAND OUT

• Bachelor's degree in Sales, Business, Marketing, or Communications
• Sales related internship experience

• Immediate Benefits
• Paid Time Off
• Tuition & Employee Discounts

• Company Vehicle
• Employer 401(k) Match

We’re hiring full-time, part-time, and PRN PTAs who are passionate about helping patients recover movement and return to the activities they love.
