jobs.title: Incident Response Manager - Privacy
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Anthropic is working on frontier AI systems that handle sensitive information at enormous scale. How we protect that data, and how we build privacy into our systems rather than bolting it on afterward, is central to our mission of building AI that is safe and beneficial.

We’re looking for an experienced Technical Program Manager to own and evolve incident management within the privacy team. This is a senior-level specialization on the Technical Program Manager ladder, focused on how we detect, respond to, and learn from privacy incidents. These incidents involve personal data subject to GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA and similar laws, and to the contractual commitments Anthropic makes to its customers.

You’ll be the driving force behind maturing and scaling our incident response lifecycle, from detection and triage through containment, remediation, and post-incident review. Critically, some of the highest-impact work in this role happens after the immediate response: gathering data on incident trends, reporting on patterns and root causes, and working cross-functionally across engineering, security, infrastructure, and product teams to ensure that broad fixes and systemic improvements are actually implemented. You will partner closely with Privacy Legal on notifiability and communications, and with the Privacy Program team on executive and board reporting; this role owns the engineering-side programme, its metrics and its follow-through.

You won’t just manage incidents: you’ll make sure we get meaningfully better after each one.

Key responsibilities

• Own the end-to-end privacy incident management program: detection workflows, response processes, escalation paths, communication standards, and remediation tracking.

• Serve as incident commander for privacy incidents, driving clear coordination across executive, engineering, security, legal, and other appropriate stakeholders.

• Establish and run incident commander rotations within privacy, ensuring clear ownership and effective coordination during incidents of varying severity.

• Drive post-incident accountability by defining how action items are captured, assigned, tracked, and completed across teams, ensuring follow-through on both tactical fixes and strategic improvements.

• Gather, analyze, and report on incident trends and patterns to surface systemic risks, recurring root causes, and areas where the organization is most vulnerable.

• Translate trend analysis into actionable cross-functional initiatives: partner with engineering, infrastructure, security, and product teams to prioritize and implement broad fixes and preventive improvements that address root causes rather than symptoms.

• Lead incident review forums (post-mortems, retrospectives) and ensure learnings are captured, socialized, and acted upon across the organization.

• Partner with Privacy Legal on breach and notifiability assessments against regulatory timelines, coordinate customer and regulator communications when required, and keep privileged and non-privileged records appropriately separated.

• Develop and maintain privacy incident response documentation, playbooks, runbooks, and training materials; keep them current as our products, data flows and obligations evolve.

• Partner with detection engineering to improve alert fidelity, reduce noise, and shorten time-to-detection for privacy events.

• Define, develop, and track incident management KPIs and report regularly to leadership.

• Support broad cross-functional training and initiatives to uplevel privacy awareness across the company (e.g. Tabletop exercises, training, talks).

Minimum qualifications

• Have led or built incident response programs at a technology company, ideally in a high-growth or security-intensive environment.

• Have a demonstrated track record of turning incident data into organizational improvements: not just writing post-mortems, but driving the cross-functional work to implement systemic fixes.

• Are comfortable participating in on-call responsibilities and leading incident response during high-severity privacy events, including off-hours.

• Have experience building and scaling operational processes from the ground up in environments where structure didn’t previously exist.

• Excel at driving accountability and follow-through across multiple teams without direct authority—you know how to influence, track, and close the loop.

• Have strong analytical skills and experience with incident trend analysis, metrics reporting, and data-driven prioritization.

• Are highly organized with a knack for bringing structure to ambiguous, fast-moving situations.

• Have excellent communication skills, especially under pressure and when coordinating across technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executive leadership.

• Thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities shift and you’re often working with incomplete information.

Preferred qualifications

• Have 7+ years of experience in technical program management, incident management, or security/privacy operations, with significant time spent in an incident response context.

• Are familiar with privacy regulation and breach-notification obligations (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA or similar) and comfortable working with legal counsel under privilege, or have a legal background.

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$1—$2 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. jobs.title: Market Associate
jobs.description:
At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.



What we do...

Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.



That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.



About the Sales Market Associate role...

The Market Associate is responsible for selling SiteMinder’s products to customers and completing business development activities in an effort to acquire new customers. 

This is a junior-mid level role that gives you the opportunity to launch your career in the fast-growing hospitality technology sales space.



What you’ll do…

 - Source opportunities and canvass potential clients via cold calling and respond to all incoming product inquiries, referrals and leads in a timely and effective manner

 - Maintain regular contact with prospective clients and new accounts

 - Achieve sales KPIs and targets, finalising all sales in a timely manner

 - Prepare accurate quotes and develop and present proposals to clients in a professional and confident manner. 

 - Negotiate contracts as required, maintaining a balance between optimal service and value for the client and SiteMinder's profit margins

 - Maintain accurate records of your business development activities on SiteMinder's CRM system

 - Manage the accounts of new clients to maintain satisfaction until they are passed on to a dedicated Onboarding Success Team or a dedicated Account Manager

 - Provide client feedback on products to the Product Team so that products can be reviewed in line with the feedback

 - Coordinate and arrange client events, meetings and demos

 - Create and maintain client databases and mail lists

 - Continue learning about yourself and adding to your skill bank with our career growth, development and progression plans



What you have…

 - Candidates must be located in Bali or within commutable distance 

 - You will be confident, personable and eager to successfully hit your sales goals

 - Eager to learn and takes on feedback constructively

 - Have a basic understanding of how to achieve sales targets and manage business development activities

 - Ability to work autonomously from home 

 - Fluent verbal and written communication skills in Indonesian

 - Fluent verbal and written communication in English as it is necessary for communication with managers and colleagues

 - An aptitude and eagerness to learn our sales process and products

 - Experience using a CRM system is highly preferred but not essential
   
   

Our Perks & Benefits…

- Remote working model (from Bali)

- Mental health and well-being initiatives

- Paid birthday, study and volunteering leave every year

- Sponsored social clubs, team events, and celebrations

- Employee Resource Groups (ERG) to help you connect and get involved 

- Investment in your personal growth offering training for your advancement

Think this role sounds like you? If so, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your resume and our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.

 

When you apply, feel free to share your pronouns and let us know if you need any adjustments during the interview process, we’re here to support you. We also warmly encourage applications from people from underrepresented backgrounds.

jobs.title: Technical Project Management Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today, Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe— large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military. With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts.

Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization. Astranis has raised over $750 million from some of the world’s best investors, from Andreessen Horowitz to Blackrock and Fidelity, and employs a team of 450 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

Technical Project Management Intern (Summer 2027)

Internships at Astranis typically last for twelve weeks, and are hourly roles designed for students who are currently enrolled at a four-year university.

As our Technical Project Manager Intern, you will support programs to ensure success and timely delivery. This will include, but is not limited to assisting program schedules, risk management, and key stakeholder interactions.

If you have already graduated from a four-year university, please apply to for the Associate position.

Role

• Support programmatics from concept to completion for projects ranging from small internal R&D efforts to complete multi-spacecraft missions.

• Run risk management processes for projects including encouraging generation of risk documentation when needed, tracking of burndown plans, and coordinating approvals of risk closure

• Facilitate and streamline headcount tracking and forecasting.

• Plan and organize periodic internal program reviews including trending schedule, risk, and key program requirements

• Work with engineers to develop schedules for various subsystems and boxes

Requirements

• B.S. in aerospace engineering, or equivalent technical degree (e.g. physics or applied math)

• Strong communication skills, both internal and external facing

• Strong organizational skills and ability to coordinate across different tracks and groups

• Proven ability to work in a fast paced environment, overcome obstacles with creative solutions, and clearly document/communicate tactical plans

• Ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize

Bonus

• Leadership in university programs, clubs, or technical projects

• Space system experience

• Hardware experience

• Familiarity with Smartsheet, Jira, and Confluence

• Strong Excel or Google sheet skills, including use of formulas, pivot tables, V-lookups, and basic data cleansing

The base pay for this position is $29.00 per hour.

Base Hourly Pay

$29—$29 USD

U.S. Citizenship, Lawful Permanent Residency, or Refugee/Asylee Status Required

Our mission and products are built for everyone, regardless of gender, race, creed, or background. We believe in a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we invite all people to join our team and bring their unique perspectives to make us stronger.

jobs.description:

This position is responsible for all phases of receipt, movement, storage, tracking, and shipment of service materials and tools required for field service and order fulfillment.   Job duties include: materials transactions using SAP and trouble-shooting; perform document and reconcile inventory cycle counts; manages interfaces with delivery carriers; and facilitates support of daily service operations throughout the warehouse.  Provides guidance and trains peer members of logistics team; able to independently audit processes and procedures for compliance.

Roles and Responsibilities:

• Provides guidance and training to logistics coordinator in methods and requirements for put-away, 3rd party warehouse replenishment, FRU order fulfillment, and shipments worldwide
• Ensure timely shipment of all outbound FRU shipments to meet contractual obligations and customer requirements
• Work with customs brokers and freight forwarders to resolve import/export operational issues
• Able to provide backup to Lead / Supervisor(s) during their absence

• Able to resolve receiving and shipping issues
• Reviews shortages for root cause and corrective action problem solving
• Able to process FRU orders for domestic (U.S.) and international customers
• Manage international shipping documentation requirements

• Able to train in use of business operations software to record and trouble-shoot data Lead projects for warehouse safety and housekeeping continuous improvement per 5S principles

• Train and certify for use of material handling (fork lift and pallet jack) equipment per policy and procedures; audit safety inspections of equipment
• Contributing member of cross-functional teams that target continuous improvements for materials management
• Maintain an excellent attendance record
• Follow all corporate, regulatory, safety policies and procedures
• Perform other projects or duties as assigned.
• Meet departmental goals/objectives

Skill/Job Requirements:

In order to adequately perform the responsibilities of this position the individual must:

• Possess high school diploma, AA degree preferred
• Possess prior warehouse (2 to 5 years) or experience in all aspects of receiving, shipping, and manufacturing operations support
• Inventory management experience (cycle counts, physical inventory)
• Prior ability to audit process issues and lead project teams
• Prior medical industry experience
• Prior experience and/or certification in operating material handling equipment
• Ability to lift 35 pounds frequently each day
• Extensive walking and repetitive physical motion (squatting, bending, lifting) is required (at least 70% of hours worked)
• Clean driving record (no violations)
• Able to demonstrate accuracy and thoroughness in completing work assignments while complying with verbal and written instructions
• Able to work at the lead level of expertise
• Prior computer experience (including MS Office products and ERP systems) preferably SAP and Agile.
• Process shipments using FedEx Ship Manager
• Knowledge of kanban systems and other lean material handling principles
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Highly customer and service focused

jobs.title: Vertical Sales Lead, Health Systems
jobs.description:
About Doctronic

Doctronic is the #1 AI doctor. Our AI is free, anonymous and HIPAA-compliant, and it has delivered over 30 million consults to date. In December 2025 we became the first and only AI legally authorized to practice medicine, renewing prescriptions autonomously under Utah's AI Learning Lab, and the first AI ever granted medical malpractice insurance. We are live in all 50 states and DC with AI and human physicians available 24/7, and we have raised $65M through our Series B from Abstract, Lightspeed, Union Square Ventures and others.

We are now building the enterprise organization that takes this to health plans, health systems and the wider healthcare ecosystem. This is one of the first senior sales hires on that team.


The Role

You will own the health systems vertical end to end: the pipeline, the relationships, the narrative, and the number. Academic medical centers, integrated delivery networks, community health systems, and multi-specialty provider groups.

This is a fulltime role at a company where the product is genuinely new, so you will spend as much time teaching the market what autonomous clinical AI can do as you will running a process. You will report to the Chief Business Officer and work alongside our Chief Medical Officer, who carries the clinical credibility that opens these rooms.


What You'll Do

 - Own pipeline generation and closed contract value for the health systems vertical, with a target of at least four opportunities in contracting or later at any time

 - Build the health system narrative and buyer persona map: cost of care, patient access and capacity, patient engagement, quality measures, and performance in value-based arrangements

 - Run the full cycle, sourcing with business development and marketing, scoping the integration with solutions engineering, and closing with the deal desk

 - Navigate health system procurement and compliance, including security review, diligence questionnaires, corporate practice of medicine considerations, and BAA and DUA negotiation

 - Work with our Chief Medical Officer and research team to turn clinical evidence into health system-ready economic packages

 - Partner with implementation before signature so that what you sell is what we can deliver, on the timeline you committed to

 - Feed vertical requirements into the enterprise product roadmap, and push back on one-off builds that will not repeat

 - Grow accounts after launch alongside customer success, because expansion inside a health system matters more to us than net-new logos
   

What We're Looking For

 - 10+ years selling into health systems, including multi-year enterprise contracts you personally closed and carried a number against

 - Verifiable relationships with health system economic buyers: chief medical officers, VPs of clinical operations and network, and digital health or innovation leaders

 - Fluency in health system economics and the vocabulary that goes with it: cost per case, DRG reimbursement, bundled payments, shared savings, risk-based arrangements, and value-based contracting

 - A track record of selling clinical credibility rather than features, and the judgment to know which evidence a given buyer actually needs

 - Comfort selling a product that is still moving, in a category that regulators are still defining

 - Willingness to travel heavily. Our enterprise buyers do not buy over video alone

 - Based in New York City or willing to relocate. This is a hybrid role
   

Nice to Have

 - Sold AI, digital health or virtual care into health systems specifically

 - Worked inside a health system, on the buying side of a deal like this one

 - Familiarity with CMS models and care management programs such as ACCESS, APCM, CCM and TCM

 - Experience with co-branded or digital front door deployments inside a health system's patient experience

 - Early-stage experience, ideally as one of the first sellers in a vertical
   

Compensation & Benefits

 - Base salary range: $225-$275k + commission of up to 50% of base

 - Meaningful equity

 - Health reimbursement allowance, support for well-being, and flexible time off

jobs.title: Manager, Loads & Dynamics
jobs.description:
At REGENT, we’re on a mission to revolutionize regional transportation between coastal cities. We're not just building vehicles, we're creating a new category of transportation: the Seaglider. These groundbreaking wing-in-ground-effect craft travel just above the water’s surface, combining the speed of an airplane with the low operating costs of a boat. Capable of 180 miles at 180 mph on today's battery tech (and up to 400 miles with next-gen batteries), Seagliders will unlock fast, affordable, and sustainable coastal transit for passengers and cargo - connecting cities, islands, and communities like never before.

Backed by leading investors and powered by a team of passionate, forward-thinking engineers, builders, and operators, we’re now scaling from a breakthrough prototype to full production - and building the team to make it happen.



ROLE OVERVIEW:

As the Manager, Loads & Dynamics, you will build and lead the function that defines the forces our vehicles must withstand - and ensures those definitions are technically sound, internally consistent, and certifiable.

This role sits at the foundation of vehicle integrity. You’ll establish the methodologies, assumptions, and datasets that drive structural design, inform flight physics, and underpin certification. Today, these responsibilities are distributed across teams; your role is to bring them into a coherent, defensible system.

You’ll start as a player-coach: setting direction, doing hands-on technical work, and building the team over time. You’ll work across Structures, Flight Physics, and Certification to align on a single source of truth for loads - resolving ambiguity, closing gaps, and ensuring the program is built on a solid and scalable foundation.

Success in this role means the organization is operating from a single, trusted loads basis - clearly defined, consistently applied, and ready to support both structural design and certification - supported by a strong, scalable Loads & Dynamics team you’ve built and developed.

If you’re energized by working at the intersection of cutting-edge innovation, real-world impact, and hands-on engineering, you’ll be in the right place - and we’d be thrilled to have you on the team!




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Build and Lead the Loads & Dynamics Function: Establish the team from the ground up - defining standards, operating cadence, and technical expectations - while hiring, mentoring, and developing engineers. Act as a player-coach, contributing directly while scaling the team.

 - Define the Vehicle Loads Basis: Develop a coherent, traceable set of load cases across all operating modes and environmental conditions. Establish the operating envelope and ensure loads assumptions are consistent, controlled, and clearly communicated across the program.

 - Own Dynamics and Aero/Hydroelastic Approach: Define how the program addresses flutter risk, modal behavior, and dynamic response, including analysis methods, GVT strategy, and how coupling effects are incorporated into loads and verification.

 - Establish Loads Validation and Integration: Define how simulation, structural models, and test data come together. Build the processes for CFD-to-loads mapping, FEM integration, and correlation between predicted and measured loads.

 - Enable Certification Through Defensible Methods: Develop the compliance approach for loads and dynamics, including assumptions, traceability, and required evidence. Produce certification-ready artifacts and support technical discussions with regulators and classification bodies.

 - Drive Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Structures and Flight Physics to define clear interfaces, resolve gaps, and maintain a single source of truth for loads across the organization.
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - Deep Loads & Dynamics Expertise: Significant experience defining loads for complex aerospace, maritime, or hybrid vehicles, including ownership of load cases used for structural design and certification.

 - Experience Building or Owning a Vehicle Loads Basis: You’ve led or directly contributed to a Vehicle Loads Document (or equivalent), with clear traceability to requirements and use in substantiation and/or certification.

 - Leadership and Team-Building Experience: Proven ability to lead technical teams - setting direction, mentoring engineers, and building a high-performing group. You’re comfortable operating as both a hands-on contributor and a manager, especially in early-stage or scaling environments.

 - Strong Foundation in Aeroelasticity and Structural Dynamics: Experience with flutter risk identification, modal analysis, dynamic response, and test planning (e.g., GVT), and how these influence loads definition.

 - Experience in Regulated, Certification-Driven Environments: Familiarity working with certification or classification bodies (FAA, EASA, Lloyd’s Register, or similar), including developing compliance approaches and supporting technical discussions.

 - Fluency in Loads Workflows and Toolchains: Strong understanding of CFD-to-loads mapping, integration with FEM/FEA tools (e.g., Nastran), and how loads outputs are consumed by Structures.

 - Validation and Correlation Mindset: Experience tying together simulation, analysis, and test data into a coherent validation strategy, including model calibration and documentation for defensibility.

 - Clear and Effective Communication: Able to translate complex loads and dynamics concepts into clear, actionable insights for cross-functional teams, leadership, and external stakeholders.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 - Collaborative Team Player: You believe that great things happen when teams work together. You partner effectively across engineering, certification, and leadership to align on requirements, risk, and execution. You bring clarity to complex discussions and ensure teams are working from a shared understanding of system behavior and certification goals.

 - Creative Problem Solver: You thrive on tackling complex, system-level challenges and bringing structure to ambiguity. You don’t just react to gaps - you identify where assumptions, models, or processes are breaking down and build scalable solutions that improve how the organization defines and uses loads.

 - Adaptable & Agile: In a fast-paced, evolving environment, you balance rigor with speed. You know when to introduce structure and when to simplify, helping the team move forward without losing sight of safety and certification requirements. You remain calm and decisive in the face of uncertainty.

 - Innovative Mindset: You’re driven by curiosity and a passion for building safe, high-performance systems. You continuously look for ways to improve loads methodologies, toolchains, and cross-team workflows - raising the bar for how the organization understands and manages physical risk.




WHAT WE OFFER:

 - Competitive compensation including a robust equity incentive plan to reward your contributions to our success.

 - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance - we cover 100% of your premiums (including dependents!).

 - 401(k) with company matching, so you can plan for the future.

 - Generous flexible time off, paid parental leave, and company-wide holiday breaks.

 - Relocation packages available for those moving to join our team.

 - Daily, free catered lunches

 - Learning & professional development opportunities with the chance to make a direct impact on the company’s growth and success.
   
   

If you’re ready to take on an exciting challenge, grow with us, and make a lasting impact, we want to hear from you. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, but you see yourself contributing to our mission, we encourage you to apply! We value diverse skillsets and experiences and believe in the potential of passionate individuals to make a big impact.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer (Robotics)
jobs.description:
The Company
We believe general-purpose, generally-intelligent robots will be built in our lifetimes. Robots will work in our factories, move our goods, walk on our streets and eventually be in our homes. To build that future, research and deployment must work in lockstep: real-world operation must make the technology better and better technology must make deployment easier. We're looking for the thinkers, builders, and researchers who want to be part of that loop.
As an AI robotics company that deploys its inventions directly into the facilities that need them, on state-of-the-art hardware, every line of code written at Tutor has a direct impact on the global, physical economy.
Our Culture
We believe that something truly special can happen when talented, motivated people work together; at Tutor, every member of our team is empowered to have real impact in everything that they do. We're characterized by both technical excellence and next-level collaboration and respect.
About the Role
Our robots work in customer facilities with people nearby. The code that decides how an arm moves, how fast, and how it stops is what keeps those people safe. We're looking for a controls engineer to own it.
The work is controls: joint limits, speed limits, stopping distances and stopping times, contact and collision behavior, the loop that turns a motion command into torque, and the monitoring that detects when that loop misbehaves. It is also software work. The code lives in a large codebase that changes every week, and the safety-critical parts of it have to be written, organized, tested, and reviewed so they stay correct through those changes. The person we want has worked in a codebase where a mistake had physical consequences, has written and organized a lot of code there, and is comfortable with the physics underneath it.
You will build the hardware-in-the-loop test bench that runs the control code against real arms and real stop circuits, in continuous integration. You will also keep the evidence current: the measurements and tests that show the arm stops when it should, updated as the code, the arms, and the applications change.
The formal side of safety, risk assessments and the standards customers ask about, is part of the role. We will teach it.

About the Role:

As Associate, Standards & Brand Safety, your primary responsibility will be evaluating commercials and promotional materials to verify compliance with Tubi’s advertising policies and relevant legal standards. This role specifically requires working on Saturdays and Sundays throughout the year.

The Standards & Brand Safety team collaborates closely across functions, including Legal, Sales, Ad Operations, Content, and Content Operations, to support consistent application of company guidelines. In addition to advertising review, you will develop expertise in Tubi’s content standards and broader industry practices concerning original and acquired content.

The work schedule is Wednesday-Sunday. Candidates must have the ability and be willing to work Saturdays and Sundays throughout the year.

This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco, Los Angeles, or New York office. You must be willing to travel to the office 2 days/week.

What You'll Do:

• Interpret and apply Tubi’s advertising content policies to ads that run on the platform

• Interpret and apply Tubi’s content standards policies with regard to sexual, violent, and controversial content, including reviewing and recommending content for further evaluation or removal from the service

• Evaluate and substantiate marketing, scientific, and other data submitted by advertisers

• Coordinate with Sales, Ad Operations, Content, and Content Operations to ensure proper socialization of ad restrictions and relevant information

• Use internal tools to document and socialize findings to ensure that policies are consistently implemented

• Review original and acquired scripted and unscripted content at various stages of production; collaborate with Legal and Content Operations to help ensure content is consistent with Tubi standards, industry guidelines, and applicable ratings frameworks, including the TV Parental Guidelines

• Provide notes and recommendations when necessary

• Highlight policy issues that require further analysis or escalation

• Assist in improving operational workstreams by identifying challenges and offering practical solutions, including improvements to existing guidelines

• Stay current on streaming industry trends, including conducting analyses of competing streamers’ advertising and content Standards and Practices policies

Your Background:

• Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university

• 2+ years of professional experience in advertising compliance, advertising policy, trust & safety, content moderation, standards & practices, or a related policy enforcement role

• Demonstrated ability to interpret and apply written policies consistently while exercising sound judgment in ambiguous situations

• Must have the ability and willingness to work Saturdays and Sundays throughout the year

• Willingness to review all types of content and apply Tubi and legal standards without regard to personal beliefs

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Ability to communicate effectively with various internal teams, colleagues, managers, producers, and advertisers

• Excellent analytical skills with strong attention to detail

• Sound judgment with the ability to recognize when matters should be escalated

• Practical familiarity with AI tools and an interest in applying them to improve operational efficiency

• Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

• Ability to prioritize work effectively and make consistent decisions in a fast-paced environment

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, databases, and web-based tools

• Spanish language proficiency is a plus, but not required

• Experience in streaming, digital media, broadcast television, or online platform operations is a plus

• Self-starter who can work independently with limited supervision

#LI-MJ1

#LI-Hybrid

Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is listed annually below. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, long-term incentive plan, and various benefits including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents.

High cost labor markets such as but not limited to Los Angeles, New York City, and San Francisco

$59,800—$78,000 USD

This time is 100% paid through a combination of any applicable state, city, and federal leaves and wage-replacement programs in addition to contributions made by Tubi.

Boldly built for every fandom, Tubi is a free streaming service that entertains over 100 million monthly active users. jobs.title: Lab Robotics Research Associate
jobs.description:
About Plasmidsaurus

Plasmidsaurus is on a mission to accelerate new cures and promote a healthier planet by unlocking a new level of productivity for scientists. Our sequencing services are used daily by thousands of innovators, including Nobel laureates, Fortune 100 pharma, and over 70,000 scientists.



We began by revolutionizing plasmid sequencing, making it exponentially cheaper and faster, with innovative sequencing technologies and a global network of laboratories that turn samples into answers in hours, not weeks.



Now we are expanding that same disruptive model across all of genomics. With the launch of our new RNA-seq service, we are taking a bold step toward our vision to sequence everything, providing scientists everywhere with faster, simpler, and more affordable access to the data that powers discovery.



Every team member at Plasmidsaurus plays a crucial role in driving the future of biotech research. Together, we are building the world’s most efficient sequencing engine that operates overnight, scales globally, and helps scientists make breakthroughs faster than ever before.




OUR AUTOMATION TEAM

DNA sequencing is fundamental to a biologist’s daily workflow. Just like software engineers program computers in code, biologists program life in DNA - they do this every day. However, every time a biologist updates their DNA (via a chemical process), they have to sequence the DNA to make sure the update works. That’s where we come in!

We sequence DNA overnight (and same-day). We began by revolutionizing plasmid sequencing, making it exponentially cheaper and faster using innovating sequencing technologies, automation, and a global network of laboratories to turn samples into answers in hours instead of weeks. We’re expanded our disruptive model across all of genomics, starting with the launch of our new 3-day RNA-seq service. We made these processes up to 30 times cheaper and 10 times faster. We aren’t finished yet.

Scientists love this. https://x.com/yo_arfi/status/1912043897162695025




POSITION OVERVIEW

Our automation team plays a pivotal role in delivering top quality data to our customers at unbeatable speeds. As a Lab Robotics Research Associate at Plasmidsaurus, you will play a crucial role connecting our science with our robotics fleet. You will:

 - Develop and improve new lab automation protocols for 10,000s samples per day.

 - Build and optimize agentic tools that accelerate scientific research using our lab robotics fleet.

 - Measure and improve the performance of custom in-house automation hardware.

 - Modify, prototype and optimize custom 3D printed tools.

 - Work hand-in-hand with our world-class scientists to develop robust high throughput lab automation.
   
   


CULTURE

You will excel if you are someone who:

 - Enjoys working with physical objects.

 - Aspires to understand problems from first principles.

 - Enjoys high agency and high ownership work.

 - Is curious about learning from other people’s expertise in scientific/biological domains.

 - Is excited to make an impact on the scientific community, enabling the next generation of medicines, biotechnology, and even plant-based-meats!

 - Can lead projects from idea to production independently.

 - Is a life-long learner.

 - Values clear communication and helping others learn new skills.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS

 - BS or MS in Biology, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or relevant work experience.

 - 1+ yrs lab experience and familiarity with molecular biology protocols.

 - 1+ years of experience using using liquid handling systems (OpenTrons, Hamilton, etc.) and lab robotics.

 - 1+ years of experience programming in Python.

 - Experience using modern web frameworks like Flask/Django.

 - Experience with 3D printing (e.g., Fusion 360) and basic CAD modeling.

 - (Preferred) Experience working with Linux servers.

 - (Preferred) Some experience with C# and .NET frameworks for scripting automation equipment.

 - (Preferred) Interest in learning about biotechnology and DNA sequence analysis.
   
   


WHY PLASMIDSAURUS?

 - IMPACT: Your work will directly contribute to accelerating biotech research. This research is one of humanity’s most powerful tools for stopping climate change and developing novel therapies.

 - INNOVATION: Work on the cutting edge of biotech and software, introducing indispensable tools to top-tier researchers.

 - COMMUNITY: Join a passionate, resourceful team that values close, interactive relationships with our customers and each other.
   
   

We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly align with the job description as we seek out diverse and creative perspectives. Team members who love to learn and collaborate in an inclusive environment will thrive with us. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please let us know at careers@plasmidsaurus.com. careers@plasmidsaurus.com

Fortis Fire & Safety is looking for an experienced Contract Talent Sourcer to build strong candidate pipelines across our brands and branch locations, with a focus on skilled trades and field service roles. You'll develop sourcing strategies, engage passive and active candidates, conduct initial screening, and deliver qualified talent to our recruiters and hiring managers.

This is a full-time, on-site position based in our Schaumburg, IL office. Work is primarily performed at a computer in a standard office setting.

Important Notes for This Position:
As a temporary contract position, this role is not eligible for the medical, dental, vision, 401(k), disability, or other company benefits referenced in the standard compensation language below. It accrues paid leave under the Illinois Paid Leave for All Workers Act.

This position is performed in a standard office environment and involves extended periods of computer work. The physical and field requirements described in the standard language below, including lifting, climbing, kneeling, and field or construction conditions, do not apply to this role. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

• Develop sourcing strategies for hard-to-fill and recurring roles, including market mapping and competitor talent research

• Source candidates through job boards, professional networks, trade associations, referrals, and direct outreach

• Build and maintain talent pipelines for roles such as fire sprinkler fitters, fire alarm technicians, inspectors, and service personnel

• Write and send personalized outreach messages to engage passive candidates

• Conduct initial phone screens to confirm interest, availability, and qualifications

• Evaluate candidate certifications, licenses, and field experience against role requirements before handing off to recruiters

• Advise recruiters and hiring managers on talent availability, market conditions, and realistic candidate profiles

• Maintain accurate candidate records and sourcing activity in the applicant tracking system

• Track and report on sourcing metrics such as response rates and candidates submitted

• Follow company policy and applicable employment laws throughout sourcing and screening

Required Skills & Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience

• 3+ years of sourcing or full-cycle recruiting experience, with a proven track record of filling hard-to-find technical or skilled trades roles

• Strong candidate search and research skills, including advanced search techniques (such as Boolean search) across LinkedIn, job boards, and niche or trade-specific sourcing channels

• Demonstrated ability to engage passive candidates and deliver strong response and conversion rates

• Experience supporting high-volume or multi-location hiring across several hiring managers at once

• Ability to work independently with minimal ramp-up time

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in fire protection, life safety, or a related trade (such as sprinkler, fire alarm, suppression, electrical, low-voltage, or mechanical), either working in the field or recruiting for those roles

• Working knowledge of fire protection credentials and career paths, including NICET certifications, state fire marshal licensing, and union and merit-shop apprenticeship programs

$40—$60 USD

Physical activities can include reaching, bending, kneeling, climbing, and lifting up to 75 lbs. Field positions may involve heavy lifting, working in varying climates (including outdoor conditions), construction or low-voltage environments, and exposure to dust, noise, or confined spaces. Accounting Associate

Dalio Family Office

Dalio Family Office Overview:

The Dalio Family Office (DFO) supports Barbara and Ray Dalio and their family in their ventures, investments, and philanthropic efforts under Dalio Philanthropies, which includes OceanX, Dalio Education, Endless Network, and the Beijing Dalio Foundation. The core of the DFO’s culture is built around meaningful work and meaningful relationships and the family’s commitment to giving back. The office is headquartered in Westport, CT with regional offices in New York City, Singapore, and Abu Dhabi.

The Accounting Associate plays a key role in maintaining the financial health and integrity of the organization by managing core accounting operations, ensuring accurate financial reporting, and supporting audit and tax readiness. This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of critical accounting processes, support key projects, and drive continuous improvements across financial workflows. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and exercises sound judgment while partnering across the organization to enhance efficiency, strengthen controls, and support informed business decision-making.

Day-to-day responsibilities would include a combination of the following:

• Own and perform complex bookkeeping and accounting activities pertaining to business entities, including: Carry out day-to-day ledger functions within monthly close Maintain general ledgers for tax and financial reporting Prepare bank and credit card reconciliations Perform cash management functions Prepare and maintain information, analysis, and reports needed for tax return preparation

• Highly professional with the ability to manage confidential information with discretion

• Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and commitment to excellence

• Thrives in a fast-paced environment, balancing multiple priorities with accuracy and efficiency

• Detail-oriented with the ability to connect day-to-day work to broader business objectives

• Eager to learn, grow, and contribute within a high-performing, values-driven culture

Illustrative Benefits:

• 17 company paid holidays

• Friday summer hours

• Monthly community happy hours

• Hybrid work environment

• Free catered food services for in-office days

• Generous PTO offering

• Casual dress code

• 150% 401(k) match up to $7,500 and 100% match above $7,500 ($15k match limit)

• Gym reimbursement, back up childcare services, insurance, financial, and legal services, and much more!

• Experience working with computerized general ledger accounting software program (i.e. BlackBaud, Intacct, NetSuite, or comparable program preferred)

• Prior experience with a family office or individual with a high net worth is a plus

jobs.title: Primary Care Physician - Sign-On Bonus Available
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

Employment type:

• Full time

What you’ll be working on:

• Managing a patient panel with a broad array of patient needs; conducting a mix of acute, chronic, and well visits

• Treating patients in-office or in testing centers as well as conducting occasional tele-health visits

• Continuous learning during weekly Clinical Rounds and through other modalities

• Ongoing collaboration with in-office teammates via daily huddles, as well as with virtual clinical teams

• Utilization of your specific clinical training and opportunities to perform in-office procedures

• Supervising one or more NP or PA colleagues

• Willing to obtain additional state licensure and credentialing for One Medical virtual primary care in additional states

Education, licenses, and experiences required for this role:

• Enrolled in, or have completed, an accredited Family Medicine or Medicine/Pediatrics residency program

• Practiced at least 2 of the last 5 years in an outpatient primary care setting seeing all ages (0+)

• Board certified in Family Medicine or Medicine/Pediatrics, or Board Eligible with plans to obtain board certification within 1 year of your One Medical start date

• State licensed in CA, obtained before your One Medical start date

One Medical providers also demonstrate:

• A passion for human-centered primary care

• The ability to successfully communicate with and provide care to individuals of all backgrounds

• The ability to effectively use technology to deliver high quality care

• Clinical proficiency in evidence-based primary care

• The desire to be an integral part of a team dedicated to changing healthcare delivery

• An openness to feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into strengths and weaknesses

• The ability to confidently navigate uncertain situations with both patients and colleagues

• Readiness to adapt personal and interpersonal behavior to meet the needs of our patients

This is a full-time role based in Berkeley, CA at our University Avenue office.

One Medical is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

The base salary range for this role is $308,700 to $369,000 based on a full-time schedule. Final determination of starting pay may vary based on factors such as practice experience and patient care schedule. Additional pay may be determined for those candidates that exceed these specified qualifications and requirements. For more information, visit https://www.onemedical.com/careers/

Relocation assistance may be available for this role.

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

• Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

• Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

• PTO cash outs - Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year

Protecting your future for you and your family

• 401K match

• Credit towards emergency childcare

• Company paid maternity and paternity leave

• Paid Life Insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Basic Life Insurance

• Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%.

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• Continuing Medical Education (CME) - Receive an annual stipend for continuing medical education

• Rounds - Providers end patient care one hour early each week to participate in this shared learning experience

• Discounted rate to attend One Medical’s Annual REAL primary care conference

One Medical is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

One Medical participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.  Please refer to the E-Verification Poster and Right to Work Poster for additional information.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on  LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

WHO IS HUDSON ROUGE?

Hudson Rouge is an integrated luxury boutique marketing and communications agency within WPP that works solely on luxury brands and is the exclusive agency of record for the Lincoln Motor Company business across all channels. We combine brand strategy, media strategy, activation, digital, social, earned media, production, and analytics to provide exquisitely crafted creativity. We are a small group of people, spread across several offices — New York, Detroit, Shanghai, Toronto, Mexico City — and we care for each other as much as we care for our clients. We are an agency that prides itself on creating irrational desire for luxury brands, and we look for uniquely talented people who are excited about doing their best work and want to grow with us.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Account Director, Experiential leads overall agency services across experiential marketing accounts, brand activations, and strategic partnerships. This role is responsible for driving account growth, managing agency financial results, and directing the development of client engagement personnel through ongoing coaching in Marketing Excellence, Ownership, Intelligence, and Innovation.

Externally, the Account Director builds and maintains trusted relationships with senior client leadership, establishing Hudson Rouge as an industry leader in experiential marketing. The Account Director must be a proactive champion and innovative thinker for experiential marketing—serving as the practice’s biggest advocate both internally across agency disciplines and externally with senior client partners. Grounded in operational rigor and a deep understanding of the luxury automotive business, they relentlessly pursue creative excellence, shift brand perception, and drive measurable business impact.

What you'll do:

Strategic Client Leadership

• Lead the overall experiential media and activation strategy for a luxury automotive client, ensuring strategic alignment, flawless execution, and strong senior client partnerships.

• Proactively champion the strategic value of experiential marketing to senior clients, pitching innovative, forward-thinking concepts that elevate the brand and deliver superior business results.

• Serve as the primary senior client contact across experiential initiatives, establishing credibility through visionary leadership, sound judgment, and proactive communication.

• Drive account growth by expanding experiential capabilities, introducing emerging event technology, and securing groundbreaking brand partnerships.

• Maintain expert, forward-looking knowledge of the client’s business, luxury consumer behavior, automotive industry trends, and competitive landscape.

Experiential Program Leadership & Vision

• Drive innovative, outside-the-box thinking to conceptualize and execute unique experiential deliverables that achieve client business objectives and shift consumer perception to elevate the brand image.

• Lead the annual Go-To-Market (GTM) experiential strategy and activation roadmap, aligning event programs with Lincoln’s integrated multi-channel campaigns.

• Provide executive oversight across the full lifecycle of complex experiential programs, auto shows, brand partnerships, and high-touch consumer experiences.

• Maintain the highest standards of craft, production value, operational execution, and post-event ROI measurement.

• Proactively present strategic recommendations, new concepts, and activation innovations to senior client leadership.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Integration

• Champion experiential internally, inspiring and aligning cross-functional teams (Creative, Strategy, Media, PR, and Production) to integrate physical activations as a core pillar of brand campaigns.

• Direct vendor and supplier strategy, overseeing contract negotiations, budget compliance, and partner evaluation.

• Lead senior client briefings, inter-agency partner meetings, and executive strategy sessions.

Team Management & Development

• Supervise, mentor, and foster the career growth of account and project management personnel within the experiential team.

• Establish clear annual goals, conduct performance evaluations, and provide continuous coaching in luxury service delivery and strategic thinking.

• Promote a high-performance culture grounded in accountability, cross-functional collaboration, and creative excellence.

Operational & Financial Stewardship

• Establish process and timeline discipline, holding both internal teams and client partners accountable to milestone delivery dates.

• Understand operational workflows deeply enough to adapt or compress processes for aggressive deadlines, clearly communicating trade-offs, operational risks, and consequences to stakeholders.

• Own overall account financial performance, including revenue forecasting, monthly billing, staffing resourcing, and budget tracking.

• Manage workflow allocation and timeline feasibility across all active experiential workstreams.

• Keep the Group Account Director regularly informed on business status, growth opportunities, and executive escalation points

What you bring:

• Process Rigor & Adaptive Execution: Highly process- and timeline-oriented leader skilled at holding internal teams and client partners accountable to delivery dates; adept at flexibly restructuring workflows to meet aggressive deadlines while clearly advising on risks and operational trade-offs.

• Innovative Thinking & Brand Transformation: An outside-the-box creative thinker capable of conceiving unique, high-impact experiential deliverables that shift consumer brand perception and drive business results.

• Experiential Advocacy & Proactive Drive: A passionate, proactive advocate for experiential marketing who relentlessly drives results, pushes for creative excellence, and champions the discipline both internally across agency teams and externally with clients.

• Strategic Leadership & Growth: Strategic thinker with a proven track record of managing high-profile client accounts, driving business growth, and delivering measurable results.

• Experiential & Luxury Expertise: In-depth knowledge of experiential marketing, large-scale event production, automotive activations, luxury brand positioning, and immersive experience design.

• Integrated Agency Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional agency teams and align creative, strategy, media, public relations (PR), and production around unified activation goals.

• Financial & Operational Mastery: Solid financial management skills, including budget oversight, resource forecasting, and margin tracking.

• Executive Communication & Presentation: Polished, persuasive presenter and communicator capable of articulating strategic vision to senior client leadership.

• Problem-Solving & Agility: Calm and decisive under pressure, with strong crisis-management skills during live event executions.

What you'll need:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Marketing, Communications, Event Management, or a related field.

• Professional Experience: 8 to 12 years of progressive marketing experience in an agency or client-side setting, with a dedicated focus on experiential strategy, event production, and / or account management.

• Industry Focus: Experience working on luxury and/or automotive accounts is strongly preferred, including managing high-profile brand partnerships, auto shows, or lifestyle activations.

• Leadership Experience: Proven experience leading and developing account and project management teams in an integrated agency environment.

• Operational & Workplace Requirements: Ability to travel to event locations as needed for on-site support, with flexibility to work evenings and weekends during program execution.

This role will be based in our Detroit office.

jobs.title: Market Operations - Sports
jobs.description:
WHAT IS KALSHI?

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

 - Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

 - Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.


ROLE ROADMAP

In the Sports Operations function at Kalshi, you'll be a critical member ensuring our sports markets run flawlessly. The Sports Operations team is responsible for the precise execution of sports market listings, determinations, and maintaining the integrity of our sports prediction markets. 




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Execute the listing of sports markets with precision, ensuring all markets are properly configured and accurately reflect game conditions, player availability, and league rules. Make rapid determinations on market outcomes based on official league data, box scores, and verified sports sources while managing time-sensitive settlement windows.

 - Structure sports markets to capture the true axis of disagreement between traders, understanding the nuances between different contract types (spreads, totals, props, futures). Make strategic decisions about how to frame markets around games, seasons, player performances, and sporting events to maximize liquidity and trading interest.

 - Build out and prioritize the sports market listing pipeline across all major leagues (NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, NCAA) and international competitions. Balance pre-game, in-play, and futures markets while responding to breaking news like injuries, trades, and lineup changes that affect market demand and trading volumes.

 - Leverage deep understanding of how sportsbooks operate to identify market opportunities, understand edge cases in settlement scenarios, and ensure our markets capture the sophistication that sports traders expect. Navigate complex scenarios like postponements, player scratches, overtime rules, and stat corrections.

 - Maintain encyclopedic knowledge of league-specific rules, tiebreakers, playoff structures, and statistical definitions across all sports. Ensure markets are structured with airtight settlement criteria that account for sport-specific edge cases (rain delays, technical fouls, injury timeouts, VAR decisions, etc.).

 - Monitor live games and sports news across multiple leagues simultaneously, quickly responding to events that require market suspension, clarification, or settlement. Manage high-volume periods like NFL Sundays or March Madness with precision while multitasking across numerous concurrent events.

 - Work with structured, time-sensitive sports data feeds to ensure accurate market parameters, real-time updates, and proper settlement. Identify and resolve data discrepancies quickly to maintain market integrity.

 - Issue timely clarifications on sports markets when ambiguities arise (injury designations, weather impacts, rule interpretations), maintaining trader trust through clear, authoritative communications about sports-specific situations.

 - Work closely with Contracts, Product, and Engineering teams to implement sports-specific operational improvements, integrate new data sources, and expand our sports market offerings.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, business, sports management, mathematics, or a related field.

 - Encyclopedic knowledge of sports across multiple leagues with deep understanding of rules, playoff structures, tiebreakers, and statistical categories for NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, and major NCAA sports.

 - Extensive experience with sportsbooks – understanding how sportsbooks operate, common market types, settlement procedures, and the edge cases that arise in sports market operations.

 - Experience working with structured, time-sensitive sports data including real-time feeds, official league data sources, and sports statistics platforms.

 - Genuine passion for sports with the ability to follow multiple games simultaneously and stay current on player news, injuries, trades, and team dynamics across all major leagues.

 - Exceptional multitasking abilities to manage numerous live markets during peak periods while maintaining accuracy in high-pressure, time-sensitive situations.

 - Deep understanding of sportsbook nuances and edge cases including suspended games, protest outcomes, stat corrections, and unusual scoring scenarios that affect market settlement.

 - Strong analytical skills with the ability to quickly interpret box scores, game situations, and official rulings to make sound operational decisions.

 - Experience trading on Kalshi, sportsbooks, DFS platforms, or other prediction markets is strongly preferred.

 - Excellent written communication skills for drafting clear market clarifications on complex sports scenarios and settlement decisions.

 - Ability to work flexible hours including nights and weekends to cover live sporting events across different time zones.

 - Hardworking mentality with a commitment to operational excellence and the stamina to maintain focus during extended periods of live sports coverage.


NYC PAY TRANSPARENCY DISCLOSURE

Salary Range: $120,000 to $180,000 annually plus equity and benefits. This salary range is based on the current available market data, and represents the expected salary range for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and few titles, but has broad ranges of experience represented within roles. Should you have compensation expectations that exceed these bands, we'd love to hear from you and would welcome you to reach out to further discuss.


OUR CULTURE

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.




COMMITMENT TO EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Sourcer, GTM
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and create new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the gross domestic product of the internet, and we have a significant amount of work ahead. That means you have an opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing some of the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Recruiting team’s mission is to build Stripe’s teams by identifying and attracting people who can help us increase the gross domestic product of the internet. We work closely with business leaders to understand their goals, anticipate talent needs, and develop thoughtful hiring strategies.

As a Go-to-Market (GTM) Sourcer supporting the Americas, you’ll help grow teams across Sales. You’ll partner with recruiters and hiring leaders to understand each role, map relevant talent markets, engage prospective candidates, and build strong pipelines across the United States, Latin America, and Canada.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for a strategic, data-oriented Sourcer who can find and engage exceptional GTM talent in competitive and evolving markets. You’ll own the top-of-funnel strategy for a portfolio of roles, translating business needs into targeted sourcing plans and strong candidate pipelines.

You’ll combine market research, creative outreach, recruiting technology, and internal networks to reach prospective candidates. You’ll also provide recruiters and hiring leaders with clear insights into talent availability, pipeline health, and the changes needed to meet hiring goals.

Responsibilities

• Partner with recruiters and hiring leaders to understand hiring goals, role requirements, and the profiles most likely to succeed at Stripe.

• Develop and run sourcing strategies for GTM roles across Sales and Solutions Architecture.

• Identify, engage, and assess prospective candidates, then manage them through the initial stages of the recruiting process.

• Build broad candidate pipelines using direct sourcing, referrals, internal networks, talent communities, events, and other relevant channels.

• Conduct talent research and market mapping to assess talent availability, identify target companies and adjacent profiles, and inform hiring plans.

• Use qualitative and quantitative data to evaluate pipeline health, outreach performance, conversion, and sourcing effectiveness.

• Share clear market and pipeline insights with recruiters and hiring leaders, including risks, tradeoffs, and recommended changes to sourcing strategy.

• Build and maintain long-term relationships with prospective candidates, including talent who may be a fit for future opportunities.

• Test new sourcing approaches, tools, and outreach methods, then turn successful practices into repeatable processes.

• Partner with Talent Brand and other Recruiting teams on campaigns, events, and initiatives that expand awareness of Stripe’s opportunities.

• Deliver a thoughtful, responsive candidate experience that reflects Stripe’s values throughout the sourcing process.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements below. If you meet these requirements, we encourage you to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 3 or more years of sourcing or recruiting experience in a fast-paced environment, with experience building pipelines for GTM roles.

• Experience using sourcing and candidate relationship management tools, such as Gem and LinkedIn Recruiter, to identify and engage prospective candidates.

• Demonstrated ability to create sourcing strategies for competitive, specialized, or difficult-to-fill roles.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create personalized outreach and represent opportunities accurately and persuasively.

• Ability to build effective working relationships with recruiters, hiring managers, candidates, and senior stakeholders.

• Strong research and analytical skills, with experience using sourcing metrics and market information to identify trends and adjust strategy.

• Ability to prioritize and manage multiple candidate pipelines across roles, locations, and stages of the hiring process.

• Curiosity and a problem-solving mindset, including the ability to learn unfamiliar talent markets and develop creative approaches when established sourcing channels aren’t producing results.

• Flexibility to adjust priorities and sourcing plans as business needs and market conditions change.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience sourcing for GTM, specifically Sales and Solutions Architecture.

• Experience with applicant tracking systems such as Greenhouse or Lever.

• Familiarity with recruiting analytics, reporting tools, and talent-market research.

• Experience using events, talent communities, referrals, or brand campaigns to create new candidate pipelines.

• A track record of adopting new recruiting technologies and improving sourcing workflows at scale.
