jobs.title: Software Engineer, Data Access
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

We're looking for an outstanding engineer to join our Data Access team within Infra / Storage where we build EaaS (Entities-as-a-Service), Roblox’s large-scale managed OLTP access and management platform powering tens of millions of QPS across thousands of services. EaaS abstracts the complexity of distributed databases and caching systems behind a consistent and productive developer experience, enabling teams across Roblox to safely build and operate stateful systems at massive scale without requiring deep database expertise.

The team operates at the intersection of distributed systems engineering, reliability engineering, and platform architecture — solving hard infrastructure problems that directly impact Roblox-wide scale and stability.

You Will:

• Build and evolve EaaS, Roblox’s managed OLTP access platform powering tens of millions of QPS across hundreds of services.

• Design infrastructure that abstracts distributed databases and caching systems behind a consistent, safe, and highly productive developer experience.

• Drive reliability and scalability improvements across distributed systems, including adaptive flow control, workload isolation and governance, efficient database usage and large-scale caching behavior.

• Lead end-to-end technical execution architecture, implementation, rollout, production operations, and incident response for mission-critical infrastructure systems.

• Analyze real production traffic patterns and failure modes to improve platform reliability, operational predictability, and scalability under rapidly growing workloads.

• Improve platform safety, observability, deployment reliability, and operational excellence across the stack.

• Partner with teams across Roblox to solve real scalability and reliability challenges for critical production workloads.

You Have:

• 1+ years of experience building large-scale backend or infrastructure systems. An understanding of building systems that operate at high QPS with low-latency requirements is a plus. Experience working on infrastructure or performance-critical backend systems is a plus.

• Knowledge: You are proficient in one or more programming languages (C#, C++, Go, Python or similar programming language).

• Curiosity: You are curious and passionate about solving open-ended problems. You can identify challenges, develop a deep understanding of the systems involved, and drive solutions in collaboration with your team.

• Strong Teamwork: You are able to collaborate in cross-functional and cross team projects to deliver the most curated technical solution.

• Long-term Mindset: You are willing to take the long view to drive the collaboration and build the system.

jobs.description:
Ardent is seeking a Tier 3 System Administrator Lead to join our team.

This is an on-site position in Washington, D.C.

Position Description:

Ardent is seeking a Tier 3 System Administrator Lead to support the United States Holocaust Memorial Museum (USHMM) and the technology foundation behind its historically important mission.. Reliable systems, storage, backup, and cloud services are essential to the Museum’s work preserving Holocaust history, supporting education, and serving the public. The Tier 3 System Administrator Lead will be responsible for the end-to-end operational integrity, availability, maintenance, and recovery of the Museum’s server ecosystem. The position supports onsite operations to enable 24x7x365 enterprise escalation requirements.

Responsibilities and Duties:

• Lead administration, monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, and recovery for physical, virtual, and cloud-based Windows and Linux servers.

• Perform operating system patching, storage-capacity monitoring, hardware maintenance, critical-service restart and validation, backup verification, SSL certificate renewal, firmware and BIOS updates, and directed vulnerability remediation.

• Administer and troubleshoot VMware ESXi and vCenter environments, AWS EC2 and related cloud services, Microsoft SQL, MySQL, Oracle, certificate services, and Active Directory infrastructure within the assigned operational scope.

• Use advanced Linux and Windows administration skills, including shell scripting, to automate repeatable support activities and accelerate diagnosis and recovery.

• Support AWS operations including Linux EC2 lifecycle management, S3 administration, Route 53 records, VPC routing, Lambda monitoring, CloudWatch monitoring, and approved IAM execution.

• Deploy physical, virtual, and cloud servers; complete domain joins, IP and DNS registration, security baselines, backup policy association, documentation, and asset tagging.

• Operate backup, restore, and recovery services using Museum-supported platforms, including daily job review, restoration requests, annual disaster recovery exercises, bare-metal recovery, and runbook validation.

• Support storage platforms and services, including PowerScale, OneFS, Cohesity, S3, Glacier, Unity, and associated monitoring, access, capacity, firmware, and recovery activities.

• Provide data center hardware support, vendor RMA coordination, equipment and cable labeling, environmental and rack-capacity monitoring, and approved physical changes.

• Serve as technical lead for third-party hosted applications, vendor updates, secure remote access, certificates, domains, OS patching, and application-tier services such as IIS, Apache, or JBoss.

• Create and maintain accurate implementation, configuration, recovery, change, incident, and operational documentation; coordinate significant changes through Museum change-control processes.

• Provide Tier 3 escalation and after-hours support for incidents affecting critical infrastructure, including data center and AWS services.

Requirements:

• Expertise in Linux and Windows server administration and shell scripting.

• Demonstrated experience maintaining operational integrity across on-premises, virtual, and cloud-based server environments.

• Advanced troubleshooting experience with server hardware, operating systems, virtualization, storage, backup, databases, identity services, and network dependencies.

• Experience with VMware, Microsoft Windows Server, Linux, AWS, Active Directory, DNS, SSL certificates, and enterprise patching and monitoring practices.

• Experience executing backup, restoration, disaster recovery, bare-metal recovery, and hardware failure remediation activities.

• Ability to document technical work, coordinate changes with technical stakeholders, and lead vendor escalation and restoration efforts.

• Ability to support onsite work and participate in 24x7x365 after-hours escalation for critical incidents.

Preferred Qualifications:

• AWS SysOps Administrator-level proficiency or a relevant AWS certification.

• Experience with PowerScale, OneFS, Cohesity, Dell Unity, VMware vCenter, AWS S3 and Glacier, CloudWatch, and SolarWinds.

• Experience supporting SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle, IIS, Apache, or JBoss environments.

jobs.title: Director, IT & Enterprise
jobs.description:
Home Chef’s IT team is responsible for maintaining technology and enterprise systems that support our company goals and continued growth. The team supports our Chicago-based corporate office in addition to 4 national production facilities. Ideal candidates embody our tech team values: serving as proactive thought-partners to business stakeholders, encouraging their team to think bigger, taking full ownership of outcomes, and maintaining a fun, collaborative environment.

Detailed Responsibilities

Strategy & Planning:

• Establish and execute the multi-year IT strategy and enterprise roadmap aligned with Home Chef’s growth objectives

• Lead enterprise AI, automation, and data governance strategies, establishing guidelines that encourage practical AI adoption while protecting corporate data

• Continually evaluate technical infrastructure, decommission redundant tools, and drive modern efficiency across systems

• Maintain clear communication channels to provide leadership visibility into project roadmaps, resource allocation, and initiative progress

Operations & Support:

• Maintain resilient networking infrastructure, targeting high uptime and proactively eliminating single points of failure across corporate and manufacturing locations

• Oversee plant-floor technology systems across 4 facilities, including custom pick-to-light platforms, WMS, timekeeping systems, and access controls

• Manage end-to-end hardware lifecycles for corporate laptops, plant-floor kiosks, scanning equipment, and network hardware from procurement through retirement

• Implement robust Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions for both corporate staff and plant-floor teams

• Oversee responsive helpdesk services, including structured on-call and off-hours support

• Partner with operational teams to plan, install, and validate technology for facility expansions and new site launches

Enterprise System Management:

• Maintain, integrate, and optimize key enterprise platforms (e.g., NetSuite, Google Workspace, Kronos, ADP, Concur, Greenhouse)

• Act as a technical advisor to cross-functional leaders during the evaluation, selection, and rollout of new software applications

• Oversee IT-specific spend within the enterprise software budget and negotiate vendor contracts

• Drive SaaS governance to eliminate license sprawl and optimize software spend

• Expand cross-platform automations and workflow optimizations (experience with Workato is a plus)

Security & Privacy:

• Develop, maintain, and enforce cybersecurity policies, Zero Trust controls, Incident Response (IR) protocols, and Disaster Recovery (DR) plans

• Collaborate with Kroger’s corporate IT security team to ensure Home Chef systems adhere to enterprise security and compliance standards

• Conduct periodic vulnerability assessments, system audits, and penetration testing across corporate and plant environments

• Monitor changing data privacy regulations and partner with legal to maintain operational compliance

Team Management:

• Mentor, coach, and support professional growth for a team of IT administrators and support staff

• Establish clear performance metrics, operational SLAs, and professional standards for the IT department

• Build strong collaborative relationships across all departments, positioning IT as a consultative problem-solver

• Continuously evaluate organizational structure to ensure proper coverage across corporate offices and distributed production facilities

Key Traits and Behaviors

• Taking Ownership: We do whatever is necessary to get the job done - no job is too big or too small. We are willing to do any task at any level - and get our hands dirty (at a meal solutions company, sometimes we all have to do the dishes!). We work with speed, setting realistic but aggressive timelines. We do not allow lack of perfect to get in the way of progress.

• Pragmatic, Next-level Thinker: We explore new methodologies and strategies and are not constrained by conventional thinking or ‘the way we have always done it’. We take calculated risks in order to learn and innovate with speed, or ‘test and learn’. We pride ourselves on using data and insights to drive practical decisions in our fast-paced environment.

• Humble Team Player: We work collaboratively and effectively with colleagues, always putting company and team needs ahead of personal achievement. We are open to different points of view when weighing a decision, pulling in different people to provide fresh and unique perspectives.

Qualifications

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability needed for this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities.

• 3+ years experience running an IT team (10+ team members; manufacturing/operations/food environment a plus)

• Experience managing $1M+ software budgets

• Experience evaluating, negotiating, and implementing enterprise software contracts

• Flexibility to travel up to 20% of the time

• Flexibility to be on-call to support plant technology & employee needs

• Up to one year of post-high school training such as in a business school, community college or vocational training

More About Us

Perks and benefits

• Candidates can experience Home Chef as a customer - enter promo code PEOPLE30 for $30 off your first order!

• Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance available

• Paid holidays, sick time and vacation time

• 401k program

• Flexible spending accounts for qualified medical, dependent care, parking, or transit expenses

How We Work Together

We are humble team players.
We are warm and gracious with team members and customers. We seek feedback to improve ourselves - and respectfully listen to and accept input.

We are pragmatic next-level thinkers.
We come up with novel and unique ideas. We explore new strategies to avoid being constrained by conventional thinking.

We take ownership.
We approach ambiguous problems, prepared to dive in, get curious, and learn more. We are results-driven, always challenging ourselves to exceed goals.

Be at Home at Home Chef

We all show up authentically at Home Chef. Our team includes individuals with a variety of identities, backgrounds, and perspectives. You can trust that you’ll be able to bring your whole self to an inclusive and enjoyable workplace.

We welcome people of all races, colors, religions, national origin or ancestry, sex (including sexual identity), age, physical or mental disabilities, pregnancy, veteran or military status, unfavorable discharge from military service, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, order of protection status, citizenship status, arrest record or expunged/sealed convictions, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law.

Home Chef is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Home Chef will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact our People team at hr@homechef.com.

While compensation is within the provided range, it is not typical for offers to be made at the upper end. jobs.title: Tier 3 Network Lead
jobs.description:
Ardent is seeking a Tier 3 Network Lead to join our team.

This is an on-site position in Washington, D.C.

Position Description:

Ardent is seeking a Tier 3 Network Lead to support the United States Holocaust Memorial Museum (USHMM) and the technology foundation behind its historically important mission. The Museum’s ability to preserve Holocaust history, educate the public, and connect staff and visitors depends on secure, resilient, and high-performing wired and wireless infrastructure. The Tier 3 Network Lead is responsible for the performance, availability, and operational maintenance of the Museum’s wired, wireless, WAN, Internet, cloud-connectivity, and distributed antenna infrastructure. The position supports onsite operations to enable 24x7x365 enterprise escalation requirements.

Responsibilities and Duties:

Lead operations, monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, and restoration for LAN, WAN, Internet, Wi-Fi, cloud connectivity, and distributed antenna systems across Museum-supported locations.

• Install and configure switches and routers; monitor device health, bandwidth, latency, jitter, packet loss, throughput, interfaces, access points, and circuit performance.

• Diagnose and resolve network outages, routing loops, connectivity issues, authentication failures, RF interference, hardware failures, and performance degradation.

• Apply approved firmware and software updates to network switches, routers, wireless switches, and access points in coordination with Museum change-control requirements.

• Use SolarWinds Orion and associated alert dependencies to identify actionable events, reduce alert noise, detect degrading infrastructure, and support proactive and reactive Problem Management.

• Provide expert-level routing and switching support for the Museum’s Cisco Nexus, Catalyst, ASR, regional switching, and related wired infrastructure.

• Operate and maintain Aruba Central-managed wireless infrastructure, monitor client and access-point health, maintain wireless diagrams and RF maps, and report security issues to the Museum CISO.

• Coordinate with Internet service providers, circuit providers, cloud-connectivity providers, and equipment vendors for outages, installations, upgrades, troubleshooting, restoration, and after-action reporting.

• Support network cabling, data center connectivity, equipment labeling, cable management, hardware replacement, vendor RMA activity, and approved infrastructure changes.

• Maintain accurate network diagrams, circuit and provider records, configuration records, incident documentation, change records, troubleshooting notes, and knowledge articles.

• Lead Tier 3 escalation for Priority 1 and Priority 2 incidents and provide after-hours support for failures affecting core networking, data center connectivity, AWS access, or enterprise operations.

• Collaborate with Museum technical monitors and security personnel to implement approved performance, availability, and operational requirements.

Requirements:

• Current Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) certification.

• Expert-level knowledge of enterprise routing and switching.

• Demonstrated experience operating and troubleshooting complex wired, wireless, WAN, Internet, and cloud-connected network environments.

• Advanced proficiency with SolarWinds, including event monitoring, alert configuration, dependency mapping, trend analysis, and proactive fault detection.

• Hands-on experience with Cisco switching and routing platforms and enterprise wireless infrastructure.

• Experience coordinating carrier and vendor restoration, documenting root cause, and communicating status during major incidents.

• Ability to support onsite work and participate in 24x7x365 after-hours escalation for critical network incidents.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with Cisco Nexus 9000, Catalyst 9200/9300/9500, ASR 1000-HX, Cisco CLI, TACACS+, and Wireshark.

• Experience with Aruba CX6300, Aruba wireless access points, and Aruba Central Cloud Management.

• Experience supporting Metro Ethernet, multiple ISP links, cloud connectivity, distributed antenna systems, and geographically dispersed offices.

• Experience in a high-availability cultural, historical, museum, nonprofit, or Federal environment.

Due to the nature of the work we support, all candidates in consideration for this role must be willing to undergo the government issued background investigation process.

We're serving great customers https://dust.tt/customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.



Dust is backed by Sequoia https://techcrunch.com/2024/06/27/dust-grabs-another-16-million-for-its-enterprise-ai-assistants-connected-to-internal-data/ with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 https://www.linkedin.com/posts/dust-tt_were-honored-to-be-recognized-on-the-generalists-activity-7359284343929741313-Rq04.




SUMMARY



As Dust’s first dedicated US Customer Success leader, you will build the post-sales motion for one of our most important growth markets. You will begin as a player-coach: personally owning a focused portfolio of strategic customers, leading the coordination of CSMs, Deployment Strategists, and Solutions Engineers, and partnering closely with Sales and Product to drive adoption, retention, and expansion.



You will start close to the customer and close to the work, building conviction about what great post-sales looks like at Dust. You will then turn those learnings into the operating rhythms, segmentation, playbooks, and team needed to scale. This is an opportunity to define how Customer Success works at a fast-growing, AI-native company, not simply inherit an existing process.




WHAT YOU'LL DO




OWN THE US CUSTOMER-SUCCESS MOTION

 - Define and lead the Customer Success approach for Dust’s US customers.

 - Establish how we segment customers and determine the right level of engagement for each account.

 - Coordinate CSMs, Deployment Strategists, Solutions Engineers, and other post-sales partners around shared customer outcomes.

 - Create the operating rhythms that keep the team aligned on adoption, customer health, renewals, escalations, and expansion.

 - Make clear prioritization and resourcing decisions as customer needs evolve.




PERSONALLY OWN STRATEGIC CUSTOMERS

 - Manage a focused portfolio of strategic and high-complexity accounts.

 - Build trusted relationships with users, champions, technical stakeholders, and executive sponsors.

 - Lead customers from deployment through adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion.

 - Develop clear success plans tied to the customer’s business priorities and measurable outcomes.

 - Serve as the senior escalation point for high-stakes customer situations.

 - Bring firsthand customer context into decisions about product, process, and team priorities.




BUILD THE US POST-SALES PLAYBOOK

 - Define what great post-sales delivery looks like across the customer lifecycle.

 - Improve the transition from Sales to Customer Success, including handoff quality, stakeholder mapping, use-case definition, and success criteria.

 - Identify patterns across accounts and turn what works into repeatable playbooks.

 - Create practical approaches to customer health, risk management, executive engagement, adoption, and expansion.

 - Use Dust and other AI tools to increase the leverage of the Customer Success team.




DEVELOP THE TEAM

 - Coach CSMs and Deployment Strategists to raise the quality of customer work across the board

 - Help define the roles, capabilities, and hiring plan required for the next stage of the US post-sales organization.

 - Evolve from execution-heavy to strategy-heavy as the team grows building an organization that can operate independently

 - Create an environment where people develop faster than they would anywhere else




PARTNER CROSS-FUNCTIONALLY WITH SALES AND PRODUCT

 - Work closely with AEs to align pre- and post-sales motions and unlock expansion opportunities

 - Represent the voice of the US customer internally with clarity and conviction

 - Surface recurring customer needs and product gaps, and help Product prioritize them.

 - Contribute to how Dust thinks about customer value, retention, and growth at a company level.




REQUIREMENTS



Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.




APTITUDE

 - Has been an excellent Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, or Post-Sales Leader, with strong judgment across account strategy, executive communication, discovery, value articulation, adoption planning, stakeholder management, renewal strategy, and expansion.

 - Has owned strategic B2B SaaS customers through deployment, adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion.

 - Has led or deeply coordinated multiple post-sales functions, such as Customer Success, deployment, professional services, solutions engineering, or forward-deployed engineering.

 - Brings structured judgment to customer segmentation, account prioritization, and resource allocation, balancing customer urgency, strategic value, commercial importance, and team capacity.

 - Has built or meaningfully contributed to a Customer Success playbook, operating model, or team in a high-growth environment.

 - Is comfortable with technical products and complex customer environments, and can translate between business priorities, product capabilities, and operational execution.

 - Uses AI tools actively in their own work and can identify practical ways to create leverage across the Customer Success motion.




ATTITUDE

 - Treats customer outcomes as the north star, not activity metrics, and builds trust through preparation, clarity, follow-through, and honest communication.

 - Surfaces risks and difficult information early, and collaborates naturally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and other teams around shared customer outcomes.

 - Is comfortable operating in a fluid, cross-functional environment where titles do not determine contribution.

 - Develops the people around them through coaching, direct feedback, and example, while maintaining high standards in a rapidly evolving company.




AGENCY

 - Is willing to stay close to the work, personally own strategic accounts, and engage directly in complex customer situations.

 - Can define and build the US post-sales model without waiting for a complete blueprint, turning customer patterns into repeatable processes and playbooks.

 - Makes prioritization and resourcing decisions autonomously, balancing customer urgency, strategic value, commercial importance, and team capacity.

 - Finds ways to create customer outcomes with limited resources and imperfect information, and treats the player-coach phase as an opportunity to build conviction and organizational leverage.
   
   


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation: $260,000–$340,000 OTE

 - Significant equity package in a Sequoia-backed startup

 - Health insurance for you and your dependents

 - New MacBook Pro or Linux machine, monitor, keyboard, etc.

 - Beautiful office in the heart of SoHo (NYC)

 - Opportunity to travel to Paris multiple times a year

 - Regular team events and offsites




LOCATION



We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.



We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.




WHY DUST



The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.



We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.



If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.



Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. 



Learn how we think and work.

At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in unmanned aircraft systems. Our team of engineers and innovators is developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions that push the boundaries of UAS technology - solving complex challenges that matter.

We're building the future of UAS capabilities, and we're looking for exceptional talent to join us. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on next-generation flight systems, you belong here.

Position Overview

The Configuration Management Site Lead/Supervisor reports to the Senior Configuration Manager and serves as the local extension of enterprise CM leadership at an assigned operating site. This position leads and governs Configuration Management activities throughout the product lifecycle, supervises CM personnel, coordinates site workload, and ensures site execution aligns with enterprise policies, program objectives, contractual requirements, and industry standards.

Operating with minimal supervision, the Site Lead/Supervisor partners with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Operations, Software, and Program Management to maintain configuration integrity from concept and development through production, delivery, and sustainment. This position also represents the CDM function to leadership, customers, government representatives, suppliers, and auditors.

The Day-to-Day

• Supervise site CM personnel by assigning work, setting priorities, monitoring performance, providing technical direction, and supporting employee development.

jobs.title: Customer Operations Specialist, Payments
jobs.description:
CUSTOMER OPERATIONS SPECIALIST, PAYMENTS



Role in one line: Resolve the customer problems that cross payments, disputes, cancellations, audits, and insurance operations before they become repeat calls or unresolved risk.



A payment does not reconcile. A customer raises a dispute. A cancellation notice conflicts with the account record. An audit creates a question nobody can answer from one screen. You establish the real state, speak with the customer, and carry the issue to a documented resolution.



Harper's systems can surface records and prepare routine service work. This role handles the customer problems that still require judgment, persistence, and direct communication across payments and insurance operations.






WHY NOW



Harper serves a growing base of small businesses across many carriers, payment paths, and policy workflows. Routine requests belong with Customer Service. This specialist owns the harder cases that cross systems or require reconciliation across finance, insurance, and service records.



You own payments and disputes, plus the related cancellations, audits, insurance questions, phone work, and complex service problems that often arrive with them. The job is broad because the customer's problem rarely respects one system boundary.






WHAT YOU OWN



 - Resolve payment questions. Trace the payment question through the available records and identify the current state, amount, owner, and next action.

 - Work disputes end to end. Establish the issue, gather the source records, explain the current state, coordinate the required review, and record the final outcome.

 - Handle cancellation complexity. Read the full event chain, including notices, effective cancellations, reinstatements, and rescissions, before telling a customer what is true.

 - Support audits. Help customers understand the audit request, identify the records needed, and route licensed or specialized questions to the correct owner.

 - Answer general insurance questions within authority. Explain process and recorded facts clearly. Escalate coverage advice and licensed decisions rather than guessing.

 - Talk to people. Use the phone when a live conversation will resolve confusion faster than another automated message.

 - Reconcile across systems. Compare the customer record, payment record, policy record, communications, and external confirmation before closing a case.

 - Own the next action. Keep one named owner, one current state, and one promised update point until the issue is complete.

 - Find the repeated cause. Flag patterns that should become a permanent product, process, training, or finance fix.






WHAT RESOLVED MEANS



 - Cases preserve the customer's question, the amount or policy involved, the records checked, the owner, and the next action.

 - Payment conclusions name the evidence and the account or transaction they belong to.

 - Disputes end with a recorded resolution, customer notification, and any required financial or policy correction.

 - Cancellation answers reflect the latest event in the chain, not the loudest notice.

 - Repeat contacts decline because the underlying issue was resolved and explained clearly.






WHO THRIVES HERE



 - You have worked in payments, disputes, cancellations, audits, insurance service, or another high-volume problem-solving environment.

 - You can read several systems without losing the customer's question.

 - You are calm and direct with people who are frustrated or confused.

 - You document facts carefully and distinguish a missing record from a missing real-world action.

 - You know when to keep investigating and when to escalate.

 - You are comfortable with phone work throughout the day.

 - You are based in Atlanta or San Francisco, or ready to relocate to one of those offices.






WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY



 - You want a back-office role with no customer conversations.

 - You close cases when you transfer them.

 - You infer payment, cancellation, or coverage from one status field.

 - You avoid difficult conversations or detailed reconciliation.

 - You need a remote or hybrid default.






BENEFITS



Harper offers health, dental, and vision insurance. Office-specific benefits will be set by working location.







HOW TO APPLY



Send your resume and a short example of a customer problem that crossed several systems or teams. Explain how you established the real state, what you told the customer, and how you proved the issue was resolved.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive

We're a Series B startup backed by Kleiner Perkins, Meritech Capital, General Catalyst, and other top-tier investors, with $125M raised and a $1B valuation. We grew 10x in 2025 and have scaled to 170+ employees in under two years across our NYC headquarters and Santa Barbara office.

In a $1T+ market where 85% of missed calls go to competitors, we're building the category-defining platform for AI-driven customer engagement, serving the largest brands in home services. With high-energy, in-office teams in both locations, every hire here has an immediate and visible impact.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Avoca, you'll own the full sales cycle, from first conversation to close, for our largest and most strategic home services accounts. You'll work directly with operators, and home service business leaders at scale to understand their call flows, conversion challenges, and growth goals, and help them adopt Avoca as a mission-critical revenue engine across their organization.

This role is built for a hunter: someone who builds their own pipeline, thrives in founder-led sales environments, is comfortable selling a technical product into large, multi-stakeholder organizations, and wants to help define how Avoca sells as we scale upmarket. This role reports to Jack Gashi, our VP Sales.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the end-to-end sales cycle for our largest enterprise home services customers, from prospecting to close.

 - Proactively build and manage your own pipeline of enterprise-fit accounts rather than waiting on inbound.

 - Run discovery calls to deeply understand customer operations, call workflows, and revenue pain points across complex organizations.

 - Deliver tailored demos and solution pitches that map Avoca's AI to enterprise outcomes and ROI.

 - Manage pipeline, forecasts, and deal progression across long, multi-stakeholder deal cycles with high accuracy.

 - Navigate complex buying committees and drive consensus across founders, operators, procurement, and finance.

 - Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to structure and close complex, high-ACV deals.

 - Provide feedback from the field to help shape product roadmap, positioning, and enterprise go-to-market strategy.

 - Hit and exceed aggressive monthly and quarterly revenue targets.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 7-10 years of closing experience in B2B SaaS (AI, vertical SaaS, or operational software preferred), with a track record of winning enterprise or high-ACV deals.

 - A demonstrated hunter mentality, you generate and win deals rather than just manage what lands on your desk.

 - Proven ability to run complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and close high-ACV deals from first touch to signature.

 - Strong discovery skills, you ask great questions and listen closely.

 - Comfort selling to operators and executives at the enterprise level.




WHO YOU ARE

 - Experience carrying an enterprise or strategic accounts quota and winning outsized deals.

 - Clear, confident communicator who can explain technical concepts simply to varied stakeholders.

 - Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable in fast-moving environments.

 - Experience working in early-stage startups is a plus.

 - Experience selling to home services or operations-heavy businesses is a plus.

 - Excited to work in-office with a high-ownership team in NYC.




BENEFITS

 - Company-sponsored 401(k) through Vestwell

 - Company-wide off-sites

 - Daily in-office lunch through Parkday

 - Dinner covered when working late

 - Standing desks and workspace accommodations available on request

Compensation: The expected on target earnings for this role is $380,000-$400,000 with final compensation based on experience, skills, and qualifications determined during the interview process. Avoca's total compensation package includes base salary, bonus, equity, and a comprehensive suite of benefits and perks. Our Recruiting team will share the full details as you progress through our hiring process.




WHY AVOCA

At Avoca, you’ll be part of a team that’s building a category-defining company at the center of a massive market opportunity. We’re a fast-moving, collaborative team with a culture designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and impact.

jobs.title: Deputy Director of Industrial Security
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Security Team at Anduril is the cornerstone of defense, employing unparalleled security measures and state-of-the-art technology to ensure the protection of our people, assets, operations, and innovations. Given the unique nature of this company, our team supports a host of standard and non-standard taskings integrating physical and digital measures to stay ahead of evolving threats. We also uphold stringent industry and government compliance, creating a secure environment that nurtures the development of cutting-edge defense solutions and ensures Anduril's continued growth and innovation in a complex global landscape.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking an experienced, proactive, and dynamic leader to serve as the Deputy Director of Industrial Security. In this critical leadership role, you will assist with overseeing the strategic direction and operational execution of our enterprise-wide industrial security program. You will lead a large, geographically dispersed security team across the United States, including Regional Facility Security Officers (RFSOs), site-level Facility Security Officers (FSOs), and a centralized Personnel Security (PERSEC) team. The ideal candidate brings extensive hands-on experience as an FSO, deep subject matter expertise in 32 CFR Part 117 (NISPOM) Must be able to work within a collaborative team environment and take independent action, analyze problems, and provide security focused solutions to Anduril and government personnel.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Serve as the senior technical authority on 32 CFR Part 117 (NISPOM Rule), ensuring absolute enterprise-wide compliance across all cleared facilities.

• Leverage expertise with US government security policies, procedures and industry experience as it relates to Industrial security.

• Build a culture of compliance, operational excellence, customer service, and continuous improvement across all security functions.

• Establish team KPIs, conduct performance reviews, allocate resources effectively, and develop professional growth pathways for security personnel.

• In coordination with the security education manager, develop and deliver applicable security education topics to program personnel.

• Oversee and standardize Standard Practice Procedures (SPPs) for all cleared locations.

• Lead preparation efforts for Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA) security reviews, vulnerability assessments, and internal self-inspections.

• Serve as an escalated point of contact for complex security violations, and adverse information reporting. Oversee and coordinate all activities related to FOCI.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelors Degree and ten years of industrial security-related experience.

• Exceptional time management and prioritization skills, with the ability to achieve goals and targets while handling multiple tasks.

• Minimum of 5+ years directly managing large, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed teams (including managing managers/regional leaders).

• FSO Background: Direct experience having served as an appointed Facility Security Officer (FSO) for a possessing/cleared facility.

• Ability to communicate and interact professionally and courteously both orally and in writing with all levels of employees, management and customers.

• Experience integrating security operations following corporate Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A).

• Active Top Secret

US Salary Range

$166,000—$220,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

The primary goal of an engineering technician is to provide troubleshooting, testing, repairs, and technical services to our systems manufacturing line, meeting quality and productivity goals within manufacturing. This person will play a significant role in the areas of failure analysis, first pass yield, and manufacturing escalations.

Essential Job Duties

• Follow production escalation process and provide engineering evaluation of any interruptions to production line.
• Perform quick triage of the issue and recommend best course of action to keep production moving. This includes performing simple reworks on the spot such as cable crimping, soldering, tapping, fiber optics cleaning, etc.
• Document all activities during escalation support in formal records.
• Diagnose and resolve failures on Systems Mfg line, including system level failures, Sub-assembly failures, and test fixture failures.
• Perform failure analysis down to component level, investigate root cause, and recommend corrective / preventive actions.
• Troubleshoot non-conforming material rejected from manufacturing lines and document findings in process logs and variance requests.
• Collaborate with manufacturing engineers to resolve manufacture, process, and quality issues.
• Conduct tests and experiments under the supervision of senior staff.
• Execute engineering level tests and collect data to support design of experiment activities or characterize a device.
• Support production with electronics/PCA programming and functional testing in the early phase of new product launches to shake out bugs and suggest improvements.
• Collaborate with team members to ensure project timelines and objectives are met.
• Follow safety protocols and maintain a clean and organized work environment.
• Maintain calibration of all test equipment and fixtures.
• Perform other engineering technician duties as needed

Required Skills and Experience

• Minimum 2 years of journey level technical engineering experience.
• Must possess extensive knowledge/experience in troubleshooting electromechanical issues.
• Ability to perform failure analysis and troubleshooting with minimal supervision.
• Effectively use of test equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, function generators, and custom test platforms.
• Understand wiring diagrams, schematics, assembly drawings, fab drawings, and mechanical component drawings.
• Strong analytic and problem-solving skills.
• Working knowledge of computers, word processing and spreadsheet applications for documentation and data presentation.
• Ability to learn quickly and adapt to variety of technologies that allow effective troubleshooting.
• Effective communication skills to be able to collaborate effectively with production technicians, supervisors, trainers, and engineers.
• Sense of urgency and multi-tasking is essential to be able to support production line effectively.
• Good communication and documentation skills.
• Experience with Agile, SAP, MES, and SPC or equivalent tools.

Required Education and Training

• Minimum AS in electrical engineering or related degree, military technical training or equivalent.
• Open to new college graduates with a BSEE degree.

• Standard working hours, with potential for overtime depending on business needs.
• Fast-paced manufacturing environment.

• Ability to work independently with minimum supervision.
• Hands-on troubleshooting experience is preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Cost Manager / Quantity Surveyor - Workplace Projects
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is seeking an experienced Senior Cost Manager and/or Quantity Surveyor to support a portfolio of workplace, commercial, and capital improvement projects across North America. This role is responsible for budgeting, forecasting, cost controls, change management, and financial reporting throughout the project lifecycle. The successful candidate will work closely with project teams, stakeholders, and external cost consultants to ensure accurate cost management and effective project delivery. Experience supporting tenant improvement, renovation, decommissioning, laboratory, infrastructure, or similar capital projects is preferred.

• Prepare written comments to contractor and consultant submissions, including executive summaries.
• Coordinate all sources of cost information for cost discussions and decision-making.

• Review, validate, and monitor project budgets, forecasts, commitments, and expenditures.

• Support portfolio-level financial reporting and provide cost performance analysis to stakeholders and leadership.

• Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Engineering, Cost Management, or a related field.
• 7+ years of experience in construction cost management, quantity surveying, cost controls, or project controls.
• Experience managing budgets, forecasts, change management, cost reporting, and financial controls across multiple projects or programs.
• Experience leading cost management services on medium to large-scale construction projects.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

jobs.title: Sr. Configuration Management Specialist
jobs.location: Fort Walton Beach, Florida, United States
jobs.description:
At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in unmanned aircraft systems. Our team of engineers and innovators is developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions that push the boundaries of UAS technology - solving complex challenges that matter.

We're building the future of UAS capabilities, and we're looking for exceptional talent to join us. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on next-generation flight systems, you belong here.

Position Overview

Join our growing aerospace and defense organization as a Senior Configuration Management Specialist (Level III). This role independently executes and coordinates configuration management across assigned programs, products, and lifecycle phases. The specialist partners with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Software, Systems Engineering, and Program Management to maintain configuration integrity from concept and development through production, delivery, and sustainment.

The Level III specialist serves as a trusted program CM practitioner and may lead defined workstreams, facilitate change-control activities, and mentor less-experienced team members. This is an individual-contributor position aligned to enterprise CM governance and direction from the Senior Configuration Manager.

This is one onsite position with location flexibility. The selected candidate may be based at the Dallas-Fort Worth, Fort Walton Beach, or San Luis Obispo site and should identify their preferred location when applying.

What You Will Do

• Own day-to-day configuration management execution for assigned programs, products, and projects while ensuring alignment with enterprise policies, program plans, contracts, and applicable industry requirements.

• Develop and maintain program configuration management plans, procedures, work instructions, checklists, and lifecycle records under enterprise CM governance.

• Establish, document, and maintain configuration identification and product structures for hardware, software, firmware, documentation, interfaces, and technical data.

• Coordinate functional, allocated, product, production, as-built, as-tested, and as-maintained baseline activities as required by the program lifecycle and contract.

• Support and facilitate Configuration Control Boards (CCBs) and Software Configuration Control Boards (SCCBs), including agenda preparation, change-package readiness, stakeholder coordination, decision records, and action tracking.

• Review engineering change requests, engineering change orders, deviations, waivers, problem reports, and related change documentation for completeness, traceability, classification, effectivity, and implementation planning.

• Maintain configuration status accounting for approved changes, baselines, releases, effectivity, serial applicability, open actions, implementation status, and technical data deliveries.

• Verify that approved changes are fully implemented across affected drawings, specifications, bills of material, work instructions, software repositories, test artifacts, planning records, and downstream business systems.

• Help maintain alignment among requirements, design data, EBOMs, MBOMs, SBOMs, ERP/MRP, MES, QMS, PDM/PLM, and software-development repositories to strengthen the digital thread.

• Perform release-readiness and baseline-completeness reviews before production, test, delivery, or major technical milestones.

• Support functional and physical configuration audits, production readiness reviews, first article activities, customer reviews, and internal or external compliance assessments.

• Identify and resolve configuration discrepancies involving engineering data, manufacturing planning, software versions, effectivity, serialized product records, and as-built documentation.

• Coordinate configuration records and technical data packages required for customer delivery, contractual reporting, audit readiness, and product acceptance.

• Contribute configuration management scope, assumptions, schedules, risks, deliverables, and basis-of-estimate inputs to proposals and program planning activities.

• Develop program-level metrics and concise status reports covering change throughput, aging actions, baseline health, release readiness, implementation completion, and emerging CM risks.

• Provide practical CM guidance and training to cross-functional stakeholders and mentor junior CM personnel in established processes and tools.

• Collaborate across operating sites to promote consistent execution while addressing local program and production needs.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, systems engineering, information management, business, or a related discipline, with at least five years of relevant configuration management experience; an equivalent combination of education and directly applicable experience may be considered.

• Hands-on experience performing configuration identification, change control, status accounting, baseline management, release management, implementation verification, and configuration audits.

• Experience supporting complex hardware, software, firmware, or integrated product development in aerospace, defense, manufacturing, or another highly regulated environment.

• Working knowledge of engineering drawings, specifications, bills of material, part and document revision control, effectivity, serialization, and product lifecycle records.

• Ability to evaluate change packages for cross-functional impact and trace changes through engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, test, software, and delivery records.

Pay range for this role

$95,000—$126,000 USD

What's in it for you:

Benefits:

• Competitive total compensation package

• Comprehensive benefit package options include medical, dental, vision, life, and more.

• 401k with company-match

• 3 weeks of paid time off each year

• 40 hours of sick time

• 12 annual company holidays

Why Join Zone 5 Technologies?

• Innovative Environment: Work on cutting-edge technology that is shaping the future of defense and aerospace.

• Collaborative Culture: Join a team of passionate professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

• Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

If you are passionate about unmanned aircraft technology and want to be a part of a dynamic and growing company, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and join the Zone 5 Technologies team!

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

Zone 5 Technologies is a federal contractor and participates in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility. jobs.title: Account Executive, New Business
jobs.description:
ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, NEW BUSINESS



Role in one line: Take qualified small-business owners from a real insurance need to a confident decision and a closed policy.



The quote is back. The owner has a price, three questions, and a business that cannot wait forever. You own the conversation that turns that moment into a decision.



Harper uses AI to assemble account context, prioritize follow-up, and prepare the next touch. You turn that preparation into a clear recommendation, handle the objection, and ask for the business.






WHY NOW



Harper is hiring Account Executives in Atlanta and San Francisco. Atlanta is Harper's in-person, high-volume sales hub, and San Francisco is another active home for the same closing work. The SDR owns reach and qualification. Intake owns application completeness. 



You begin when the customer is qualified and the account is ready for a quote, recommendation, or closing conversation.



This is a phone-closing role. You take warmed, qualified business owners and turn them into Harper customers at volume. You are measured on policies closed, booked revenue, conversion quality, and the accuracy of what you sell.






THE OPPORTUNITIES YOU WILL CLOSE



Most of your work follows a straightforward path from qualified customer to quote, recommendation, and decision. Some opportunities are harder. The first classification, quote, market, package, or handoff did not work, but the customer may still be worth winning.

Those accounts are an appealing part of the job for a seller who likes solving the real problem. You read the history, diagnose what failed, rebuild a credible path with the right Harper partners, explain what changed, and ask the customer for a decision.






WHAT YOU OWN



 - Close small-business accounts at volume. Run direct, focused conversations and ask for the business when Harper has the right answer.

 - Use the full account context. Know the customer's operation, urgency, quoted options, coverage needs, and open questions before you call.

 - Explain the commercial choice. Make price, coverage, carrier, and tradeoffs understandable without hiding behind insurance language.

 - Handle objections and follow-up. Stay with a live opportunity until it closes, clearly dies, or requires a different Harper owner.

 - Recover harder opportunities. Read the full history, distinguish work Harper still owes from customer follow-up or a terminal outcome, and coordinate the corrected quote, market, package, or recommendation.

 - Remarket thoughtfully. Work with placement and insurance experts to choose a credible next market rather than repeating a failed route.

 - Work the prepared queue. Verify the surfaced account facts, use the prioritized follow-up list, correct generated drafts before use, and record the actual outcome.

 - Protect contact preferences. Never work a customer who opted out or reached an explicit terminal outcome.

 - Protect accuracy. Work within your license and authority. Never create confidence by overstating coverage or skipping a real question.

 - Feed the system. Capture why customers buy, wait, or walk away so the playbook and product improve.

 - Raise the floor. Share calls, language, and patterns that make the whole sales team better.






THE OUTCOMES YOU OWN



 - You accept clean handoffs and keep each live opportunity moving toward one customer decision.

 - Your recommendations make the quoted option, material tradeoffs, and unresolved conditions clear.

 - Harder recovery opportunities leave your hands with the original failure understood and a credible new commercial path.

 - Bound accounts carry the accepted option and required completion steps into the next stage without ambiguity.

 - Lost or stalled accounts preserve the customer's stated reason, or an honest record that the reason remains unknown.






WHO THRIVES HERE



 - You have closed in a high-volume phone-sales environment.

 - You are comfortable being measured on conversion and revenue, not soft activity.

 - You can build trust quickly with small-business owners.

 - You listen for the real objection and respond directly.

 - You can read a difficult account history, identify what failed, and explain a corrected path without blaming the customer.

 - You use coaching, call review, and data to improve your own conversion.

 - You can earn a commercial insurance producer license quickly if you do not already hold one.

 - Commercial insurance experience is valuable but not required for every level.

 - You are based in Atlanta or San Francisco, or ready to relocate to one of those offices.






WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY



 - You want an enterprise sales cycle with a small number of accounts.

 - You avoid direct asks, follow-up, or visible performance measurement.

 - You see licensing and coverage accuracy as administrative work.

 - You need a remote or hybrid default.

 - You want a management title before proving you can close the work yourself.






COMPENSATION & LOGISTICS



 - Salary: $150,000–$200,000 OTE. Top performers earn more.

 - Equity: Yes.

 - Location: On-site, New York or San Francisco. Based here or willing to relocate.

 - Schedule: Monday–Friday, very early morning start, in-office 5 days a week.

 - Licensing: Commercial insurance producer license required within ~30 days of start; Harper pays for training and licensing.






BENEFITS



Harper offers health, dental, and vision insurance. Office-specific benefits are set by working location. 






TO APPLY



Send your resume and a short note about the sales environment where you performed best. Include what you sold, how much phone volume you carried, how you were measured, and the change you made that most improved your conversion.

The ideal candidate is safety-focused, customer-service oriented, professional, dependable, and comfortable representing Mattel in a highly visible role. Employee safety, service, and reliability are the top priorities for this position.

Primary Responsibility: Shuttle & Driving Operations

• Valid Passenger Endorsement required.

• Must maintain all required commercial driver qualifications, medical certification, and licensing requirements.

• Clean and acceptable driving record required, subject to company review.

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.title: Graduate Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
About Graphcore

Graphcore is a global leader in artificial intelligence computing systems. We design advanced semiconductors and data center hardware that provide the specialized processing power needed to advance AI while improving the efficiency required for broad adoption.

As part of SoftBank Group, Graphcore belongs to a family of companies developing transformative technologies. Our AI Engineering Campus in Austin plays an important role in building the hardware platforms that support the next generation of AI systems.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a recent graduate or early-career engineer to join the Hardware Platform Development team as a Graduate Systems Engineer. You will contribute to the design, integration, validation, and performance analysis of advanced AI compute platforms.

You will work with experienced hardware, firmware, software, mechanical, thermal, and systems engineers throughout the development lifecycle. The role combines subsystem engineering, hands-on laboratory work, test automation, data analysis, troubleshooting, and clear technical documentation.

What You Will Do

• Contribute to the design, integration, and testing of CPU and high-speed input and output subsystems for advanced compute platforms.

• Take ownership of defined engineering tasks from requirements and test planning through execution, analysis, and technical review.

• Develop system-level validation plans, procedures, scripts, and tools that improve test coverage, repeatability, data collection, and analysis.

• Evaluate platform performance, power, signal behavior, reliability, and interoperability using laboratory measurements and system data.

• Investigate emerging input and output technologies, including PCIe 6.0 and 800G Ethernet, and assess their use in advanced computing systems.

• Support platform power, cooling, and energy-efficiency investigations, including liquid-cooling systems for high-performance processors.

• Use power meters, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and comparable laboratory equipment to execute tests and gather reliable evidence.

• Analyze unexpected behavior, reproduce issues, perform structured root-cause investigations, and help verify corrective actions.

• Collaborate across hardware, firmware, software, mechanical, thermal, manufacturing, and systems teams to resolve integration issues.

• Maintain accurate requirements, test procedures, scripts, data summaries, engineering notes, and change records.

• Present progress, results, risks, and technical recommendations clearly and follow applicable engineering, configuration-control, laboratory, and safety procedures.

What You Will Bring

• A bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, systems engineering, or a closely related field, completed recently or expected before the role begins.

• A strong foundation in computer architecture, digital systems, embedded systems, hardware-software interaction, or system-level engineering.

• Hands-on experience with laboratory testing and technical measurements through coursework, research, internships, student teams, or personal projects.

• Experience with at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, C, C++, or MATLAB.

• Ability to plan technical work, analyze test data, document results accurately, and draw evidence-based conclusions.

• A structured approach to problem-solving, troubleshooting, and root-cause investigation.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering disciplines.

• Curiosity, sound engineering judgment, and willingness to learn unfamiliar tools, systems, and laboratory methods.

Preferred Qualifications

• Internship, research, academic, or project experience with CPU subsystems, PCIe, Ethernet, high-speed interfaces, or platform validation.

• Experience using power meters, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, or similar laboratory equipment.

• Experience creating test automation, data-analysis tools, or engineering scripts.

• Exposure to platform performance characterization, power delivery, thermal management, liquid cooling, or energy efficiency.

• Familiarity with systems integration, design verification, configuration control, or engineering change processes.

• Experience presenting engineering work or test results in a technical review setting.

These qualifications are helpful, not required. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every preferred qualification.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Greenfield Product
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

CorpTech Platform is the internal engineering force multiplier behind Anduril's corporate systems. It drives CorpTech engineering forward through strategic investment in data platforms, software platforms, QA and release excellence, ERP engineering, and AI infrastructure.

We build the foundations that power both CorpOS, enabling Finance and Growth to operate with speed and precision, and ArsenalOS, the digital backbone of Anduril's hardware enterprise. By unifying systems, accelerating development velocity, and embedding intelligence into every layer, CorpTech Platform transforms how the company operates end to end.

We are also driving Anduril toward becoming an autonomous enterprise. Through initiatives like the Autonomous Software Factory, we are rethinking how software is built, tested, deployed, and evolved by integrating AI directly into the engineering lifecycle. CorpTech Platform is how Anduril scales its business systems with the same rigor, speed, and adaptability as its mission critical products.

About the Job

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build new products for some of Anduril's highest-priority operational needs. This is a greenfield product-engineering role for someone who moves quickly from an ambiguous problem to working software, learns directly from customers, and takes ownership beyond implementation. You will partner closely with a product manager to shape what gets built, make product and technical trade-offs, launch applications, and iterate until they create measurable value.

The work will be highly visible and often begin without a complete specification or established technical path. Success requires a strong bias for action, sound judgment under uncertainty, and the ability to balance exceptional delivery speed with the engineering foundations a successful product will need as it grows.

What You'll Do

• Own the technical delivery of greenfield applications from initial concept through production launch and iteration.

• Partner with a product manager as a product-engineering pair, jointly shaping scope, priorities, user experience, technical approach, and success measures.

• Work directly with customers and end users to understand operational problems, test assumptions, gather feedback, and improve the product.

• Build high-quality full-stack product experiences using modern web technologies and CorpTech Platform capabilities.

• Make pragmatic architecture and implementation decisions that maximize learning and speed while preserving a credible path to reliability and scale.

• Break ambiguous initiatives into testable product increments and ship useful software before every requirement is known.

• Communicate progress, trade-offs, risks, and results clearly to technical partners, business stakeholders, and senior leadership.

• Use frontier AI tooling and AI-enabled development workflows to accelerate prototyping, implementation, testing, and iteration.

• Raise the product-engineering bar by improving reusable patterns, technical foundations, and development practices for future zero-to-one teams.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in a software engineering role building and shipping products, ideally in a fast-paced environment.

• Demonstrated experience taking a software product or substantial feature from an ambiguous problem through production launch.

• Deep expertise in one or more areas of full-stack web development, such as backend, frontend, or systems integration, with the ability to contribute across the stack.

• Proficiency with web technologies such as JavaScript, React, TypeScript, and frameworks such as Next.js.

• Experience partnering closely with product management, design, and end users to shape solutions rather than only implementing predefined requirements.

• Strong product judgment and a demonstrated ability to balance delivery speed, customer value, technical quality, and long-term maintainability.

• Ability to operate with high autonomy, make decisions with incomplete information, and communicate clearly on high-visibility work.

• Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience building zero-to-one products, internal tools, or enterprise applications in a startup or similarly high-velocity environment.

• Experience conducting customer discovery, validating product assumptions, and iterating based on direct user feedback.

• Familiarity with frontier AI tooling, AI coding assistants, agentic development workflows, and AI-enabled software delivery practices.

• Experience with large enterprise applications or platforms and the judgment to evolve prototypes into reliable production systems.

• Familiarity with enterprise systems and business process domains such as ERP, MES, WMS, CRM, finance, supply chain, or manufacturing.

• Experience in hyper-growth startup-like environments, with demonstrated success balancing speed, ambiguity, autonomy, and long-term product health.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. TS clearance.

US Salary Range

$191,000—$253,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.
