You'll be responsible for designing, developing, and modifying mechanical engineering layouts, schematics, and specifications. You will oversee manufacturing and installation processes, ensuring adherence to industry standards and regulations-- and you'll coordinate the procurement and assembly of mechanical components and equipment for design projects, identifying sources of critical parts and subsystems to resolve technical issues.

Role Responsibilities:

• Independently develop and implement concepts for a range of significantly complex product engineering solutions
• Determine appropriate material and fabrication processes for parts.
• Lead or execute engineering projects and spearhead the mechanical aspects as part of the R&D team
• Identify and troubleshoot a wide range of significantly complex engineering problems
• Specify or perform significantly complex engineering analysis and FEA simulation.
• Perform tolerance analysis on parts and assemblies.
• Communicate with internal and external customers regarding significantly complex engineering issues to address customers’ important needs.
• Review and understand product specifications and invent new or improved sub-systems to intercept future needs.
• Work with electrical engineering, chemical engineering, and software engineering groups to generate the mechanical aspects of equipment solutions.
• Specify engineering tests for mechanical systems and oversee technicians that will implement assembly and testing.
• Interpret complex engineering layouts, schematics, drawings, and specifications
• Specify and review engineering documentation and engineering processes
• Visit manufacturing and customer sites to identify and resolve first time issues

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree
• 10-15 years of experience
• Deep technical expertise in equipment design, assembly and part fabrication
• Experience with semiconductor equipment, especially wet processing equipment, is preferred
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills to explain difficult or sensitive information and to build consensus

Join the team protecting half a billion lives every year with next-gen science, mRNA innovation, and AI Vaccines driven breakthroughs. In Vaccines, you’ll help advance prevention on a global scale - and shape the future of immunization.

Xcel Energy supports a hybrid work model to enable collaboration and flexibility. Many roles are expected to work onsite three days per week (Tuesday–Thursday); however, work location expectations vary based on role, team, and business needs.

Position Summary

Provide high-level technical expertise in all property and sales/use tax reporting matters, and provide leadership in coordinating team efforts. This position actively participates in the identification of tax issues, leads and performs transaction research, and implements changes in tax statutes, regulations, and rules. This position promotes accurate and timely reporting of tax information by leveraging data analytics and technology resources.

Essential Responsibilities

• Property and Sales/Use Tax Compliance - Complete and/or review the accurate and timely filing of all property and sales/use tax filings as well as the analysis of the data used in the completion of these filings. Provide support for corporate systems used to meet statutory and analytical sales/use and property tax reporting requirements. Demonstrate an in-depth knowledge of state and local property and sales tax laws, ordinances, rules, and regulations. Coordinate tax payments in a manner that minimizes company cash requirements.
• Accounting and Forecasting - Participate at a high technical level in the computation, recording, and documentation of property and sales/use tax accruals to ensure compliance with GAAP, regulatory, and Sarbanes-Oxley provisions. Coordinate team efforts related to accounting, forecasting and internal or external reporting.
• Team Leadership - Direct the day-to-day activities of the tax analysts and senior analysts in coordinating the overall activities of the Property and Sales/Use Tax Reporting team.
• Property and Sales/Use Tax Defense - Represent the company to tax authorities in regard to tax reporting matters. Provide timely responses to information requests and coordinate team efforts to ensure efficient completion of audits. Facilitate the resolution of issues to attain the lowest fair tax payable. Provide in-depth transactional research, experience and creative thinking to the process of gathering facts, evaluating alternative positions, and determining strategies.
• Property and Sales/Use Tax Strategy - Keep abreast of and effectively communicate current changes in tax laws, ordinances, regulations, and rulings. Monitor and evaluate initiatives and trends that impact the company and industry. Assist in the development of strategies and plans and provide consulting to business areas. Develop and maintain contacts both inside and outside the company for purposes of seeking out tax minimization opportunities.

• Audit and tax systems experience preferred.

jobs.description:
Xcel Energy (NASDAQ: XEL) is a leading energy provider and Fortune 500 company, dedicated to serving millions of electricity and natural gas customers across eight states: Minnesota, Colorado, Wisconsin, Michigan, North Dakota, South Dakota, New Mexico and Texas. We make energy work better for our customers, helping them thrive every day. That means always raising the bar - delivering better service and providing more reliable, resilient, and sustainable energy.

Xcel Energy is a place where you’ll have opportunities to grow, expand your skills, and help lead the clean energy transition. We offer meaningful rewards, recognition, and support to help you build your career and make an impact - both on the job and beyond. Most importantly, it means you’ll be joining a company that knows employees are the driving force behind its success and is committed to helping you be your best.

We anticipate an opening for one or more Operator Repairman for the Black Dog Plant located in Burnsville, MN. The base rate of pay for this classification will be $59.78. The position will be posted for 10 Working Days from September 24, 2026, to October 7, 2026.

Position Summary

Operator Repairman must have a general knowledge of the total plant equipment, procedures, and operations. The Operator Repairman must have specific expertise for the operation of plant systems.

Essential Functions:

1. Performs all the functions trained and qualified for.

2. As provided by the training and qualification program, must have full knowledge of operation of CT’s, HRSG, steam turbines, and auxiliary power plant equipment, and shall have the fundamental knowledge of electrical theory along with full knowledge of generator synchronization, excitation, voltage and load control, main and auxiliary transformer operation, and station and transmission switching.

3. Operates, monitors, inspects, and maintains boilers, turbines, condensers, generators and plant auxiliary equipment and systems as assigned including water treatment systems and chemical additions as needed. Performs startups, shutdowns, equipment tests and operating adjustments.

4. Monitors and records operating of equipment. Recognizes abnormal equipment performance and takes corrective action. Reports problems and initiates trouble reports.

5. Responds to plant emergencies, unit upsets, and changing operating conditions. Must evaluate system condition and initiate corrective action. Coordinates actions and implements instructions from Management.

6. Uses computer to generate Transmission Work Requests, Plant Event Reports and similar.

7. Switches voltages through 230 kilovolts.

8. Change out brushes on generator.

9. Implements/issues equipment clearances in preparation for inspection, testing, or maintenance. On return of clearance, inspects and returns equipment to normal operation. Follows prescribed clearance procedures and assists with development of new procedures as needed.

10. Comply with applicable Company, OSHA and other governmental regulations. Understands and complies with all pertinent safety and environmental permit requirements and/or regulations.

11. Understands and safely uses hand tools, shop tools, and other power tools.

12. Capable of understanding MSDS, confined space requirements, hot work, etc.

13. Completes work orders. Completes all job paperwork including log sheets, records of parts used and work completed.

14. Contributes to annual budget cycle for operations area.

15. Participates with plant management in daily and outage work planning, scheduling, and prioritization.

16. Assists with on-the-job training for others, and participation in development, writing and documenting work-related practices and procedures.

17. Must have the ability to make quick and sound decisions in any plant emergency.

18. Must have the ability to read and understand one line electrical, plant flow diagrams, blueprints, equipment drawings, diagrams, and manuals.

19. Must have the ability to intelligently communicate with plant personnel both verbally and in writing along with taking the necessary readings required by management.

20. Shall participate in training and maintain qualifications of mechanical maintenance skills and abilities equivalent to maintenance repairman as outlined in Operator / Repairman.

Required

1. Must have a High School diploma or GED

2. Will be required to actively participate in training and retraining programs established for this position as determined by management, including assisting with training and qualifying of other personnel.

3. Will be required to have full knowledge of plant operating procedures and equipment including pollution control equipment.

4. Will be required to direct other operating classifications in the performance of their duties.

5. Will be required to function under written plant operating and maintenance procedures as appropriate, assist in their preparation and document records as required by management.

6. Will be required to perform duties when necessary from scaffoldings and catwalks in high and confined areas.

7. May be required to accept temporary assignments as an Operator/Repairman.

8. Must demonstrate and maintain proficiency.

9. Will be required to demonstrate proficiency through periodic on-the-job assessments and evaluations.

10. Must possess a Minnesota State First Class Grade ""A"" License at the time of assignment and will be required to secure a Minnesota State Chief Class Grade ""A"" within two years.

11. Must possess and maintain training and qualification in mechanical maintenance skills and abilities equivalent to maintenance repairman.

NOTE: The above list is not all-inclusive. Other Operation or Repairmen job duties or requirements may be required, as management deems necessary.

jobs.title: Lead Strategy & Planning Consultant, VP - Wealth & Investment Management (WIM) Strategy
jobs.description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Strategy & Planning Consultant, Vice President, to join the Wealth & Investment Management (WIM) Strategy team. Learn more about the career areas and business divisions at wellsfargojobs.com.

The Lead Consultant will support the Head of WIM Strategy, the Strategy leadership team, and WIM business leaders in shaping business innovation, growth opportunities, and strategic priorities across the wealth and investment management ecosystem and will own the analysis and recommendations that advance business transformation and position WIM for sustainable long-term growth in an evolving competitive and regulatory environment.

The Lead Consultant will own strategy workstreams from problem definition through executive recommendation and will be the primary builder of the analytics and executive materials that WIM leadership decides from. They will work directly with and support members of the WIM Operating Committee and their teams, and will provide guidance to less experienced colleagues.

The successful candidate brings a strong understanding of the wealth management and investment industry — client segments, advisor models, platform capabilities, investment products, regulatory considerations, and the competitive landscape — combined with the management consultant’s toolkit: structured problem solving, critical thinking, quantitative rigor, and concise executive communication. Candidates may enter strong on either the consulting toolkit or wealth management domain depth and develop the other. Critical success factors include working effectively in a matrixed organization, building partnerships across business and functional areas, and influencing without authority, with a sense of urgency and personal accountability for results.

In this role, you will:

• Lead the development of assigned strategic plans and analyses that position WIM for long-term growth, and draft assigned sections and build the exhibits for the WIM annual strategic plan and strategy presentations for the Board of Directors and Investor Day.
• Support the long-term (3–5 year) strategic vision and growth plan for assigned WIM businesses, encompassing advisory, brokerage, digital and self-directed wealth, deposits, lending, and trust.
• Own workstreams within the digital and self-directed wealth strategy, including client segmentation, the self-directed-to-advised funnel, pricing and digital engagement economics, and the analysis behind build, buy, or partner recommendations.
• Own workstreams within the workplace wealth strategy across stock plan, equity compensation, and retirement offerings, and support diligence, economics, and negotiation of partnership agreements with Legal, Risk, Finance, Product, and Corporate Development partners.
• Own the analysis and business case for growth in deposits, securities-based and mortgage lending, and trust and fiduciary relationships, including cash and sweep economics, client primacy, and channel-level opportunity sizing.
• Evaluate options for emerging areas including digital assets, assessing regulatory developments, competitor moves, and client demand, including intangible and unprecedented factors.
• Identify and size AI-enabled organizational efficiency opportunities across WIM, and partner with business owners to convert them into implementable changes.
• Develop competitive and market intelligence on evolving client expectations, advisor needs, regulatory developments, and technology innovations, benchmarking across wealth managers, RIAs, asset managers, digital wealth platforms, private banks, and fintech entrants.
• Support alignment and coordination with firmwide and cross-LOB objectives, including with Consumer Banking and Lending, Commercial Banking, Corporate and Investment Banking, and Corporate Strategy.
• Build the analytics that decisions rest on — market and competitor sizing, client and advisor economics, business cases, and scenario models — with the driver logic explicit and reviewable.
• Use AI agents and tooling as the default method for research, modeling, competitive monitoring, and presentation development, and help improve the team’s toolchain.
• Communicate insights, strategic recommendations, and execution roadmaps clearly to senior leaders and stakeholders across WIM.
• Make decisions in complex situations that influence and lead the broader work team to meet deliverables and drive new initiatives and provide guidance to less experienced staff.

Required Qualifications:

• 5+ years of Strategy and Planning experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education.

Desired Qualifications:

• 5+ years of progressively increasing responsibility across management consulting, corporate strategy, product strategy, or a wealth management product, field, or finance role.
• The management consultant’s toolkit, structured problem solving, critical thinking, quantitativi rigor, and concise executive communication or wealth management domain depth; candidates may enter strong on one dimension and develop the other.
• An innovation mindset with the ability to leverage emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, to accelerate business performance, evidenced by AI agents or workflows the candidate has built into how work gets done.
• Exposure to one or more of: digital and self-directed wealth; partnerships, corporate development, or M&A workplace wealth including stock plan and retirement; deposit, lending, and trust growth within a wealth channel; digital assets; operational and process improvement.
• Advanced quantitative modeling skills and the ability to produce executive-quality materials without a supporting analyst.
• Experience developing product, capability, or investment roadmaps and translating strategic priorities into actionable plans and measurable outcomes.
• Experience contributing to Board of Directors or Investor Day strategy materials, or to an annual strategic planning cycle.
• Experience operating in a large-scale, complex matrixed organization, and influencing without authority.
• Ability to bring structure to ambiguity, prioritize independently, and follow through in a fast-moving environment.
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a track record of converting insights into actionable plans, and excellent written and verbal communication across audiences and levels.

Job Expectations:

• Some travel required.
• Ability to work at one of the locations in the job posting.
• This position does not offer relocation assistance.
• This position currently offers a hybrid work schedule.
• This position does not offer VISA sponsorship.

Posting Location:

• 500 West 33rd Street - New York, NY​

​Specific compliance policies may apply regarding outside activities and/or personal investing; affected employees will be expected to provide information to the Wells Fargo Personal Account Dealing Team and abide by applicable policy requirements if hired. Information will be shared about expectations during the recruitment process.

Pay Range

Reflected is the base pay range offered for this position. Pay may vary depending on factors including but not limited to demonstrated examples of prior performance, skills, experience, or work location. Employees may also be eligible for incentive opportunities.
$143,000.00 - $224,000.00

Benefits

• 401(k) Plan
• Paid time off

Posting End Date:

27 Sep 2026

We Value Equal Opportunity

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

En quête d’une première expérience qui fait la différence ?

Rejoins Airbus Atlantic et donne une trajectoire unique à ton parcours grâce à ce stage.

Nous sommes un leader mondial sur le marché des aérostructures, des sièges pilotes et des fauteuils passagers premium.

Dans le cadre de votre formation initiale, vous recherchez un stage obligatoire ou intégré dans une année de césure, d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, vous permettant de valider votre année.

Une offre de stage intitulée « STAGE 2027 - Préparateur Méthodes Industrielle A330 & A400M(ALL GENDER) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’Airbus Atlantic sur le site de Rochefort.

Cette mission débutera en Mars 2027 (date sujette à flexibilité) pour une durée de 6 mois.

Découvrez le site en vidéo

Retrouvez Airbus Atlantic en vidéo

Présentation Airbus Atlantic

Présentation du site de Rochefort

Tâches et responsabilités :

Vous rejoindrez dans un environnement multi métier une équipe de 7 personnes au sein du département Manufacturing Engineering  A330 & A400M en charge de la préparation méthodes du A330 et A400M.

Encadré par votre tuteur, vous développerez vos compétences en travaillant sur les activités suivantes :

• Support d’industrialisation :

Vous assurez le suivi rigoureux des dossiers de mise en production, en veillant au respect des jalons techniques et des standards de qualité aéronautique. Veiller à l'application des process en suivi de production

• Performance & Optimisation :

Vous analysez les cycles de fabrication pour identifier des leviers d'amélioration, avec l'objectif de rendre nos processus plus fluides, plus robustes et plus efficaces.

• Ingénierie de fabrication :

Vous participez à la structuration et à la mise à jour des dossiers de fabrication (gammes et fiiches d'instruction), garantissant ainsi une transmission d’information et un support aux équipes de production.

Durant votre stage, vous développerez les compétences suivantes en lien avec votre formation :

• CAO & Maquette Numérique : Consultation, prise de côtes, manipulation de la CAO avion.
• Support de production : Participer à la vie série de la production et être support à la résolutions des aléas afin de permettre la livraison des avions en termes sécurité, qualité, coûts et délais.
• Analyse de risques : être force de proposition dans la participation à l'analyse de risque produit/process, utilisation de la méthode AMDEC/PFMEA
• Industrialisation : participation à l'industrialisation d'une modification, de la réception des données d'entrées du bureau d'études jusqu'à l'implémentation et le suivi en production et dans le respect des règles et process aéronautiques.
• Performance industrielle : Proposer et mettre en place des solutions permettant un gain de productivité sur les chaînes d'assemblage.

Parlons de VOUS !

Vous préparez actuellement un diplôme de niveau Bac +3 ou +5 (ou équivalent) dans le domaine de la production industrielle  ou une discipline apparentée.

Vous avez les connaissances et compétences suivantes :

• Esprit d'analyse : Face à une problématique complexe, vous savez prendre de la hauteur pour synthétiser l'essentiel et proposer des solutions.
• Engagement et rigueur : Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre implication et votre sens des responsabilités.
• Aisance relationnelle : Fluidité relationnelle et posture d'interface adaptées à la diversité des interlocuteurs (compagnons d'atelier, support technique, bureau d'études).
• Curiosité technique : Vous cherchez toujours à approfondir vos connaissances techniques pour optimiser les lignes de production.
• Français : courant
• Anglais : intermédiaire

Vous pourrez être amené(e) à vous déplacer avec votre tuteur.

Parlons de NOUS !

Rejoindre Airbus Atlantic en tant que stagiaire, c'est :

• Participer à des projets ambitieux, à la pointe de la technologie, visant à construire l’avion de demain tout en répondant aux défis environnementaux,
• Acquérir des compétences dans un environnement dynamique qui encourage la créativité et l'initiative, avec une approche entrepreneuriale,
• Évoluer au sein d'une organisation solidaire, qui valorise la proximité et l'humain.

Notre processus de sélection:

Toutes les candidatures seront soigneusement examinées par un recruteur.

Si votre candidature est présélectionnée, vous serez invité à réaliser un entretien vidéo afin de vous présenter.

Après évaluation, les candidats retenus seront contactés pour un entretien avec le manager ou le tuteur qui procédera alors à la sélection finale.

Internship

Student

Support to Management

Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

Airbus is, and always has been, committed to equal opportunities for all. As such, we will never ask for any type of monetary exchange in the frame of a recruitment process. Any impersonation of Airbus to do so should be reported to emsom@airbus.com.

jobs.description:

Join us in Santa Clara, CA, and be a member of a team dedicated to outstanding performance and careful implementation!

• Drive continuous improvement and automation across the program by finding opportunities to streamline, standardize, and rationalize controls.
• Support and evaluate the efforts of offshore testers, giving coaching and feedback to maintain quality and audit-ready documentation.

• 8+ overall years in Big 4 and/or large public company environments, with broad hands-on SOX and internal audit experience covering core business processes.

• Track record of getting results through influence.

• Reports progress, outcomes, and emerging opportunities to senior leadership, framing impact in terms of business value (accuracy, recovery, cycle time, appeals resolution).
• Builds team capability, coaching Senior Managers on both delivery oversight and people leadership as their own teams grow.

jobs.title: SRE Systems Engineer (TS/SCI Clearance)
jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Join our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team, where you'll work alongside Infrastructure and Research & Development (R&D) partners to keep Salesforce cloud services available for customers around the clock. In this role, you'll detect and resolve incidents fast, drive automation, and help build the resilient systems that millions of customers depend on every day.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

• Monitor customer-facing services and respond to Severity 0 (Sev0) and Severity 1 (Sev1) incidents, leading technical reviews and contributing to root cause analyses.
• Automate the detection and resolution of recurring production issues to reduce engineering and operations toil.
• Contribute to compliance, resiliency, and self-healing initiatives, including destructive testing and game day exercises.
• Partner with and mentor teammates to stay current on industry technology and drive team development.

You're Our Person If...

• You have experience in enterprise-scale internet service engineering or support, with strong command line interface (CLI) knowledge of Unix variants, including Red Hat Enterprise Linux.
• You have expertise in Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP) networking technologies and protocols.
• You have demonstrated experience with incident management and a solid understanding of IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL) service operations in a 24/7 environment.
• You're proficient writing scripts in Python, Go, or similar languages, with experience provisioning and operating Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure.

Even Better If...

• You have experience with configuration management tools such as Chef or Puppet, and pipeline tools such as Jenkins, Bamboo, or Spinnaker.
• You have hands-on experience supporting and managing Kubernetes-based applications and services.
• You hold certifications in Linux+, Red Hat, or AWS.
• You're familiar with Agile processes and DevOps practices.

*LI-Y

This candidate must be a U.S. citizen (U.S. born or naturalized) who does not hold dual citizenship and agrees to complete a U.S. federal government Minimum Background Investigation (MBI) for a Moderate Public Trust position.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination.
